😎 Our Culture
Quantum Metric's number one objective is happy people, diverse and inclusive culture.  We’re passionate about empowering our people to become the best version of themselves, offering coaching and training programs designed to accelerate their career in whatever direction they choose.
As a remote-first company, we understand the importance of building an engaged, diverse, and fun place to work. We hold regular company-wide events, seasonal challenges, and Quantum Metric sponsored local outings when Zoom becomes too much. We also have a number of Employee Resource Groups that provide spaces to discuss, share, and reflect on topics that impact us both inside and outside of work - from being new to SaaS or navigating it as a first-time parent, to overcoming the barriers faced as Black, Hispanic, Asian American and Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander, LGBTQIA or other underrepresented backgrounds.
We are also passionate about the connections we build with our customers. You’ll not only work with some of the world’s most recognized brands, but build lasting relationships.
At Quantum Metric we value all types of experience and education and don’t expect you to meet every qualification for this position. We are most interested in the unique perspective you can bring and your ability to uphold our values of passion, persistence, and integrity.

As an Enterprise Solutions Engineer (EMEA) at Quantum Metric, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor supporting complex, high-value sales opportunities across the region. Working in close partnership with Enterprise Account Executives, you will engage with large, multinational organizations to help them transform how they understand and optimize digital customer experiences.
In this role, you will guide the technical strategy for enterprise deals, aligning Quantum Metric’s platform with strategic business initiatives. You will connect with diverse audiences—from digital and product teams to C-level executives—positioning Quantum Metric as a critical component of enterprise digital transformation.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/3commas/fdcf801d-e267-4.description_excerpt:
ABOUT QUANTPILOT
QuantPilot is 3Commas' AI trading copilot: agents that research markets, generate trading strategies, backtest them and iterate on them together with the trader in a chat. We are building it for serious retail traders who want institutional-grade research tools that until now were available mainly to hedge funds and prop desks.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a Trader to join the product team full-time. This is a hands-on trading role for someone who already runs systematic, automated strategies. Your day-to-day is building and stress-testing strategies across crypto, futures, stocks, FX, working directly with the engineers and designers building the tools you use. You are not here to advise or observe. You are here because you trade systematically, you automate, and you can push this platform harder than anyone else.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Research and build automated trading strategies using QuantPilot across crypto (perps and spot), futures, stocks, FX, commodities, etc.
- Backtest strategies across multiple timeframes and market conditions using QuantPilot to find edges that hold up.
- Optimize strategy parameters, risk rules, position sizing and entry/exit logic
- Analyze live and historical performance data in QuantPilot to understand why strategies win or lose.
- Stress-test strategies against drawdowns, volatility spikes, low liquidity and black swan scenarios.
- Work with product and engineering daily to identify gaps in the QuantPilot platform, suggest improvements, and validate new features from a trader's perspective.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
You are a systematic trader with at least 2 years experience doing the following:
- You run automated strategies on either crypto (perps and spot), futures, stocks, FX, commodities, etc..
- You have built bots, scripts or systematic setups for use across many markets
- You build and iterate on strategies as a process. You can explain your edge, the market conditions it targets, and why it breaks down outside those conditions.
- You backtest rigorously before deploying. Overfitting, survivorship bias, look-ahead bias, regime change. These are problems you have dealt with, not concepts you have read about.
- Risk management is built into your systems. Position sizing, stop losses, drawdown limits, exposure caps, correlation checks.
- You have opinions about trading infrastructure. You have used multiple platforms, APIs and execution tools. You know what is slow, what breaks, what is missing.
- Bonus: you trade across multiple asset classes. Crypto, stocks, futures, commodities. Cross-market experience makes your input more valuable here.
- Bonus: you have built your own tools. Custom dashboards, alerting systems, execution scripts, data pipelines. Even rough ones count.
THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR
- DeFi yield farmers or liquidity providers.
- Long term holders.
- Discretionary traders with no system behind their trades.
- Manual traders who have never automated anything.

jobs.lever.co/zimperium/ff0d3ed6-7449-4c.description_excerpt:
Zimperium® is the world leader in mobile security, purpose-built to protect the modern mobile enterprise. Trusted by leading organizations and governments, our AI-driven platform delivers real-time, on-device protection for mobile applications and devices. We help organizations stay ahead with proactive defense against evolving threats—including mobile-targeted phishing (mishing), malware, app vulnerabilities, and zero-day exploits. Our mission is to empower organizations to operate securely and confidently in today’s dynamic digital environment.
We are seeking a highly skilled and inquisitive security engineer with deep technical expertise in mobile threat detection and operating system internals. This role focuses on conducting forensics analysis of potentially compromised devices to research, develop, and improve our detection capabilities against advanced mobile threats. Experience in analyzing data from iOS backups and diagnose is at the core of the role. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with an open and adaptive research mindset, maintaining versatility across diverse security challenges. A strong ability to code for the iOS environment, alongside conducting and reviewing high-quality technical work, is essential for success in this position.
Location: Europe
Key Responsibilities:
Design, prototype, and implement new detection techniques and algorithms for the iOS platform based on forensics data coming both from the runtime environment and the offline iOS sysdiagnose and backup files.
Lead and participate in structured brainstorming sessions to generate novel detection ideas against advanced mobile threats.
Analyze, document and make use of iOS internals features in an attempt to improve the runtime and offline detection capabilities.
Develop, maintain, and improve internal tooling and automation to accelerate analysis, triage, and detection development.
Review and interpret forensic data provided by customers, produce clear technical reports, and provide actionable guidance and remediation support.
Write and publish technical blog posts to raise awareness of emerging security risks and share insights with customers and the wider security community.
Required Skills & Experience:
Proven ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment, including forming and leading focused sub-groups to deliver specific project features or research objectives.
Strong knowledge of iOS operating system internals (e.g., diagnose, encrypted backup, daemons/services, sandboxing, code-signing), with a particular focus on the capability to use the data provided by the operating system to detect a compromised device.
Good previous experience in data analysis methods applied to forensics investigations.
Proficiency in reverse engineering using tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, Hopper, or equivalent, including experience writing scripts, leveraging their SDKs, and isolating and reporting technical issues.
Demonstrated ability to think both offensively and defensively, approaching analysis tasks with the mindset of both an attacker and a defender.
Solid programming experience in C, Python, Objective-C and Swift, with the ability to produce efficient, maintainable, and secure code.
Capability to reverse engineer proprietary protocols and interprocess communication mechanisms (e.g., XPC, mach messages, IOKit) is considered a plus.
Practical knowledge of jailbreak methods and iOS exploit classes (e.g., kernel exploits, sandbox escapes, code-signing bypasses), ideally experience in analyzing such exploits or exploit chains is a big plus.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/blue-raincoat-music/3b5.description_excerpt:
Chrysalis Records/Blue Raincoat Music is a leading independent music company headquartered in London and New York. Along with our US partner Reservoir Media, we own the legendary Chrysalis and Tommy Boy catalogues, and we also represent artists through our management arm Blue Raincoat Artists, and publishing via Blue Raincoat Music Publishing.
THE POSITION
As Day-to-Day Manager, you will work closely with Amy Frenchum and her roster of artists, supporting all aspects of their careers. This is a hands-on role that requires a highly organised, proactive and solutions-oriented individual who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
The ideal candidate is a confident communicator who remains calm under pressure, demonstrates sound judgement and takes initiative to get things done. You will bring a positive, collaborative approach to your work, anticipate challenges and take ownership of projects through completion.
We are looking for someone with a modern, forward-thinking approach to artist management who understands that the role extends beyond traditional administrative responsibilities. You will be actively involved in creative strategy, social media, content development, promotional campaigns, budgeting, travel, touring and the overall day-to-day management of artists. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:
DAY-TO-DAY ARTIST MANAGEMENT
- Manage artists' daily schedules, calendars and commitments, ensuring effective coordination of meetings, travel, releases, campaigns and other key activities.
- Serve as a central point of contact for artists, management and external partners, facilitating clear and timely communication across teams.
- Proactively anticipate challenges, identify solutions and resolve issues efficiently.
- Ensure artists are organised, informed and prepared for upcoming commitments and activities.
- Take ownership of assigned projects and responsibilities, managing tasks from planning through execution.
- Keep the Lead Manager informed of key developments, priorities and decisions.
- Support the Lead Manager in implementing broader artist management strategies and initiatives.
CREATIVE & CONTENT
- Support the development and execution of creative content and social media strategies that strengthen artists' brands and audience engagement.
- Contribute innovative ideas for content, digital campaigns and emerging promotional opportunities.
- Assist with capturing, organising, editing and publishing content across digital platforms, as needed.
- Stay informed of emerging social media platforms, digital trends and content formats relevant to artist development.
- Collaborate with artists and their teams to ensure content aligns with broader creative, promotional and commercial objectives.
- Provide basic photo and video editing support when needed.
PROMOTION & CAMPAIGNS
- Coordinate promotional activities surrounding music releases, projects, live performances and other artist initiatives.
- Organise and attend promotional appearances, interviews, content shoots and media commitments, both remotely and in person, as required.
- Liaise with external partners, including publicists, labels, promoters and creative teams, to ensure effective coordination and execution.
- Prepare artists for promotional commitments by providing schedules, briefings and relevant materials.
- Monitor promotional deliverables and timelines to ensure commitments are communicated, coordinated and completed.
BUDGETING & FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
- Develop, manage and track budgets for artist projects, promotional campaigns, content production, travel and touring.
- Maintain accurate records of expenditures, financial commitments, invoices and outstanding payments.
- Collaborate with the Lead Manager and relevant teams to establish budgets and ensure spending remains within approved parameters.
- Monitor project expenses, identify potential budget variances and proactively flag unexpected costs.
- Obtain and evaluate vendor quotes, compare costs and exercise sound financial judgement when making spending recommendations.
- Coordinate expense tracking, invoice processing and payment documentation.
- Prepare clear and accurate budget reports and financial updates for the Lead Manager.
- Utilise spreadsheets and financial tracking tools to maintain organised and accurate records.
TRAVEL & TOURING
- Coordinate and support artist travel, touring schedules and promotional activities, both domestically and internationally.
- Accompany artists to selected performances, promotional engagements and touring commitments, as required.
- Manage logistical arrangements and respond effectively to last-minute schedule changes or unexpected challenges.
- Maintain a calm, professional and solutions-focused approach while working in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.
- Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability to accommodate the evolving demands of artist schedules and touring activities.
- Remain attentive to artists' needs and overall well-being, providing thoughtful and proactive support.
QUALIFICATIONS
- Approximately 4 years of experience in artist management, day-to-day management, the music or entertainment industry, or a closely related field.
- Strong understanding of the modern music industry, including artist development, touring, promotion and digital platforms.
- Excellent organisational, time management and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong professional relationships.
- Strong knowledge of social media platforms, digital content strategies and emerging trends.
- Demonstrated experience developing, managing and tracking budgets, with strong financial awareness and attention to detail.
- Proficiency in spreadsheets and other project management and organisational tools.
- Excellent problem-solving skills, sound judgement and the ability to remain composed under pressure.
- Proven ability to work independently, take initiative and exercise discretion while maintaining clear communication with management.
- Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with artists, management teams and external partners while respecting established relationships.
- Flexible, hands-on and adaptable approach, with a willingness to support responsibilities at all levels.
- Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as required.
- Genuine passion for music, artist development and innovative approaches to artist management.
- Basic photo and video editing skills are a plus.

ABOUT CLIPBOOK
Clipbook’s mission: reinvent how leaders listen to and engage with the world of information that comes out every day.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/novogaia/c5fa8f21-1f21-.description_excerpt:
OVERVIEW
Novogaia is an applied AI drug discovery company. We build machine learning systems that decode the chemistry of natural organisms, starting with fungi, to find the next generation of medicines.
We are a small team of AI engineers, computational biologists and chemists building foundation models for molecular structure prediction from mass spectrometry data. We are seeking a machine learning research engineer to lead the development of these models: setting modeling direction, designing and running architecture experiments, and owning and implementing innovative architectural improvements. You will also work with our computational chemists to design our internal benchmark and evaluation pipelines.
THE ROLE
In your first year, you'll take the lead on Gaia-02 model development, building on the work done to train Gaia-01 https://www.novogaia.bio/gaia-01while moving us towards an innovative, best-in-class architecture.
- Lead modeling decisions for Novogaia's core tasks: de novo molecular structure generation, molecular and spectral retrieval, mass spectrum simulation, molecular formula prediction, and compound property/class prediction
- Serve as the technical authority for Novogaia’s machine learning program: set modeling and experimentation standards through your own best practices, and lead architecture reviews and experiment design across the team, including:
- Making and experimenting with architecture decisions for our spectrum encoders and structure decoders, justifying each choice with experimental evidence
- Analyzing model behavior and failure cases, and explaining findings to researchers and non-technical stakeholders alike
- Working with engineers to turn training and evaluation code into reproducible, scalable pipelines
- Develop new ways to represent mass spectra and molecular structures, such as how peaks, relationships between peaks, and molecular graphs are encoded as model inputs, and design our internal pipelines to benchmark model performance
- Collaborate with our computational chemists to build a trustworthy benchmark for structure prediction models, including hard negatives and leakage-safe splits
- Follow current research in machine learning and computational mass spectrometry, and propose and prototype relevant approaches from other fields
- Translate lessons from experimentation into research priorities, data requirements, and R&D direction
WHAT WE REQUIRE
- Research or applied experience in machine learning, with direct experience owning foundation model development and generating new modeling ideas
- Depth in model architecture: you have designed or modified architectures such as transformers or graph neural networks, and have improved model performance through changes to the architecture, the training objective, or the data representation rather than hyperparameter tuning alone
- Exceptional technical communication skills, including the ability to explain evaluation findings clearly to both researchers and non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to analyze model behavior and interpret computational results critically
- Strong proficiency in Python and experience with reproducible, containerized pipelines
- Familiarity with cheminformatics representations (SMILES, InChIKey, molecular fingerprints), or willingness to pick these up quickly
- Familiarity with computational mass spectrometry or eagerness to learn
- Ability to work in-person in London
WHAT WE VALUE
- Strong scientific judgment and ability to navigate and operate novel research directions
- Motivation to build infrastructure other people can confidently rely and build upon
- Comfortable being the person who tells the team a result doesn't hold up
- Curiosity, low ego, and a willingness to learn the chemistry side quickly

jobs.ashbyhq.com/posthog/36d5ce14-851c-4.description_excerpt:
ABOUT POSTHOG
PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.
We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:
- A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking
- PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data
- Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.
We are:
1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.
2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.
3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.
We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog.
THINGS WE CARE ABOUT
- Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.
- Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.
- Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.
- Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.
- Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
We are looking for an expert security generalist (in EU/UK) to assist with all things security at PostHog. Someone equally adept (and interested!) in building secure libraries, writing semgrep rules, hardening cloud deployments, improving network observability, and leading incident response.
Someone to take the reins of our security operations, build out our detection pipelines, and ensure that when something goes bump in the night, we have the observability to know exactly what happened.
We're a team that's building internal security products and agents - things like agents to automatically triage wiz alerts, automatically review pull requests, automatically assign vulnerability findings to the owning product team.
In this role you’ll:
- Build from Scratch: You aren't maintaining someone else's legacy SIEM. You are shaping the security team, culture and tooling for a high-growth, open-source company.
- Zero Bureaucracy: We hate meetings. We don't have "Security Committees." You have the autonomy to make changes and move fast.
- Transparency: We work in the open. You’ll be able to see (and contribute to) how we handled past incidents, like this NPM package compromise https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/issues/example.
- Direct Impact: Your work directly protects the data of thousands of customers. When you improve our security posture, the whole company (and our community) feels it.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
- Triage and Tune: You’ll own our Wiz alerts. You’ll be responsible for turning "noise" into "actionable findings" and ensuring we aren't just staring at a dashboard of issues that don't actually matter. We already get relatively few alerts, and we’d like to even further reduce that to just the ones that matter.
- Incident detection, response: You’ll lead the charge on security incidents. Whether it’s a compromised NPM package or a suspicious IAM pattern, you’ll help coordinate the response and lead the post-mortem. You’ll also help build our IR runbooks.
- Build Observability: You’ll build detection pipelines, and close our network-based observability gaps. We want to be able to trace network requests and suspicious activity all the way back to specific code paths.
- Threat Hunting: You’ll proactively hunt for threats in our AWS environment. You won't just wait for an alert; you'll define what "good" looks like and build the telemetry to prove it.
- The VDP: You’ll support our Vulnerability Disclosure Program, triaging reports from researchers and eventually transitioning us toward a formal bug bounty program.
- Enable the Team: You’ll support our product squads with threat modeling and secure design reviews. We don't do "Security says no"; we do "Security says 'here is how to do this safely.'"
- Help build our security culture: Our engineers trust the security team and view security as an enabler. You’ll be a crucial part of helping to continue this excellent (and uncommon) working relationship.
While this is not a Corporate security (MDM, endpoint, device trust) or Supply chain/CI-CD hardening role, in true PostHog style, there are opportunities to work on these as well.
REQUIREMENTS
- Cloud Native: You have 3-5+ years of experience in security engineering with a heavy focus on AWS. You know your way around IAM, VPC logs, and CloudTrail like the back of your hand.
- Detection Specialist: You’ve used CSPM/CNAPP tools (like Wiz or Prisma) and, more importantly, you know how to build detection pipelines that engineers actually trust.
- Battle-Tested: You’ve led incident response before. You’re calm…

🌍 About Abusix
At Abusix, we're a fully remote company united by a shared mission: to make the internet a safer place. Our small, globally distributed team spans multiple countries—from the U.S. to Europe to the Philippines—and thrives in a culture rooted in trust, ownership, and collaboration.
We've been pioneers in the network abuse management space for 15 years, back when abuse management was unknown to 99% of people. Today, we transform complex network and security data into actionable insights through our three Guardian products: real-time blocklists against email threats, SaaS tool for network abuse management, and threat intelligence to prevent attacks.
Our vision is to build a global platform where internet stakeholders collaborate by sharing relevant, real-time security data to solve abuse and cybersecurity challenges together.
🧩 The Role
As our Head of Engineering, you lead Abusix’s 10-person engineering team (including SRE) and own the technical direction and architecture behind our platform. You turn engineering into a performance-driven, product-minded unit, connecting what the team builds to the outcomes it creates for the security teams who rely on Abusix every day.
In this role, you make the handoff between product and engineering work, unblock delivery, and keep releases predictable. From day one, you’re hands-on in the codebase: shipping alongside the team, feeling the same friction they feel, and shifting the balance toward architecture and leadership as you earn the team’s trust. As a player-coach, you lead through the work itself: hands-on and technically credible, bringing your own leadership concept and keeping engineering closely connected and visible across the rest of the company.
You report to the CEO, are part of the leadership team, and work closely with the product team.
💥 The Impact You Make in This Role
- Lead the 10-person engineering team, including SRE: setting priorities, delegating, running 1:1s, and supporting growth, to build a performance-driven, product-minded unit that ships things that matter.
- Own technical direction and architecture for the platform, setting and enforcing engineering principles, to keep the codebase and systems something the team can build on with confidence.
- Stay hands-on in the codebase, writing and reviewing production code alongside the team, to earn trust, feel the same friction engineers feel, and ship real improvements to the team’s day-to-day work.
- Improve the product-to-engineering handoff: tickets, subtasks, estimates, and refinement, with the product team, to turn roadmap intent into predictable delivery.
- Communicate roadmap, status and risk to product and leadership, and bring business context back to the team, to keep engineering visible, trusted, and easy to plan around.
- Unblock delivery and drive predictable releases, so the team consistently ships and the rest of the company can plan around engineering.
- Improve engineering practices, including how the team uses AI in development, to raise the bar on what “good” looks like.
- Hire, onboard and retain engineers as the team grows, to build an organization that can scale past you.
🦄 The Skills and Traits That Let You Thrive in This Role
- Proven experience as a Head of Engineering, Engineering Director, or senior technical lead: you’ve grown a team before and shifted from hands-on coding into architecture and leadership. Background in Product Management is a plus.
- A player-coach mentality: technically excellent and genuinely hands-on, just as comfortable in the codebase as in a design discussion.
- Experience building and shaping an engineering team or organization from the ground up, ideally in a fast-paced startup or scale-up.
- A track record of working closely with a product function: you understand product priorities and can challenge or improve requirements, not just implement them.
- A go-getter mentality: you prioritize what matters and make sure it gets done.
- Strong communication skills: you translate business context for engineers and technical reality for the rest of the company, keeping engineering visible and easy to work with.
- Comfort using AI in your daily development workflow, and curiosity about how it can make the team more effective.
- Fluent English and a remote-first mindset.
- Your core values match ours: Own It, Push Forward, Be Real. Check them out below!
🎁 The Benefits
- Fair compensation according to your location.
- Meaningful ESOP — you share in what we build together.
- Additional location-based benefits where applicable.
- Annual learning and development budget to keep growing.
- Budget for your remote workplace setup or a co-working space.
🌟 What Money-Can’t-Buy
- Real impact: your decisions on architecture, delivery, and team culture directly shape how a 10-person engineering team builds product for security teams worldwide.
- A small, talented team where your voice matters and your senior judgment is genuinely valued.
- Daily use of cutting-edge tools.
- A steep learning curve in a fast-moving cybersecurity domain.
- Flexible working hours that respect your life outside work.
- Generous PTO policy.
- Fast-paced, high-tech B2B environment where things actually ship.
✨ Our Main Values
- 🎯 Own It - Take initiative and care about results — for our customers, Abusix and your team. That starts with truly understanding what Abusix does — the threats we fight, the customers we protect, and why any of it matters.
- 🚀 Push Forward - Challenge the status quo and don't wait for permission to try something new. Failure is how we learn — we'd rather you move fast and miss than stand still and wait.
- 💎 Be Real - Treat people with respect, say what you mean, and show up as yourself. No politics, no hiding, no ego. We're honest with each other, our customers, and ourselves.
🦄 Our Commitment to "💎 Be Real" in Hiring
We value authenticity in our hiring process. During interviews, we'll share openly about both our successes and our challenges - that's how we stay true to our values. We're looking for real people, not perfect personas.

ABOUT ARKETA
Arketa is building the operating system for modern fitness and wellness. Our mission is to make wellness more accessible by empowering studios and wellness entrepreneurs to grow beyond in-person classes. We provide a powerful, all-in-one platform to manage and scale hybrid wellness businesses, whether online, in-person, or both.
With Arketa, studios can manage schedules, accept bookings and payments, build on-demand video libraries, host retreats, run automated marketing, and launch fully branded apps and websites. We make it simple for founders to deliver a seamless, professional experience across every customer touchpoint. We've raised $15M in Series A funding and are growing quickly. It's a unique moment to join us. We're building a category-defining company in a fast-moving space, and we're looking for a leader who is excited to help shape what world-class partner support looks like in the wellness category.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Guides, coaches, and migration specialists wanted. Our Onboarding team is the first real experience every studio has with Arketa after they sign. We take them from excited new customer to confident, launched business — managing their data migration, training their team, and making sure Arketa is set up to actually work the way their business runs. If you love building relationships, digging into a good migration challenge, and getting real satisfaction from watching a studio owner go from nervous to confident, we want to meet you.
As an Onboarding Specialist, you'll own the full onboarding experience for migrating studios — from kickoff call through go-live. You'll work with studio owners coming from platforms like Acuity, Glofox, Vagaro, Wix, Squarespace, and 60+ others, managing both the data migration side (call prep, data mapping, coordinating with our Migrations team) and the product side (training owners and staff on Arketa so they can actually run their business on it).
The sales team has already shown these studios what Arketa can do. Your job is to deliver on that promise — making a data migration feel manageable, configuring the platform to match how a studio operates, and training owners until they're genuinely confident. At steady state you'll launch ~15–18 studios per month, carrying a larger active pipeline at any given time.
ABOUT THE TEAM
The Onboarding team is remote-first, spread across the US and UK. We're structured into three tiers based on migration complexity — as a Tier 2 specialist, you'd own medium-complexity migrations with full support from our Migrations team on the data side.
Day-to-day you'll work closely with three teams: Migrations (data cleaning and triage), Sales (who hand off deals at close), and Support (who take partners after go-live). The culture is collaborative and feedback-driven — we're always looking for ways to improve how we work, and everyone is expected to contribute to that.
This role reports to Scott Bartel, Onboarding Manager.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Own the full onboarding experience for migrating studios — kickoff, dashboard reviews, data mapping calls, and site review through go-live.
- Become a deep Arketa product expert. Know the platform well enough to answer almost anything a partner throws at you, and configure it in a way that fits how their business actually runs.
- Train studio owners and staff on how to use Arketa to manage their business — scheduling, memberships, payments, and day-to-day operations — until they're genuinely confident, not just technically set up.
- Lead data call prep and data mapping calls with partners; validate exported data, catch defects early, and keep the migration on track.
- Coordinate with our Migrations team on data cleaning — you own the partner relationship and the review; they handle the technical heavy lifting.
- Manage standard Stripe and billing/autopay transitions.
- Keep your pipeline current with accurate stages, dates, and call logs at all times — your KPIs are only as good as your HubSpot data.
- Respond to all partner emails within 24 hours, Monday–Friday. Even a quick "I'm looking into this" counts — partners should never wonder if you saw their message.
- Escalate complex migrations outside your scope to our senior onboarders.
- Surface product and process feedback internally to improve the experience for every partner that comes after.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
We believe in setting our team up to thrive.
- 30 days: Product-certified and shadowing live onboarding calls. Clear handle on Arketa's core features and how each type of studio uses them. First solo studios in progress with support available.
- 60 days: Running your full pipeline independently — kickoffs, data mapping calls, training sessions, and go-lives. Comfortable navigating migrations from the platforms you see most often. NPS trending positive.
- 90 days: Launching at or near target velocity (~15–18/month). Partners consistently arriving at go-live confident and prepared. Proactively surfacing process improvements and product feedback to the team.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:
- 1–3 years in customer success, onboarding, implementation, or studio/software management
- You learn software quickly and get genuinely excited about knowing a product inside and out
- A natural trainer — you can walk a non-technical studio owner through a new tool and leave them feeling capable, not overwhelmed
- Strong relationship instincts — partners feel like they're in good hands from the first call
- Clear communicator: you can make a complex setup or migration question feel simple in writing, on a call, or in a walkthrough
- Organized and self-managing — you're carrying a large active pipeline at all times and nothing falls through
- Comfortable with data calls and migration exports — not intimidated by a spreadsheet
- UK-based with full availability during UK business hours
BONUS:
- Experience with fitness/wellness studio software (Acuity, Glofox, Vagaro, or similar)
- You've worked behind the desk of a wellness business
- Familiarity with Intercom, HubSpot, Notion, or similar tools — or the ability to learn them fast
- Comfort using AI-assisted tools to accelerate your work
YOU SHOULD APPLY IF
- You get genuine satisfaction from watching someone go from overwhelmed to confident on a new tool
- You like variety — no two studios run exactly the same way, and you enjoy figuring out how to make the product work for each one
- You're the kind of person who reads the help docs and notices when something could be explained better
- You're organized enough to carry a large pipeline without dropping anything, and proactive enough that partners never have to chase you
- You're mission-driven and excited about wellness becoming more accessible
YOU MAY NOT WANT TO APPLY IF
- You prefer a narrow, defined scope — this role touches product knowledge, data migrations, training, and relationship management all at once
- You're not comfortable with spreadsheets or data calls — migrations are a real part of…

jobs.ashbyhq.com/basis-research/f379d8de.description_excerpt:
ABOUT BASIS
Basis https://www.basis.ai is a nonprofit applied AI research organization with two mutually reinforcing goals.
The first is to understand and build intelligence. This means to establish the mathematical principles of what it means to reason, to learn, to make decisions, to understand, and to explain; and to construct software that implements these principles.
The second is to advance society’s ability to solve intractable problems. This means expanding the scale, complexity, and breadth of problems that we can solve today, and even more importantly, accelerating our ability to solve problems in the future.
To achieve these goals, we’re building both a new technological foundation that draws inspiration from how humans reason, and a new kind of collaborative organization that puts human values first.
ABOUT THE ROLE
GTM Leads at Basis drive our international expansion by building and converting commercial pipelines, localizing strategic relationships, and translating research capabilities into customer value. This role focuses specifically on developing UK/EU markets while supporting US growth.
We are looking for people who combine entrepreneurial vision with commercial rigor. The ideal candidate has founded or operated in early-stage ventures, understands technical innovation deeply enough to articulate its value, and thrives at the intersection of research and commercial application. You will discover new verticals, structure complex partnerships, and flag operational needs as Basis scales.
Basis is a collaborative endeavor, both internally and with our external partners; we are looking for people who relish building ecosystems larger than what they can create alone.
WE EXPECT YOU TO:
- Have demonstrated ability to build and convert commercial pipelines in technical domains. This could be evidenced by venture associate experience, business development roles at deep tech companies, or founder experience scaling startups internationally.
- Possess sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with both AI researchers and enterprise customers. You should understand machine learning concepts, probabilistic programming, and AI capabilities well enough to translate technical features into business value propositions.
- Bring international market development experience, particularly in UK/EU markets. You understand regional differences in business culture, regulatory environments (such as the EU AI Act), and partnership dynamics across multiple countries.
- Excel at relationship building with diverse stakeholders including venture capitalists, cloud partners, system integrators, academic institutions, and government agencies.
- Have experience with complex deal structuring, including design partnerships, research collaborations, contract negotiations, and proposal development for sophisticated technical offerings.
- Progress with a high degree of autonomy and under uncertainty. You can identify opportunities, structure approaches, and execute without extensive direction in ambiguous environments.
- Be excited about advancing societal capability to solve intractable problems through AI research that prioritizes rigor, safety, and human value.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Discover and develop new commercial opportunities across industries and geographies, with primary focus on building UK/EU pipeline and supporting US market expansion.
- Conduct customer discovery conversations to understand domain challenges, validate problem-solution fit, and translate needs into technical requirements that inform Basis research directions.
- Structure and negotiate partnerships including design partnerships, cloud provider collaborations, system integrator relationships, and academic/corporate research agreements.
- Develop compelling commercial materials including proposals, case studies, and pitch decks that articulate Basis capabilities and differentiation.

- Build localized presence and relationships in UK/EU markets, identifying potential needs for international entity setup and operational infrastructure.
- Identify and flag operational needs that arise from commercial activities, such as compliance requirements, delivery capabilities, or resource constraints.
- Collaborate with Systems Engineers to ensure commercial opportunities align with technical capabilities and research directions, preventing overpromising while maximizing impact.
- Contribute to Basis culture and strategic direction, bringing market intelligence that informs product roadmap, research priorities, and organizational growth.
ROLE DETAILS
Exceptional candidates who may not meet all of the following criteria are still encouraged to apply.

- In-person Policy: We are in the office four days a week. Be prepared to travel regularly to UK/EU markets and attend multi-day Basis-wide in-person events.

Your information may be processed in different countries, including the US. You retain copyright while providing Basis a license to use these materials for the stated purposes.

日本語
勤務地： リモートワーク（日本在住の方歓迎）
契約形態： 業務委託（フリーランス）
会社名： Animation Inc.（Animates）
私たちについて
Animation Inc.は、AIキャラクターと自然な会話を楽しめるコンパニオンアプリ「Animates」を開発しているスタートアップです。
Animatesでは、リアルタイムのアニメーション、自然な会話、そして過去のやり取りを記憶する機能を組み合わせることで、キャラクターがまるで生きているかのように感じられる体験を目指しています。
私たちが大切にしているのは、キャラクターそれぞれの個性や感情が伝わり、ユーザーとの会話を通じて親しみや愛着が生まれることです。
今回、キャラクターの会話をより自然で魅力的なものにするため、日本語のセリフや会話表現を一緒に考えていただけるライターを募集します。
募集ポジションについて
自然な日本語の会話表現に優れ、言葉遣いや会話のテンポ、感情表現などの細かなニュアンスを理解しているキャラクター・会話シナリオライターを募集しています。
AIキャラクターの話し方、感情表現、性格、ユーザーとのコミュニケーションのあり方などを考え、キャラクターの魅力を引き出していただくポジションです。
一般的な翻訳やローカライズ業務とは異なり、キャラクターが「そのキャラクターらしく」話し、反応するための表現をつくるクリエイティブな仕事です。
たとえば、同じ内容を伝える場合でも、キャラクターの性格や感情、相手との関係性によって、言葉遣いや会話のテンポは変わります。そうした細かなニュアンスを大切にできる方を求めています。
長年の実務経験は必須ではありません。経験年数よりも、創造性、キャラクターへの理解、自然で魅力的な会話を書く力を重視しています。
業務内容
- キャラクターの性格、口調、話し方の設計・改善
- キャラクターごとの個性や感情、状況に合わせた自然な日本語のセリフ・会話の作成
- 会話のテンポ、言葉遣い、ユーモア、感情表現などの調整
- ユーザーへの反応や感情表現、関係性の築き方など、キャラクターの振る舞いに関するアイデアの提案
- キャラクターの個性を一貫して表現するための会話スタイルやガイドラインの作成
- 海外のクリエイティブチーム・プロダクトチームとの連携
- 既存のキャラクターの会話をレビューし、より自然で感情豊かな表現へ改善
必須条件
- ネイティブレベルの日本語力があり、自然な会話表現や言葉のニュアンスを深く理解している方
- 日常会話で使われる自然な言い回し、口語表現、会話のテンポ、ユーモア、感情表現に敏感な方
- キャラクターの個性を表現し、魅力的な会話やセリフを作成できる文章力・創作力
- 海外チームと英語でコミュニケーションが取れる方（チャット・オンラインミーティングの両方）
- キャラクター制作や会話・セリフの執筆スキルが分かるポートフォリオ、または作品サンプルを提出できる方
- AI、インタラクティブな会話、キャラクターを中心としたコンテンツに興味がある方
歓迎条件
- キャラクター制作、クリエイティブライティング、ゲーム、映画などの分野での執筆経験
- 脚本制作、演劇、コメディなど、会話やセリフを中心とした創作活動の経験
- インタラクティブストーリー、分岐型シナリオ、会話デザインの経験
- AIキャラクターや会話型AIサービスへの関心・理解
- 現代の日本語による日常的なコミュニケーションについての実践的な理解
- ロシア語でのコミュニケーション能力
ポートフォリオについて
ご応募の際は、キャラクター制作や会話・セリフの執筆経験が分かる作品をご提出ください。
ゲーム、映画、演劇、コメディ、インタラクティブストーリー、個人制作作品など、ジャンルは問いません。
特に、キャラクターの個性が伝わるセリフや、自然な会話のやり取りが分かるサンプルを歓迎します。
商業作品や正式なポートフォリオがなくても問題ありません。
個人制作や自主制作の作品でも、創造性、キャラクター表現力、自然な日本語の会話を書く力が伝わるものであれば、ぜひお送りください。
働き方について
まずは業務委託（フリーランス）としての協業を予定しています。
リモートでの柔軟な働き方が可能です。具体的な業務範囲や稼働時間については、選考過程でご相談させていただきます。
お互いにとって良い協業となれば、長期的な継続も検討しています。
ご応募をお待ちしています
「このキャラクターなら、きっとこう話すはず」
そんな感覚を大切にしながら、AIキャラクターに個性と魅力を吹き込む仕事です。

- Firsthand understanding of contemporary everyday Japanese communication.
- Russian language skills.

We’ll start with a freelance collaboration, with the potential for a longer-term partnership.

Interested?
Ever thought about what makes a fictional character feel real?

GLOBAL SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE (SDR)
🌍 UK (Remote or Hybrid, it’s up to you!)
💰 Dependent on experience, plus commission
📈 Be part of our success with the opportunity to join our company equity scheme
🦸‍♀️ THE ROLE 🦸‍♀️
At Chattermill, we empower leading brands like Uber, Amazon, E.On, Next, and HelloFresh to put customers at the heart of everything they do. Our advanced Customer Experience Intelligence platform uses innovative AI to continuously analyse customer feedback, helping clients make data-driven decisions and elevate their service.
We’re seeking a dynamic Global Sales Development Representative (SDR) to play a pivotal role in our growth journey.
👉 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:
You’ll be playing a key role in prospecting and qualifying enterprise opportunities within Chattermill's defined Enterprise ICP. This means you will:
- Identify, research, and prioritise enterprise target accounts (with $1bn+ revenue) across Europe, the UK, and North America.
- Build and execute tailored, multi-channel outbound campaigns (email, phone, LinkedIn, video) aimed at senior leaders in CX, Product, Insights, and Voice of Customer roles.
- Qualify inbound and outbound leads against both our ICP and non-ICP criteria.
- Book and progress qualified meetings, ensuring a smooth handoff and maintaining an accurate pipeline in HubSpot.
- Develop strong knowledge of our solution, target customers, and the competitive landscape to engage confidently with enterprise stakeholders.
- Continuously iterate and refine your messaging, outreach sequences, and targeting strategy based on conversion data and insights.
🧰 WHAT YOU’LL NEED:
- 6 - 12 months’ experience in a B2B SaaS environment (preferred)
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple conversations simultaneously
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced setting
- Coachable mindset, eager to learn and apply feedback quickly
- Excellent written and verbal communication, comfortable engaging prospects across phone, email, and LinkedIn
- Commercial curiosity with a natural ability to understand customer pain points and clearly communicate value

1. Introductory asynchronous interview – tell us about yourself and what you’re looking for. Our team will review your submission.
2. Sales Director interview – discuss your experience and learn more about the role.

- Flexible working in a choice-first environment - we trust the way you want to work!
- Work-from-home allowance to set up your ideal workspace
🌴 Time Off
- 25 days holiday + local bank holidays, plus an extra day for each year of service
- Your birthday off
🌱 Growth & Ownership
- Annual learning & development budget to support your growth (increasing over time)
- Equity options — share in the company’s success
💚 Health & Wellbeing
- Monthly health & wellbeing budget, increasing with length of service
- Optional private healthcare plan
- Life assurance & income protection (location dependent)
- Employee Assistance Programme (location dependent) for extra support when you need it
- Enhanced family leave (location dependent), plus fertility and neonatal leave
🌆 Office Perks
- If you’re in London, a dog-friendly office with great classes, events, and a rooftop terrace

- We are obsessed with experience – We take our mission to rid the world of bad Customer Experience seriously, and we practice what we preach.
- We believe in the power of trust – Whether it's with each other, our customers, partners, or other stakeholders, we always communicate with openness and trust.

We want to enable exceptional experiences for everyone, and to achieve this we need everyone’s voice in our team.  We are on a mission to bring more diversity into the business and to give everyone (from all backgrounds and abilities) a chance to join us, even if they may not fit all of the requirements set out in this job spec. Introduction to Role & Team
Bumble Inc. is looking for an Integrity Operations Specialist to join our Trust Operations team. Trust and safety are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by supporting members through some of their most sensitive and challenging experiences.
You’ll investigate safety concerns, review accounts and content against Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines, and provide compassionate, trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents. You’ll work across a range of complex and sensitive issues, using established policies, operational guidance, sound judgment, and AI-supported tools to reach fair and consistent outcomes. You’ll also collaborate closely with colleagues across Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, taking ownership of cases and demonstrating our Bumble values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and one another.
This role will be based in the U.K. and will report to the Senior Integrity Operations Manager.
Please note that this position involves exposure to sensitive and graphic content, including but not limited to vulgar, violent, and sexual content.
What you’ll do
- Investigate and take action on member reports and proactive detections involving safety concerns, including harassment, threats, non-consensual imagery, and other potential violations of Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines.
- Provide thoughtful, high-touch and trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents, demonstrating Respect and care while following established safety processes.
- Review accounts and content flagged for potential safety violations, applying policies and operational guidance consistently while using sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps.
- Manage sensitive and time-critical cases with attention to detail, taking ownership of your work and seeing cases through from initial review to an appropriate outcome.
- Collaborate purposefully with Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, Legal, and other partners to escalate and help resolve cases that require additional expertise or support.
- Identify recurring issues, patterns, and opportunities to improve workflows, sharing insights that can strengthen operational consistency and member safety.
- Use AI-supported tools and internal systems to improve efficiency and support decision-making, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before taking action.
- Participate in on-call rotations, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed, adapting with an agile mindset to support our global community.
About you
- Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.
- Bring experience in Trust & Safety, customer support, crisis response, content moderation, or another environment where you have handled sensitive or safety-related issues.
- Are comfortable reviewing potentially distressing content, including material relating to child exploitation, sexual or physical violence, suicide and self-harm, while approaching this work with care and professionalism.
- Communicate clearly and compassionately in writing and verbally, particularly when supporting vulnerable individuals or navigating sensitive situations.
- Apply sound judgment within established policies and processes, balancing efficiency with careful, consistent decision-making and demonstrating Bumble’s values of Respect and Excellence.
- Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your work, and maintain an agile mindset as priorities, cases, and operational needs evolve.
- Proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, French, or another language in addition to English is welcomed but not required.
About Us
Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.
AI Fluency
AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.
We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.
Final Compensation
Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.
Inclusion at Bumble Inc.
Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.
In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).
AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring
At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

About the Role:
Camunda runs on trusted data for people and agents. The Holistic Data Platform (HDP) is how we get there: a data warehouse, consumption layer, and a context layer that agents use to answer questions about pipeline, bookings, ARR and product usage. We are hiring a Data Engineer who builds that platform and also cares whether the numbers are right, whether the business uses them, and whether an agent gives a correct answer on top of them. You will work directly with Corporate Strategy, Finance, Sales, Product, and Marketing leaders.
What you'll be doing:
- The consumption and context layers. Design models, metric definitions, and documentation that make HDP legible to both people and agents. A metric that two teams read differently is a bug you own.
- Data quality as a product. Define what “correct” means for each important metric, test for it, monitor it, and tell us fast when it breaks. Reconcile HDP against data sources.
- Agent reliability. Build evals for the agents that sit on HDP. Review their answers, find the wrong ones, and fix the cause in the data, the docs, or the prompt context.
- Pipelines and platform. Ingestion, orchestration, dbt, CI/CD, and cost control.
- Enablement. Make it easy for analysts and business owners to get answers without you.
- Judgment calls. Decide which requests deserve a model, which deserve a one-off query, and which deserve a “no, and here is why.”
What you bring:
- We’re looking for an experienced data engineer with ML/AI experience who’s comfortable working in an AI-native environment
- Ability and/or willingness to use Camunda’s product
- 5+ years of Data Engineering or ML experience
- Strong data modeling skills and several years of experience with dbt.
- Ownership mindset: we’re a small team and proud of our accomplishments
- Experience in deploying, operating, and evolving data pipelines in the cloud (batching and streaming)
- Knowledge of Infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform
- Strong communication skills, enjoys sharing knowledge and learning collaboratively
- Passion for clean code, adept at writing automated tests to maintain codebase quality and product excellence

ABOUT CLIPBOARD
Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.
Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.
OVERVIEW
We are hiring an Applied AI Strategy & Ops Lead to own and evolve our internal tooling ecosystem across Ops. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with real ownership. You’ll work across a range of tools including support platforms, AI-driven systems, and internal automations to improve how our day-to-day operations function.
You'll sit at the intersection of Operations and Engineering, acting as the technical voice of Ops and partner closely with team leadership to execute against defined priorities, refine existing systems, and introduce new tooling where needed ensuring our stack continues to scale effectively with the business.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
- Build and iterate on workflows, integrations, and automations that improve day-to-day efficiency
- Execute against high-priority tooling and automation initiatives across the operational stack.
- Partner with engineers and developers to scope requirements, write technical specs, and prioritize tooling work that matters most to Ops.
- Improve systems across multiple tools, including support platforms and AI-driven solutions
- Translate defined problems into practical, well-scoped technical solutions
- Identify gaps or inefficiencies in current tooling and proactively address them
- Troubleshoot issues, improve system reliability, and ensure tools perform effectively in production
- Contribute to ongoing improvements in how our systems connect and operate together
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
- Technical Fluency - You’re comfortable working with APIs, integrations, and automation tooling. You can build and debug independently and hold your own in technical conversations with engineers.
- Execution Discipline - You take defined problems and drive them through to completion. You manage multiple priorities effectively and maintain a high bar for quality and reliability.
- Systems Thinking - You understand how tools, workflows, and dependencies connect. You look for ways to improve how systems operate together, not just individual components.
- Problem Solving - You can take loosely defined or scoped problems and translate them into practical, well-structured solutions.
- Ownership Mindset - You take responsibility for delivering high-quality work and improving the team’s day-to-day operations through better tooling and processes.
NICE TO HAVE
- Experience working with support platforms such as Zendesk
- Familiarity with AI-driven tools and automation workflows
- Background in Ops, Support, or CX environments
- Experience working with evolving or fragmented tooling stacks
HIRING PROCESS
- Application
- Case Study
- Case Interview with a team member
- Interview with Head of Core Services
- Interview with Head of Operations
- Final Culture Interview with Executive Leadership

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/corti/182c6cff-0924-4e1.description_excerpt:
Overview
Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI, building world-leading models and infrastructure for the realities of healthcare.
Our technology powers healthcare’s most ambitious software, from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. We work with builders ranging from fast-moving startups to global healthcare enterprises, helping them bring clinical AI into real-world care.
Healthcare is full of problems where AI has to do more than simply work. Clinicians are overwhelmed by documentation. Coding errors, backlogs and denials cost health systems billions. And the specialist expertise patients need is not always available when they need it.
We build AI specifically for these environments, trained on real patient interactions, validated against real outcomes, and designed to perform where accuracy, trust and reliability matter. If you want to help define how AI is built for healthcare, you belong at Corti.
The Role
We are seeking a technically curious, execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to sit at the center of Corti’s growth engine.
This role is for someone who can read an API doc, spin up a landing page, and write a launch post that developers actually want to read. You are technical enough to understand what we build, creative enough to make people care, and pragmatic enough to ship instead of overthinking.
You will own the surfaces and campaigns that drive developer awareness, acquisition, and activation. That includes product launches, landing pages, demand generation, developer-facing content, and growth analytics. You will move fast across channels and formats, with real ownership over what ships and how it performs.
What you’ll be doing:
Demand generation
- Plan and execute campaigns that drive signups, activations, and pipeline across paid, organic, and owned channels
- Run conversion rate experiments across the signup and activation funnel
- Manage paid campaigns and track performance against acquisition and activation targets
Product launches and landing pages
- Design and build landing pages, launch assets, and promotional materials (often coding or prototyping yourself)
- Collaborate on the end-to-end build and launch process for new products, features, and platform updates
- Coordinate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and design to bring launches to market
- Write launch content and developer-facing announcements that inspire our audience to dive in
Content and SEO
- Produce developer-facing content for blog, social, and community channels
- Build and execute an SEO strategy targeting developers searching for healthcare AI tooling
- Write technical blog posts, guides, and tutorials that position Corti as the default platform for healthcare AI development
- Create sales enablement assets, templates, and collateral as needed
What you bring:
- Strong technical growth or product marketing experience, ideally within a technical product led growth SaaS company or Series A-C startup.
- Experience building and running successful marketing campaigns across paid, organic, email and content channels for a technical audience and are comfortable building things yourself rather than waiting on others.
- Comfortable reading API documentation and understanding how developer products work
- Track record in shipping and “vibe coding” landing pages, launches, growth experiments, and prototypes (or excited to learn)
- Familiar with developer workflows, tooling, and PLG motions
- Comfortable with analytics tools like Google Analytics or Posthog and building reports that drive decisions
- Strong writing skills, particularly for technical and developer-facing audiences
- Genuine interest in AI and healthcare
What a day looks like:
On any given day, you might push a new landing page live for an API feature launch, review funnel metrics to diagnose a drop in activation, draft a blog post on a new agent capability, and jump on a call with product and engineering to scope the next release.
We don’t care about the exact title on your CV. What matters is that you are technical enough to understand what we’re building, fast enough to ship without waiting for permission, and someone your friends might describe as “one of the smartest people they know.”
Life at Corti
- You will report into our VP of Growth
- You will work closely with the Growth, Product, and Engineering teams
- High autonomy, low bureaucracy, and real ownership
- Direct impact on how developers discover and adopt Corti’s platform
- Equipment provided by Corti
- Working in our New York office
Ready to dive into the world of Corti? Hit that 'Apply' button, and let's start working together on reshaping the dialogue in healthcare, making a real difference for millions of patient outcomes around the world.
🤝 Bringing in top talent from all backgrounds is crucial in our pursuit to improve the world of healthcare. We encourage applications from all people and do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, and/or disability status.﻿
At Corti, experience comes in many forms, and we’re passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we’re looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you’ll consider applying!

We’re a simple-to-use photo documentation and productivity app for contractors of every industry. Packed with intuitive functionality, CompanyCam facilitates unparalleled communication and accountability across a contractor’s entire business. By providing a consumer-grade, game-changing experience, we help contractors build trust within their company and with their users.
CompanyCam is a fun, energetic team united by our core values of Show Up, Grow Up, and Do Good. As soon as you join our team, you'll notice that we trust our employees to do what's best for our product, customers, and team members and empower them to make the right calls.
THE ROLE
We're looking for smart, self-motivated, problem-solving Inside Sales Representatives to join our Sales team at CompanyCam. If you're passionate about sales, this is the perfect role for you! As an Inside Sales Representative, you’ll identify and engage with leads, deliver tailored demos, and help contractors improve their businesses with our software. We value a fun, fast-paced environment and are searching for individuals who thrive on building relationships and contributing to our growing success.
Location: This role is remote in England. You must have the legal right to work in the UK.

- Inside Sales Rep and Actively reach out to inbound leads who have inquired about CompanyCam through various channels.
- Identify and address contractors' needs and pain points through tailored sales presentations to a diverse audience, including contractors, project managers, and business owners.
- Communicate CompanyCam’s value proposition to help contractors save time and improve business operations.
- Qualify leads and schedule demos daily to drive product engagement.
- Educate users on product features and act as an onboarding representative for trial users.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with prospects, understand their goals, and offer customized solutions.
- Manage an ongoing pipeline of prospects to deliver new customers consistently at or above our sales quota level.
- Thrive in a fast-paced environment, using multiple systems to manage prospects and sales activities.
- Actively participate in team meetings for feedback and performance improvement.
THE IMPACT YOU'LL HAVE

We're building something that helps real people solve real problems—and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. In this role, you’ll drive impact by:

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 1+ years of experience with directly selling software and leading product demonstrations preferred.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and establish trust with potential customers.
- Strong negotiation and closing skills, with a focus on driving revenue growth and achieving sales targets.
- A strong desire to compete and win, constantly seeking ways to outpace peers and improve individual performance.
- The ability to prioritize and manage time effectively with minimal supervision.
- Experience interacting with our target audience, aka tradespeople.
- A continuous growth mindset with a focus on learning, embracing challenges, and continuously improving.
- A knack for creativity and innovation, bringing fresh ideas to the table and solving complex problems.
BENEFITS & COMPENSATION
This is a salaried position at CompanyCam. Our salary is £53,000 per year plus OTE.
CompanyCam is an equal-opportunity employer committed to respect, inclusion, and growth. We work hard, take responsibility, and support each other. Great ideas come from all backgrounds, and we carefully consider every applicant without regard to personal characteristics or traits. Even if your work experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. jobs.ashbyhq.com/dataro/b299a77a-a6ac-40.description_excerpt:
ABOUT DATARO
Dataro is a fast-growing tech company with a bold mission: set a new standard in charity fundraising. Our AI-driven SaaS tools help nonprofits raise more funds and make a bigger impact in the world. We work with more than 250 organisations across 20+ countries - including UNICEF, Greenpeace, Amnesty International and Save the Children - and we’re looking for someone to help us reach many more of them across the UK and Europe.
We closed a Series A funding round in February 2026, led by Blueprint Equity, and are investing that backing into growing the UK and European business.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As our Sales Development Representative for the UK and Europe, you’ll be the first point of contact between Dataro and the fundraising leaders at large charities across the region. You’ll find the organisations with a problem worth solving, work out who inside them owns it, and open the conversations that let our Account Executives take things forward.
This is an outbound role and it sits at the front of everything we do commercially in the region. You’ll report directly to our Head of Region, UK & Europe, and work day to day alongside two Account Executives. You’ll own your own patch of target accounts across the UK and continental Europe.
This role is ideal for someone a few years into their sales career who wants a real patch rather than a script, and who is ready to move quickly.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Research and prioritise target charities across the UK and Europe, using our ideal customer criteria and live buying signals rather than working an undifferentiated list.
- Run multi-channel outbound - email, LinkedIn and phone - leading with a relevant insight about the prospect’s fundraising programme, not a product pitch.
- Map the buying group, identifying the fundraising managers, data leads and individual giving specialists who feel the problem day to day, and understanding how decisions actually get made inside each organisation.
- Qualify hard and disqualify quickly. A fast no is more useful than a long maybe, for us and for the prospect.
- Book and hand over qualified meetings, with enough context that the Account Executive walks in properly prepared.
- Work across European markets, adapting your approach to local fundraising practice - the sector looks quite different in the Nordics, the Netherlands and the UK.
- Keep HubSpot accurate - accounts, contacts, sequences, activity and notes.
- Act as the voice of the market internally, feeding what you hear back to Sales, Marketing and Product. You’ll be closer to prospective customers than almost anyone else in the business.
QUALIFICATIONS & KEY SKILLS
- 1–3 years’ experience in an outbound SDR or BDR role, ideally B2B SaaS.
- Demonstrable track record of meeting and exceeding outbound activity and meeting targets.
- AI Native - foundational understanding of AI-based efficiency tools (e.g. Claude), and a habit of using them.
- Clear, plain written English. Most of your first impressions will be made in writing, and charity audiences respond badly to hype.
- Comfortable with structure and discipline: sequences, activity cadence, CRM hygiene.
- Interest in the nonprofit sector and a genuine curiosity about how charities raise money — direct mail, regular giving, digital, major gifts.
- Familiarity with nonprofit CRM platforms (e.g. Raiser’s Edge, Salesforce NPSP, Blackbaud, Microsoft Dynamics) is useful but not required.
- Experience with HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a plus.
SOFT SKILLS & QUALITIES THAT MAKE A GREAT CANDIDATE
- High Agency - you don’t wait to be told what to do. You see broken things and fix them.
- Hustle - you stay in the fight when things get hard.
- AI-First mindset - you use every tool at your disposal to move faster and think bigger.
- Cares about the Mission - you genuinely care about helping nonprofits raise more money to change the world.
CONTRACT DETAILS
Contract type:
Permanent, full-time. Employed by Dataro Limited (UK).
Start date:
1 November 2026.
Location:
United Kingdom. The role is remote, with occasional travel to London for team meetings and to in-person client or sector events as needed.
Salary Range:
£37,000-£40,000 base salary based on location and experience, plus commission
