jobs.ashbyhq.com/depot/c303bf37-ee14-459.description_excerpt:
Depot helps software teams build faster and spend less time waiting. The platform spans Depot CI, remote container builds, GitHub Actions runners, remote cache, registry, APIs, SDKs, and the CLI. Across all of it, our job is to make hard infrastructure feel fast, dependable, and easy for developers.
We’re looking for a Staff Engineer who can work across the whole product. You might redesign onboarding, shape an API, change a CLI command, improve logs and errors, simplify billing or permissions, or debug a production issue with support at your side. The common thread is turning messy customer pain into crisp product and technical work.
This is a high-ownership role on a small team. You’ll help decide what to build, make tradeoffs explicit, write the technical plan, build important pieces yourself, bring teammates along, and measure whether the work made customers faster or less blocked.
We care as much about how you work as what you know. You should listen well, write clearly, handle disagreement without creating drag, and build trust through judgment and follow-through. Direct experience with our exact stack helps, but it is not the bar. We care more about learning deeply and shipping thoughtful work.
Please note: Depot is remote-only. For this role we can currently support hiring within North America and Europe.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
- Own product work across the web console, APIs, CLI, GitHub integrations, billing and usage, permissions, docs, and internal tools.
- Turn ambiguous customer pain into clear product and technical plans, then carry them through design, implementation, rollout, and measurement.
- Improve developer-facing workflows for CI, container builds, cache, registry, runners, setup, logs, errors, and integrations.
- Design APIs and data models that are consistent, understandable, and safe to evolve.
- Debug production issues across services, databases, AWS infrastructure, integrations, and customer environments.
- Raise the engineering bar through design docs, code review, mentorship, and calm technical leadership.
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
- Staff-level product engineering judgment across backend behavior, API shape, data model, UI flow, and operational reality.
- Experience owning meaningful projects from ambiguity to production, including sequencing, tradeoffs, rollout, and follow-through.
- Strong technical depth in backend, full-stack, platform, infrastructure, or developer-tooling systems.
- Excellent debugging instincts across application code, APIs, databases, background jobs, cloud infrastructure, observability, and third-party integrations.
- Developer empathy for clear APIs, intuitive CLIs, useful docs, actionable errors, and workflows that feel fast and trustworthy.
- High emotional intelligence: you communicate clearly, handle disagreement constructively, and help a remote team make better decisions.
Typically this comes from 7+ years of production engineering experience, or equivalent depth in product, platform, infrastructure, or developer tools. Helpful background includes CI systems, GitHub Actions, build tooling, Docker/BuildKit, remote caching, auth/SSO, billing, or observability.
Direct experience with our specific stack is a bonus, but not required: TypeScript, Go, React, protobuf/gRPC-style APIs, MySQL/PlanetScale, ClickHouse, AWS, and OpenTelemetry.
HOW WE WORK
Depot is fully remote and distributed across the US, Canada, and Europe. We rely on clear writing, async collaboration, and people who can create clarity without waiting for perfect instructions.
We are a small team trying to do unusually ambitious work. Ownership matters here: you make choices, own outcomes, and share what you learn when those choices work or do not.
Work is not family. We care about excellent work and meeting commitments, and we also expect people to have real lives outside of Depot.
We make decisions with customer context and data. Strong opinions are useful; clear evidence and good judgment are better.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Depot is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates from different backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every bullet. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the interview process, let us know.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/distance/a2a8c151-9bdb-.description_excerpt:
We're looking for a Product Integration Engineer to develop and prove out our products with military customers, starting with the Field Operator HUD (FOH): a head-mounted, always-on visual intelligence system built from Distance hardware, a HUD operating system and AI-assisted data processing that pulls sensor, feeds and command-and-control into the operator's field of view. Your job is to make it work on a specific customer's platform, in the field, not just on a bench, as part of our core R&D team. If you're a hands-on generalist who knows VR or XR and would rather be where the tech meets the user than stuck at a desk, this one's for you.
WHY DISTANCE?
At Distance Technologies, the problem we're solving is simple to state and hard to solve: the amount of data in the world is endless, but human capacity is not. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics.
There are 60 of us today, with decades-long experience building world's best products, optics, and open-source operating systems. We partner and build with globally leading companies like KIA https://distance.tech/news/distance-announces-collaboration-with-kia-integrating-new-panoramic-lightfield-hud-into-the-kia-vision-meta-turismo-concept-car, Supacat https://distance.tech/news/supacat-and-distance-technologies-sign-framework-agreement-to-enable-aerospace-grade-hud-capability-across-the-entire-supacat-hmt-ground-vehicle-platform, and Galvion https://distance.tech/news/galvion-and-distance-collaborate-on-advanced-helmet-systems-with-distances-computational-optics-and-acuity-os, and we were Google Ventures' first investment in Finland.
THE ROLE
The FOH is already in field trials with military users. Your first project is getting it working with British Army equipment and defence primes, building the integration around what the customer actually needs. As our product line grows you'll take on a widening set of customer integrations across our defence work, each one a different platform, stack and set of interfaces.
Your core responsibilities include:
- Owning customer integrations end to end. Make the FOH work inside a customer's platform: adapt the software, wire it into their sensors, displays, video and connectivity, and get it demo- and trial-ready. Prototype fast in dedicated environments to prove value with a client before it hits the shared codebase.
- Being Distance in the field. Join demos, trials and exercises with defence clients, support on-site deployments when needed, and bring back what you see and hear on real kit.
- Bridging the field and the core. Turn what customers need into concrete integration work with the R&D and commercial teams, spot what should become shared product capability, and feed it into the roadmap and, eventually, the shared codebase.
You won't be a satellite. You'll join the software standups and reviews and be a real part of R&D.
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU
- Your work ships and gets used. What you integrate goes into real kit already in trials with military users, and what you learn from demos, trials and exercises with them feeds straight back into the product.
- You own the whole thread. From first prototype to working integration in the field, it's yours, not passed between five teams.
- New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs.
- A small team backed to move fast. Around 60 of us, Google Ventures' first investment in Finland, and flat enough that your calls count.
OUR EXPECTATIONS
What we're looking for:
- A builder, not a passenger: a hands-on self-starter who takes ownership, works things out when docs are missing, and would rather be with a customer or in the field than at a desk.
- At least a couple of years of software engineering experience with VR or XR, plus generalist instincts.
- Comfort across a mixed software stack. You've worked with some of C++, Unity and embedded, and you pick up the rest quickly.
- Some exposure to electrical integration or software-to-hardware interfaces. We're not expecting deep hardware experience on top of strong software.
- You're at home in prototype and integration work: incomplete docs, customer-specific stacks, messy interfaces.
- Good with clients, and happy to be the person representing Distance at a demo or trial.
- Willing to travel within the UK when needed, and to Finland now and then.
It's a bonus, though not required, if you've worked with HMDs, wearable displays or spatial computing, know C++ for integration and application development, can stand up a UI or application stack for quick situational-awareness or demo prototypes, are comfortable with embedded or Linux at integration level, or have seen sensor, display and video interfaces at system level.
You'll be based within commuting distance of the Bath office and in the office two to three days a week. Our working language is English.
DID WE GET YOU INTERESTED?
Apply via the application form. Our recruitment process includes 2-3 discussions with the team. If you want to learn more about the position, reach out to our recruiter, Joel Kinnunen, at joel@distance.tech. Kindly note that, for data privacy reasons, we are not able to process applications sent via email.
We process your application data only for this recruitment and in line with applicable data privacy law.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/dotfile/c23de5cc-231f-4.description_excerpt:
ABOUT DOTFILE
Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.
Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.
Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.
We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.
ROLE OVERVIEW
We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Account Executive (AE) to join our Sales Team. The ideal candidate has experience selling to the financial services industry, a strong understanding of AML, KYC/B, or Risk Management, and a track record of working with a proven sales playbook.
As one of the early sales hires, you will play a key role in shaping our go-to-market (GTM) strategy while actively engaging, nurturing, and closing opportunities across the EMEA region and beyond.
The position is based in Paris or London.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Help the company meet its growth targets by identifying, engaging, nurturing and successfully closing deals with new high-profile clients
- Deliver compelling outbound Pipeline Generation strategies into your territory
- Work with Solutions Engineering to tailor demos and demonstrate how we solve customers business pains
- Collaborate with BDRs and Marketing on outbound and inbound lead generation efforts
- Participate in the continuous optimization of our Sales playbook and processes, from enablement to reporting and tooling
- Liaise with our Customer Operations team to ensure smooth integration and roll-out, contribute to ongoing client satisfaction’s efforts
ABOUT YOU
- You have at least 2 years of experience in a similar role, in Fintech, Regtech or within a fast growing tech company selling in into Fintech, Crypto companies and Financial institutions
- You have experience operating according to a proven sales playbook (Meddpicc, Command of the message…)
- You have experience in Mid-market and Enterprise SaaS sales with a consistent track record of exceeding quota and revenue goals
- You have experience closing deals in several markets in EMEA and abroad. You have native-level english proficiency.
- You have strong Technical and Business acumen and are comfortable discussing both high-level integration scenarios and positive business outcomes at C-level
- You have great interpersonal skills, you can collaborate with individuals across various personality types and organisational levels, fostering productive relationships
- You are detail-oriented and have outstanding written and oral communication skills
- No task is below you and you have a strong sense of personal accountability and ownership
- You are result driven - because this is what matters in the end
- You are a collaborative team player, but also able to work independently and take ownership of your work.
THE INTERVIEW PROCESS
- Round 1: First conversation to get to know you, understand what drives you, and explore why this role excites you.
- Round 2: Two-part discussion where you'll walk us through your career journey and the choices that shaped it, followed by a values-based conversation where you'll share real examples of how you demonstrate Ownership, Pace & Intensity, High Standards, and Resilience.
- Round 3: Deep dive into one of your key projects with someone from a different team, offering a fresh, cross-functional perspective on how you work.
- Round 4: Practical exercise, case study tailored to the role, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills on a real-world challenge.
- Round 5: Final conversation with our founders to discuss your long-term vision and explore how you see yourself growing with us.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/docplanner/7f81c616-85f.description_excerpt:
ABOUT DOCPLANNER AND NOA
Docplanner is a global healthcare platform connecting more than 300,000 doctors with approximately 100 million patients every month across 13 markets.
Within Docplanner, Noa is on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. We build AI that works alongside doctors to:
- Remove their administrative work.
- Help them make better decisions and handle repeatable cases, so they can spend their time where it matters most.
- Help patients navigate healthcare using their medical history as personalized context.
We're already in doctors' hands: Noa Notes takes documentation off their plates, while Noa Evidence brings trustworthy medical evidence to the point of care.
The next frontier is the hardest—and the most valuable: helping doctors, and eventually patients, make decisions while our AI safely takes on repeatable clinical work. That's where a doctor's judgment has to live inside the product itself. That's this role.
ABOUT THE ROLE
You’ll help take Noa from writing notes and providing evidence to helping doctors decide—ensuring what we build fits clinical workflows and earns doctors’ trust.
This isn’t a traditional CMO, advisory or regulatory role. It is a hands-on, individual-contributor clinical-product role. You will:
- Shape doctor-facing products by bringing real clinical needs and workflows into product decisions.
- Bring clinical judgment to what we build, including what is correct, useful and safe.
Because you’re a doctor yourself, you can talk to our users peer-to-peer and get the honest answers a survey never will. As our first dedicated clinical hire on the product, you’ll help establish how clinical expertise informs Docplanner’s AI products.
You’ll work day-to-day with Product, AI, Design, Engineering, Regulatory and our doctor network.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
SHAPE WHAT WE BUILD
- Bring how doctors really work—their habits, workflows and administrative realities—into the product.
- Talk to doctors across specialties and working styles, and turn candid feedback into product decisions.
- Partner with Product, Design and Engineering to prioritise and ship improvements, then learn from how doctors use them.
BRING CLINICAL JUDGMENT INTO THE PRODUCT
- Help define what correct, useful and safe looks like for our doctor-facing AI products.
- Review prompts, outputs, clinical templates and workflows, and identify clinically meaningful failure modes.
- Turn clinician feedback and evaluation findings into product and model improvements with Product, ML/LLM and evaluation partners.
KEEP IT SAFE AND SCALABLE
- Work with Product, ML/LLM, Regulatory and the PRRC to align product intent, evidence, risks and controls.
- Build practical feedback loops with practising clinicians and our consultant-doctor network.
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
- A medical degree and at least 2 years of direct clinical practice. Active licensure and current practice are not required.
- Meaningful experience shaping and shipping a doctor-facing or clinical product, either as a clinical product leader or a clinician-founder/builder.
- You personally owned product decisions, worked directly with Product, Design and Engineering, and shipped something clinicians used.
- You’ve turned clinical problems into product decisions—not just provided advice, review or governance.
- You combine strong clinical judgment with doctor discovery, workflow understanding and a focus on trust and adoption.
- You communicate clearly and directly across clinical, product, technical, regulatory and leadership teams.
- You’re comfortable operating independently as a senior, hands-on contributor in a lean cross-functional team.
- You actively use generative AI and understand its potential and limitations. Hands-on experience with prompting, output review or AI-assisted development tools is valuable.
Bonus: Experience with ambient documentation, clinical templates, medical-knowledge systems, clinical coding or regulated Software as a Medical Device.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AFTER 6 MONTHS
- A clear, evidence-backed view of the priority doctor workflows and product opportunities Noa should address.
- Product improvements shipped based on doctor discovery, feedback and observed usage.
- Clear clinical quality expectations and feedback loops established with Product, ML/LLM and evaluation partners.
WHY JOIN NOA AT DOCPLANNER
- Real impact at real scale: Your work reaches hundreds of thousands of doctors and their patients.
- Shape what comes next: You’ll influence what Noa and Docplanner’s AI products become—and whether doctors and patients trust them.
- Ship to learn: A feature in front of users beats another month of planning.
- Work flexibly: The role is 100% remote across eligible European locations, subject to local hiring arrangements.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/comand-ai/92db24af-c0d9.description_excerpt:
WHO WE ARE
Comand AI is building a global technology leader focused on defense & security. The company was co-founded in 2023 by Loïc Mougeolle, Marie Inuzuka and Quentin Le Pape, drawing from their unique experience at defense industry leaders and world-class tech companies.
The world of defense & security are being entirely renewed by AI and robotisation: new classes of threats, new levels of autonomy and speed demands radically new solutions to protect our societies. Comand AI is at the forefront of the rebuilding of these verticals to serve our countries resilience.
Comand AI core product is a next generation command and control software platform, which allows militaries to operate at machine speed in a communication and GNSS denied context. A few facts to anchor you:
- €45M raised from seed to Series A, Blossom Capital leading the series A and Saab as a strategic investor
- Software platform combat proven and deployed in Ukraine
- A lean team of operators with backgrounds from Palantir, OpenAI and world-class tech experience, alongside unique expertise from the defense sector
- Live business with governments and defense industry leaders across Europe
- Paris (HQ), London, Munich and Kyiv subsidiaries
THE ROLE
We are fully indexed on the success of every user, the interfaces you ship support live operations.
You'd join the product development team as a front-end specialist, working closely with product design and engineering. You take an operational problem, explore it, come back with proposals, and iterate. Delivering a clear, fast and dependable user experience is critical to the person using it.
What this looks like in practice:
- Own front-end delivery on Prevail, our operational planning platform, from interaction design through production
- Build interfaces for real geospatial problems: interactive maps, multiple data layers, large datasets, and time-sensitive workflows well beyond a typical CRUD application
- Work with product and design early, turning operational needs into clear flows and production-ready experiences
- Raise the front-end quality bar across the team by reviewing and improving work from engineers with different specialities, including AI-assisted code
- Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed and durability, especially when a high-stakes demo or deployment creates a short deadline
- Help create reusable patterns that make the product more coherent as the team and surface area grow
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
We filter hardest on mission drive, low ego, attention to detail, and resilience under pressure. We want someone who cares about front-end engineering as a craft and can still move quickly when the problem is ambiguous.
Must-have:
- Strong production experience with React and TypeScript, with front-end engineering as a core part of your craft
- A track record of owning complex interfaces from problem definition through release and iteration
- Strong product and design judgement: you notice weak hierarchy, inconsistent interactions, and confusing states before a specification points them out
- Pragmatism and low ego: you can improve rough work from other engineers without turning every implementation choice into a philosophical debate
- Comfort with ambiguity and changing priorities, while keeping the quality of what ships high
- EU or UK citizenship (contractual requirement tied to our defence contracts)
Nice to have:
- Experience with mapping, cartographic, GIS, or other geospatial applications
- Front-end performance work involving large or real-time datasets
- Experience building offline-capable or resource-constrained web applications
- Experience creating or scaling a design system
- Prior work in defence, government, or dual-use technology
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU
- A top 0.1% European compensation package, including base salary and equity
- Paris or London based
THE PROCESS
1. Talent screening: 30 min, online. We cover your background, motivations, and what you want to own next.
2. Front-end interview: 60 min, online. We assess React and TypeScript fundamentals, product judgement, and how you reason through an unfamiliar interface problem.
3. Onsite in Paris: half day. You see the product, present a project you are proud of, and work through a front-end design and re-engineering exercise based on a realistic product problem.
4. Roundtable: hiring committee reviews the full set of evidence and makes the final decision.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/escape/186fdb2d-7c0a-46.description_excerpt:
ABOUT ESCAPE
Escape secures the code-to-cloud attack surface. Our platform maps every asset a company actually exposes to the internet including undocumented APIs and endpoints then tests them continuously. We run automated AI penetration testing and DAST at the pace that engineering teams ship code, not just once a year for auditors.
We’re 45+ people based in Paris, Amsterdam, Hawaii, Boston, New York, Series A funded, and rapidly growing.

Escape has growing customer demand and inbound interest in the Nordics and UK with an already existing client base.
This is a first-in-region role with full ownership. You’ll be responsible for end-to-end sales, your own pipeline, building a territory plan, and shaping how we go to market in these regions. Successful approaches will directly influence our future playbook working in autonomy, direct impact, and shaping our approach.
THE ROLE
You’ll own the full sales cycle, from first contact to signature, selling to technical buyers CISOs, Heads of AppSec, Security Engineers, and platform leaders. These stakeholders have deep expertise, strong preferences, and often existing tools, and will challenge you on how things work.
While you’ll partner closely with Sales Engineers for POCs and technical validation and have direct access to founders and the product team you’ll need to confidently handle first conversations and independently build most of your pipeline.
WHAT YOU BRING
- Proven cybersecurity sales experience, you’ve sold real security products to real security teams.
- Closed complex enterprise deals: six-figure ACVs with long cycles, buying committees, procurement, legal, you’ve managed deals through stalls and restarts.
- Demonstrated ability to build pipeline from scratch via successful cold outbound.
- Track record of meeting/exceeding quota ready to discuss your targets and results.
- Fluent English plus either native/fluent Swedish or deep UK market expertise.
- Eligible to work in Sweden or the UK (required). We don't do VISA sponsorship.
Bonus points for:
- Experience with AppSec or developer tooling
- Being the first AE in a new market
- Knowledge of structured selling methods (e.g., MEDDIC)
- Experience with partner-led sales
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
First 3 Months:
- Confidently demo the product solo and explain our differentiators
- Deep knowledge of ICP, competitors, and security buying cycles in your region
- Own and move existing opportunities in the pipeline
- Write a territory plan: key accounts, segments, priorities
- Launch consistent outbound and generate your first qualified opportunities
3–6 Months:
- Independently run end-to-end deals
- Deliver your first closed-won accounts in-region, including at least one sourced cold
- Pipeline at 3x forward quota with reliable forecasting and CRM hygiene
- Bring valuable market insights: why buying cycles start, recurring objections, who we’re losing to and why
- Strong collaborative rhythm established with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product with your feedback driving change
6–12 Months:
- Consistently hit quota with a scalable pipeline
- Recognized as the point owner for Nordics/UK; you set the direction, we support it
- Documented playbook new AEs can ramp using your processes
- See expansion, multi-year deals, reference customers, and case studies
- Help hire and onboard additional AEs for the region
WHAT WE OFFER
- Competitive base salary with uncapped commission [OTE, currency, split provided during interviews]
- [Equity Package]
- Remote-first, with regular trips to Paris and company offsites
- Local benefits via Deel EOR
- Full autonomy and genuine ownership in a high-impact role, with direct access to founders who value your input
HIRING PROCESS
- 30 min intro call with People & Talent
- 30 min sales deep dive with our Head of Growth
- 60 min sales simulation (“Sell Escape back to us”) with an AE and Sales Engineer
- 45 min conversation with the founders
- References check, then offer
Total process: 2–3 weeks. We’ll keep you informed throughout.
Escape is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/everis/e2d50171-6baa-4b.description_excerpt:
Job title: Deal Origination Analyst — Broker & Owner Sourcing
Location: 100% remote; candidates must be based in the United Kingdom, United States, or Canada and available during North American business hours
Employment: Full-time
Salary: US$70,000–$85,000 base salary, plus an annual performance bonus of up to US$15,000, depending on ability and experience.
Everis is hiring an early-career analyst to build the pipeline of businesses we may acquire. You will research markets and companies, build relationships with brokers, contact owners, qualify opportunities, do initial analysis, and hand the strongest deals to our acquisition team with clear notes.
This is a sourcing and relationship role, not a traditional investment-banking role. Your main responsibility is high-quality deal flow. You will see evaluation, diligence, and transactions, but the deal team owns complex modelling, diligence, negotiation, and execution.
WHY JOIN EVERIS
- Work directly on acquisition strategy and see how a lead becomes a serious opportunity.
- Speak with brokers, advisers, founders, and owners while learning what makes a business attractive and why owners sell.
- Research varied industries, use modern AI and sourcing tools, take ownership quickly, and grow into broader acquisition responsibilities.
ABOUT EVERIS
Everis is a software holding company with $27 million in annual recurring revenue. We buy B2B SaaS companies from the founders who built them and keep them permanently. We invest our own capital and operate without the pressure of a fund exit timeline. Our remote team strengthens engineering and product, pricing, go-to-market, retention, revenue operations, and back-office systems across the portfolio.
WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
BROKER AND INTERMEDIARY RELATIONSHIPS
- Find and build relationships with relevant brokers, advisers, marketplaces, and other deal sources.
- Stay in regular contact, understand what they have coming to market, and follow up consistently.
- Screen brokered and marketplace opportunities against Everis’s criteria and surface the strongest ones quickly.
OWNER SOURCING AND OUTREACH
- Build targeted lists of businesses and owners that may fit our criteria.
- Find and verify decision-maker contacts, then run thoughtful outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn, referrals, and other relevant channels.
- Hold initial conversations, understand each owner’s goals, and follow up professionally over what may be a long cycle.
RESEARCH AND QUALIFICATION
- Understand what each business does, how it makes money, who its customers are, and what makes it defensible.
- Gather high-level information on revenue, profit, growth, recurring revenue, customer concentration, owner involvement, asking price, sale motivation, and timing.
- Assess fit, prepare short opportunity briefs and notes, and coordinate a clean handoff to the deal team.
PIPELINE OWNERSHIP AND IMPROVEMENT
- Keep the acquisition CRM accurate, including contacts, source, stage, notes, next action, financial snippets, risks, and follow-up dates.
- Track outreach, responses, meetings, qualified opportunities, handoffs, and funnel progression. Provide concise weekly reporting.
- Use evidence and AI tools to improve research, outreach, recordkeeping, and the sourcing methods that produce the best opportunities.
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
- Evidence of exceptional ability through one specific, verifiable accomplishment with unusual difficulty, selectivity, or impact—and a clear explanation of what you personally contributed.
- Alternatively, direct or transferable acquisition experience that includes analysing acquisition targets, judging their attractiveness, and engaging or negotiating with owners, founders, brokers, or advisers. Investment-analyst experience is relevant when it demonstrates these capabilities; explicit SaaS or mobile-app experience is preferred but not required.
- Strong research and commercial judgment, with the ability to understand unfamiliar businesses and communicate credibly with brokers, advisers, owners, and founders. You are smart, curious, and able to learn quickly.
- Excellent spoken and written communication. You are comfortable making cold calls, sending outbound messages, hearing no, and following up consistently without relying on finance jargon.
- Highly organized, reliable, proactive, and resilient. You maintain accurate notes, follow through on commitments, handle confidential information with integrity, and work effectively without constant supervision.
- Comfortable using spreadsheets, CRM systems, research databases, and AI tools, with basic financial and commercial literacy or the ability to learn quickly.
This role is designed for candidates with zero to three years of professional experience. Prior acquisition or sales experience is not required when a candidate demonstrates exceptional ability. Lack of explicit SaaS or mobile-app experience is not disqualifying when transferable acquisition analysis, target judgment, and owner, founder, or broker engagement are clear. Generic sales results, outreach volume, list building, financial modelling, credentials, or employer prestige do not establish a strong match on their own.
WHAT WE OFFER
- US$70,000–$85,000 base salary plus an annual performance bonus of up to US$15,000.
- 100% remote work from the United Kingdom, United States, or Canada.
- Direct exposure to founders, brokers, owners, and real acquisition opportunities.
- Meaningful responsibility early, with a path into senior deal origination, acquisitions, or broader operating work.
If you want to learn how great businesses are found and directly help build Everis’s acquisition pipeline, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/frontier-health/665f23d.description_excerpt:

Frontier Health is building the system of action for healthcare: end-to-end AI co-workers that perform administrative jobs.
Healthcare has an administrative crisis breaking patient care — the WHO predicts a 10 million person workforce shortfall by 2030. Administrative staff are the invisible machinery powering healthcare systems, yet they're over capacity, under-resourced, and underfunded. Care coordination runs on shadow IT: spreadsheets, paper notes, phone calls, and outdated technology.
Frontier's AI co-workers fast-track the admin behind care decisions, designed to slot into the teams, processes, and tools already in place. Founded 18 months ago, we've experience deploying to over 40 hospitals. The team comes from Palantir, Google DeepMind, and Apple. We've raised $16M and were recently valued at $60M, backed by Tier One UK and international investors.
We’re an in person Company, valuing being in the office (Farringdon/Chancery Lane) 5 days a week, or onsite with the customer (as required). We’re also flat, valuing ownership and impact of hierarchy, process and structure. You’ll be collaborating with people across engineering and business functions, with functional leadership, where required, and close and regular touchpoints with the CEO.
Values
- Outcome Orientation — we focus on results and delivering value to customers
- Grit — we stick with hard problems and see them through
- Kindness — we presume best intentions and treat each other with respect
- Bias to Action — we prioritise forward momentum and proactive problem-solving
Who we're looking for
You care deeply about fixing healthcare and can empathise with administrators who are stressed and under-resourced. You take ownership — not just of your work, but of anything broken that you spot. You're honest about mistakes and use them to do better. You embrace challenges as opportunities to grow.
The Role
You'll own end-to-end delivery of AI workflows across the full stack — taking ambiguous, non- technical requirements and shipping world-class product that solves real problems for healthcare administrators. You'll work directly with customers and the product team, bringing back what you learn in the field to improve the core product.
What success looks like
- You ship high-quality product quickly and fix things you spot that are broken, from day one
- You proactively identify what's needed, not just what's assigned — and act on it
- You gather customer insight that directly translates into improvements in the core product
- You raise the bar on engineering quality and velocity, and contribute positively to the team's culture
- You solicit feedback and constantly strive to learn and grow
Good-to-know information
- Tech stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript (TypeScript + React), Postgres
What we offer
- Visa sponsorship: we are able to sponsor visas if required.
- Benefits: Health Insurance, Pension, Monthly Team Socials, Enhanced Parental Leave, Snacks
- Holiday: 25 days holiday + UK bank holidays
- Expectations: we work from the office (Farringdon/Chancery Lane), or customer site (as needed) 5 days a week.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/filigran/078b3281-6e64-.description_excerpt:
🌀 THE COMPANY
Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.
Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/iambic-therapeutics/123.description_excerpt:
JOB SUMMARY
We are seeking a Machine Learning Scientist to join the Enchant team at Iambic Therapeutics. Our mission is to deliver better medicines through innovation in AI-based discovery technologies. In this role, you will research and develop post-training methods for Enchant - our multimodal transformer model trained on a wide variety of biomedical data - pushing the boundaries of what large-scale foundation models can achieve in drug discovery.
The role centers on designing and evaluating post-training approaches for large multimodal language models including supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, preference or reward-based optimization, and other emerging post-training methods. You will develop rigorous evaluations and training infrastructure that make it possible to rapidly iterate on these approaches at scale and work closely with colleagues across machine learning, software engineering, and drug discovery to put powerful foundation models into the hands of scientists making real therapeutic decisions.
We are hiring across multiple levels and welcome candidates ranging from recent PhD graduates to experienced researchers with a strong publication or deployment record. This is a remote position, with the option to be on-site in our Bristol office.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Research and develop post-training strategies for large-scale multimodal foundation models
- Design reward functions, training objectives, data-generation strategies, and evaluation protocols for reinforcement learning and other post-training approaches applied to multimodal LLMs
- Build systematic experimentation and hyperparameter optimization workflows to efficiently explore post-training recipes, model configurations, and training strategies
- Develop and apply inference optimization techniques to support deployment in both high-throughput model evaluation and interactive discovery workflows
- Design and maintain rigorous benchmarking and evaluation frameworks that measure model quality across modalities, downstream tasks, and scientific use cases
- Collaborate with ML and software engineering colleagues to productionize models, evaluation systems, and inference services
- Partner with computational chemists, medicinal chemists, and biologists to ensure model development and post-training objectives are grounded in drug discovery needs
- Communicate results to internal teams, external partners, and at conferences
- Write high-quality research and engineering code: refactor, test, document, and package ML components to support team velocity
QUALIFICATIONS
- PhD in machine learning, computer science, computational chemistry, physics, or a related computational STEM field, or equivalent industry experience demonstrating comparable depth
- Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including implementing, training, debugging and evaluating deep learning models end-to-end
- Demonstrated experience training large-scale transformer models
- Demonstrated experience in one or more of the following:
- Reinforcement learning approaches such as RLHF, RLAIF, PPO, GRPO, RL with verifiable rewards, or related methods (strongly preferred)
- Supervised fine-tuning, full-parameter fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA), or related methods
- Systematic hyperparameter optimization or large-scale experimentation using tools such as Optuna, Ray Tune, or similar frameworks
- Strong engineering practices: reproducible experimentation, clean code, testing, and performance-aware debugging
- Comfort with modern ML infrastructure (e.g., Docker, CUDA, Kubernetes, experiment tracking tools such as Weights & Biases)
PREFERRED
- Experience with multimodal or multi-task model architectures
- Training and inference optimization (e.g., mixed precision, kernel optimization, quantization, distributed strategies)
- Familiarity with biomedical, chemical, or biological data domains
- Distributed training at scale
- HPC or large-scale training operations experience
ABOUT IAMBIC THERAPEUTICS
Iambic is a clinical-stage life-science and technology company developing novel medicines using its AI-driven discovery and development platform. Based in San Diego and founded in 2020, Iambic has assembled a world-class team that unites pioneering AI experts and experienced drug hunters. The Iambic platform has demonstrated delivery of new drug candidates to human clinical trials with unprecedented speed and across multiple target classes and mechanisms of action. Iambic is advancing a pipeline of potential best-in-class and first-in-class clinical assets, both internally and in partnership, to address urgent unmet patient need. Learn more about the Iambic team, platform, pipeline, and partnerships at iambic.ai http://iambic.ai.
MISSION & CORE VALUES
Our mission is to deliver better medicines through innovations in AI-based discovery technologies. The culture and work at Iambic Therapeutics are profoundly strengthened by the diversity of our people and our differences in background, culture, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, and life experiences. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where a diverse group of talented humans work together to discover therapeutics and create technologies.
PAY AND BENEFITS
We offer a competitive compensation package, private medical insurance, life assurance, pension contributions, and flexible holiday allowances to our team. Our UK office provides a modern and collaborative work environment, right in the centre of Bristol.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/junction/634c5cb8-e98b-.description_excerpt:
Healthcare is in crisis and the people behind the results deserve better. With more and more data coming from wearables, lab tests, and patient–doctor interactions, we’re entering an era where data is abundant.
Junction is building the infrastructure layer for diagnostic healthcare, making patient data accessible, actionable, and automated across labs and devices. Our mission is simple but ambitious: use health data to unlock unprecedented insight into human health and disease.
If you're passionate about how technology can supercharge healthcare, you’ll fit right in.
Backed by Creandum, Point Nine, 20VC, YC, and leading angels, we’re working to solve one of the biggest challenges of our time: making healthcare personalized, proactive, and affordable. We’re already connecting millions and scaling fast.
SHORT ON TIME?
- You: You’ve led experienced engineers, stayed close to the code, and care about the product and the customers using it.
- Ownership / Focus: You’ll lead a small and growing engineering team, you’ll own its engineering direction, technical delivery, team health and hiring.
- How we manage: We don’t believe in purely pastoral engineering managers. You’ll manage and develop people, but you’ll also ship, unblock, review and make technical decisions alongside them.
- Salary: £120-£150k + equity (based on experience and location)
- Location: Fully remote (GMT). We have one company offsite each year, with possible travel to London every couple of months for team meet-ups.
WHY WE NEED YOU
Our engineering team is growing, and we need another Engineering Manager to grow with it. You’ll report to Mark, our Head of Engineering, and work alongside Rui, our other Engineering Manager. You’ll initially take ownership of a small engineering team, working closely with product and other teams to decide what to build and get it shipped.
At Junction, engineering management is a technical job. We want our managers close enough to the work to know what’s going on, give good feedback and get involved when needed. But we don’t want you to become the person everyone waits for when something gets difficult.
Six months in, your team should trust you, people outside the team should know where things stand, and the team should be delivering what it says it will.
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY
- Own the engineering direction, delivery and health of a small team of senior product engineers.
- Work with product on what the team commits to, then make sure it gets delivered.
- Stay close to the code: review PRs, give technical feedback, pair on problems and ship when it makes sense.
- Unblock the team when decisions are unclear or things go wrong.
- Give engineers regular feedback, run useful 1:1s and performance reviews, and actively help them grow in their careers.
- Notice what’s slowing the team down and fix it, surface problems early and keep the rest of the company clear on what’s happening.
- Own hiring for your team and play an active role in helping Junction grow.
REQUIREMENTS
- You’ve led and directly managed experienced software engineers.
- You’ve stayed technically involved while managing
- You’ve owned a team’s delivery, not just its people management.
- You can give useful technical feedback and make sound calls on engineering trade-offs.
- You’ve worked with product and other teams to turn customer problems into shipped software.
- You’ve helped engineers develop through direct feedback, coaching and meaningful opportunities to take on more.
- You’ve hired engineers and helped raise the technical or operating standards of a team.
You don’t need to tick every box to fit in here. If the problems we’re solving genuinely interest you and you know you can contribute, we’d love to talk.
NICE TO HAVE
- You’ve worked at an early-stage or scaling company where managers are expected to manage people and build product.
WHAT THIS ROLE ISN’T
- If you want to stay out of the code and spend most of your time in 1:1s, planning and status meetings, it won’t be a good fit.
- You’ll have to make tough calls on technical and non-technical topics and own the outcomes
- It isn’t a tech lead role with a few 1:1s either. Developing people, giving difficult feedback, hiring and building a healthy team are core parts of the job.
How you'll be compensated
- Your salary is dependent on your location and experience level
- Equity (extended exercise post 2 years of employment)
- Company and team offsites
- Monthly learning budget of $150 for personal development and productivity
- $100 monthly wellness budget
- Flexible, remote-first working, including $1K for home office equipment
- Coworking budget
- 36 days paid time off (including bank holidays)
- Premium healthcare coverage
- 4% monthly contribution to pension/401k
- Yearly blood test on us
- Enhanced parental, foster, and adoption leave
Important details before applying:
- We only hire folks physically based in GMT and EST timezones
- We do not sponsor visas right now given our stage

We specialize in delivering cutting-edge trading technology, unparalleled liquidity, and exceptional customer service. Our extensive range of financial products includes Forex, Metals, Shares, Indices, Commodities, and Cryptocurrency CFDs.
Join our thriving community of over 2 million clients across 100 countries, contributing to a daily trading volume exceeding US$ 35 billion. As a heavily regulated institution with oversight from 18+ financial regulators across 5 continents, and recipient of over 80 financial awards, MultiBank Group is devoted to innovation, excellence, and empowering our clients to achieve their financial goals.
Role Overview
We are seeking a Customer Support Specialist (Mandarin Speaker) to deliver responsive and professional support to clients across global markets. This role will primarily support Chinese-speaking clients during UK coverage hours and requires availability to work evening shifts.
Responsibilities
• Respond to client queries across live chat, email, and phone promptly and professionally.
• Provide support to Chinese-speaking clients across UK and Canada coverage hours.
• Deliver high-quality support during evening shift operations, ensuring service-level agreements and response-time targets are met.
• Support clients through account opening, verification, funding, and withdrawal processes.
• Help clients navigate MT4, MT5, and the MultiBank-Plus platform.

Requirements
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Fluency in Mandarin and English, both written and spoken. Cantonese is an advantage.
• A client-first attitude with patience, professionalism, and the ability to remain calm under pressure.
• Comfortable supporting clients across live chat, email, and phone.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in customer support within Forex, fintech, brokerage, online trading, or financial services.
• Familiarity with MT4, MT5, CRM systems, and ticketing platforms.
• Experience supporting Chinese-speaking clients in a regulated financial services environment.
Why Join Us?
- Work with one of the world’s leading financial derivatives institutions.
- Competitive salary plus performance-based incentives.
- Access to a dynamic, international, and fast-growing environment.
- Strong opportunities for career progression within a global financial group.
- Be part of a business committed to innovation, excellence, and long-term growth.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/mast/1b0d05ce-6bf6-4b41.description_excerpt:
Mast is on a mission to make complex lending simple. The UK's specialist lending market is underserved by technology, with legacy systems that can't handle the nuance of complex income, niche products, or the broker workflows that specialist lenders rely on.
We're building modern, cloud-native lending technology, purpose-built for specialist lenders, that helps them process more applications in less time, reach decisions faster, and deliver better experiences for brokers and borrowers.
We're pioneering the use of AI in mortgage origination, building it into the platform from the ground up rather than bolting it onto legacy architecture.. We work with regulated lenders across the UK, have a 100% delivery track record, and are building a high-performance team where everyone has real ownership and direct impact.
ABOUT THE ROLE
This is not a traditional support role, and you do not need any previous customer support or technology experience to apply.
This role is ideal for a recent graduate or someone early in their career who wants to get into tech. What matters most is your attitude: we are looking for someone curious, reliable, organised, eager to learn, and willing to get stuck in..
You will help lenders, brokers, and internal teams get the best out of Mast. You will answer questions, investigate issues, improve support processes, create documentation, spot recurring product friction, and turn customer conversations into ideas that shape the platform.
You'll report to the Head of Product and work closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, and Implementation. Over time, this role has the potential to grow into leading Mast's customer support function as the company scales.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Support customers and users
Triage, investigate, and manage support requests from start to finish, escalating to Product or Engineering where needed while keeping people informed.
You will build deep knowledge of Mast's platform, including mortgage journeys, forms, policy prompts, automations, integrations, product configuration, and broker/lender workflows.
Build the support operating system
Help design how support works at Mast: ticketing workflows, escalation routes, response templates, internal runbooks, help centre content, and reporting dashboards.
You will look for repetitive questions and manual processes, then automate them through better tooling, documentation, AI-assisted workflows, or process changes.
Turn support into product insight
Because this role reports into Product, you will do more than answer questions.
You will identify patterns in customer feedback, recurring pain points, confusing workflows, and missing features, then translate those into product ideas, bug reports, and roadmap input.
Create self-service documentation
Write clear, practical help articles, FAQs, release notes, troubleshooting guides, onboarding material, and internal playbooks.
You will help keep everything up to date as the platform evolves.
Use AI to work smarter
Use AI tools to draft documentation, summarise issues, identify patterns, write clearer responses, and speed up repetitive work.
You don't need to be an AI expert. We are looking for someone curious, experimental, and willing to learn.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
We are not looking for years of experience. We are looking for potential.
You may be a recent graduate or early in your career. You do not need previous customer support, fintech, mortgage, or software experience.
The most important things are that you:
- Have a great attitude and want to learn quickly
- Are reliable, thoughtful, and willing to take ownership
- Can work independently, spot what needs doing, and make progress without needing detailed instructions every time
- Communicate clearly and calmly in writing
- Are organised and detail-oriented, especially when managing several issues or follow-ups at once
- Are comfortable asking questions when something is unclear
- Enjoy solving problems and making things easier for others
- Are curious about technology, software, and AI
- Are comfortable working remotely and managing your own time
- Naturally ask, “How can this be easier next time?”
NICE TO HAVE
- Familiarity with tools like Notion, Slack, Linear, Jira, Zendesk, Intercom, HubSpot, Loom, Metabase, or AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude
- Experience from university projects, internships, part-time work, customer-facing roles, or startup environments
- Interest in product management, customer success, operations, automation, or fintech
- Experience writing clear documentation, guides, or process notes
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
First 3 months: Strong understanding of Mast's platform and customer workflows. Ownership of incoming support requests. Clearer processes for tracking and resolving issues.
6 to 12 months: Reduced repeat questions through better documentation and automation. A reliable feedback loop into Product. Clear visibility into where customers struggle and where the product can improve.
Longer term: You help define what excellent customer support looks like at Mast, and may grow into leading the support function.
SALARY & LOCATION
Location: London or UK Remote
Salary: £30,000 to £35,000 + Stock Options
Target Start date : Immediate
Benefits
- Stock Option Plan
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays
- 4 - 10 weeks work from anywhere, based on tenure (for UK based roles)
- Vitality Health insurance
- Pension plan
- Equipment budget
- Learning & development budget
- Cycle to Work Scheme
- Monthly team socials + Quarterly Team Meet-ups @ HQ
- Digital-first, employee-first company with a flexible working culture + Central London HQ
About Us
Mast is a high-performance team of engineers and lending experts building the future of specialist lending technology. We value radical honesty, transparency, and speed. We hire exceptional people, expect a lot from each other, and offer real ownership, fast growth, and the chance to shape an industry.
Mast. is an equal opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/molecule-software/f90a1.description_excerpt:
Enterprise Account Executive, Europe (Energy Trading Software)
Location: London, UK (preferred) · Hybrid
Department: Sales
Reports to: Head of Sales
Employment Type: Full-time
---
Molecule is hiring the quota-carrying Enterprise Account Executive who will own Europe. You'll start with live pipeline, a London-based Sales Engineer and BDR, flagship reference customers across Iberia, Italy and Southeast Europe, and a CEO who will be in the room on your biggest deals. Deals run €100K–€300K+ ARR. OTE is £200K–£240K, uncapped, plus equity. If you've closed enterprise deals with energy traders and want to write the regional playbook instead of just following one, read on.
About Molecule:
Molecule is the most modern cloud-native ETRM/CTRM (Energy Trading and Risk Management) platform on the market. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Houston, we serve 30+ enterprise customers from renewable energy producers and utilities to hedge funds and Fortune 100 companies, helping them capture trades, manage risk, and report P&L across power, gas, renewables, and 50+ other commodities. Our platform manages 500,000+ instruments representing nearly $100 billion in daily trade value.
We're building out our European presence to meet surging demand from power and renewables companies across the UK and Continental Europe. We already have flagship European customers (including multi-country renewable portfolios across Portugal, Spain, Italy, Greece, and Southeast Europe), and a recent win in South Africa, a new deregulated market. We need a proven closer to own the full sales cycle across the region.
The Role:
You'll be the primary quota-carrying sales executive for Molecule across Europe and South Africa. This is a hunter role with a defined territory and real pipeline already in motion, including active opportunities with European utilities, trading houses, and renewable energy companies.
This is a consultative, technically grounded sales role. Our most successful deals come from AEs who can sit across the table from a Head of Trading or Risk Manager and have a real conversation about PPA settlement mechanics, TSO connectivity, balancing cost optimization, or how a fund with seven SPVs needs entity separation in an ETRM. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be fluent enough to earn credibility with technical buyers and then orchestrate the right internal resources (solutions engineers, implementation leads, product specialists) to close complex deals.
You'll be as much an educator and trusted advisor as you are a seller, helping prospects build internal business cases, navigate procurement, and understand what a modern ETRM can do that their spreadsheets can't. The typical sales cycle is 6-9 months with multiple stakeholders, and patience and persistence matter as much as closing instinct.
What You'll Do:
- Own the full sales cycle for enterprise ETRM deals across Europe, from first meeting to signed contract, with typical deal sizes of €100K–€300K+ ARR
- Build and manage a qualified pipeline through a mix of inbound leads, conference networking, and targeted outreach. Our best European deals have originated from industry events (E-world, ETW), referrals from existing customers, and direct prospecting.
- Run discovery sessions that go deep on the prospect's trading workflows, pain points, and organizational structure, understanding whether they need front-to-back ETRM coverage or a phased approach starting with position management and P&L.
- Orchestrate demos and technical sessions alongside our Sales Engineer, ensuring each interaction is tailored to the prospect's specific commodities, market structures, and regulatory requirements.
- Navigate multi-stakeholder procurement processes involving traders, risk managers, middle office, IT, CFO, and C-suite, often building consensus across functions that have never purchased enterprise trading software before
- Act as the customer's advocate internally, flagging implementation complexity, product gaps, and realistic timelines. Our credibility with customers depends on honest scoping, not overselling.
- Develop territory plans and provide accurate, honest forecasting. We value pipeline quality over volume.
- Represent Molecule at European energy conferences and industry events, building relationships that may take months or years to convert.
- Contribute market intelligence back to Product: what European customers need, where the gaps are, what competitors are doing, and where regulatory changes (REMIT, EMIR, MiFID II) create opportunity
- Articulate Molecule's AI and technology differentiation (embedded LLM assistant, MCP server connectivity, API-first architecture) to technically sophisticated buyers who increasingly evaluate ETRM vendors on extensibility and innovation.
What Success Looks Like:
- First 90 days: You know our product, ideal customer profile and active European pipeline inside out. You've met our existing European customers and run discovery on [X] new opportunities with our Sales Engineer.
- By month 6: You've built €4M+ of qualified pipeline and closed or meaningfully advanced the deals you inherited.
- By month 12: You've delivered €750K+ in new ARR against your ramped first-year target, landed at least one new reference logo in a new market, and shaped the European playbook (ICP, messaging, event strategy).
What We're Looking For
Must-haves:
- 5+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with at least 2–3 years selling into energy and commodities markets (ETRM/CTRM, trading technology, energy SaaS, or adjacent fintech).
- Demonstrated track record of closing six-figure enterprise software deals with complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles (6-9+ months).
- Technical fluency in energy trading concepts. You should be able to discuss PPA structures, mark-to-market vs. realized P&L, power scheduling, renewable certificate markets, and European market structures (EEX, Nord Pool, EPEX) and the regulatory landscape (REMIT, EMIR, MiFID II basics) at a working level with trading professionals.
- Consultative selling approach with patience for long sales cycles, including comfort educating first-time ETRM buyers, building business cases collaboratively, and staying engaged with prospects who are 6–12 months from decision.
- Strong internal collaboration skills, with the ability to quarterback deals across solutions engineering, implementation, product, and executive leadership while keeping everyone aligned.
- Based in London or willing to relocate; ability to travel across Europe regularly (~30–40%), including Continental Europe and occasionally Southeast Europe/Nordics/South Africa.
- Fluency in English; additional European languages a strong plus (German, French, Portuguese, Spanish, or CEE languages particularly valuable).
Nice-to-haves:
- Direct experience selling ETRM, CTRM, or energy trading platforms (OpenLink/ION, Brady, Allegro, Orchestrade, Previse, Amphora)
- Existing relationships with energy trading…

jobs.ashbyhq.com/monumental/d94d53ea-be5.description_excerpt:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.
We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural.
You'll be part of our founding UK team - pilots and deployments are incoming, with facilities to follow. To get you started, we'll cover travel and accommodation for a few weeks of onboarding at Monumental HQ, in the city centre of Amsterdam. We have a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week.
Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision https://www.monumental.co/our-vision/ and company https://www.monumental.co/about/. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel https://www.youtube.com/@buildmonumental, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2-Q2F0Fcx4A, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOo8n19XEns.
About the role
We're looking for a Construction Robot Operator to introduce robots and automation to the construction industry in the UK, helping create affordable, beautiful, high-quality housing for everyone.
Over the last couple of years, we’ve grown our Amsterdam Operator team from 0 to 45. Many of these came from retail, hospitality and events. Some studied civil, mechanical or computer engineering and wanted to do something more practical with it. Others grew up on farms, or around workshops, and most are sporty. They all have one thing in common: they'd rather be hands-on outside than stuck behind a desk. If that sounds like you, you'll fit right in.
Given that this is a completely new role, we don’t expect any prior experience. What we're looking for is technical intuition, practicality, and an eye for detail, plus a bias for action: when something's going wrong, you take the initiative to work out what it is, and you're not afraid to get your hands dirty fixing it.
The role itself is unlike anything else in construction or tech. You'll travel to and from site, prep a build, place markers for 3D reconstruction, and operate our robots using Atrium, our in-house OS for onsite construction https://www.monumental.co/atrium. When something doesn't go to plan, you'll work with our R&D and operations teams, who manage and support every build remotely.
You'll be the face of Monumental on site. Our robots don't talk, so the general contractors, subcontractors, and trades you work alongside will talk to you instead. You'll spend most of your time building the housing, infrastructure, hospitals, and commercial spaces the UK needs. The rest of the time, you will be at our Hub, building test walls, learning how to service and maintain our robots, and prepping for your next deployment.
For more on how we think about the role, read Jip's post on his experience joining Monumental as a robot operator https://buildmonumental.substack.com/p/the-best-product-job-isnt-in-engineering. Expect a lot of driving: you'll travel to construction sites across the country from our UK hub, and since construction starts early, you'll need to be comfortable with early mornings.
You'll be one of the first people in the UK using software and robots to build, in an industry that's worked the same way for centuries.
We are unable to support relocation or sponsorship for this role. Applicants must be based in the United Kingdom, eligible to work and able to commute onsite to London to be considered.
What you’ll do
- Prepping a real or test construction project: understanding what needs to be built, where, and scoping site conditions
- Preparing the site by placing markers and taking photos for 3D reconstruction
- Operating our construction robots using our in-house software system on a laptop
- Taking notes as the system runs so our R&D team can keep improving the product
- Troubleshooting with our engineering, ops, and manufacturing teams in Amsterdam when more complicated issues come up
- Handling site tasks including: setting wall ties, cutting and loading bricks and pointing walls
- Being an ambassador and the face of Monumental on a construction site
What we’re looking for
- A technical and analytical mindset. You don’t need an engineering degree, but you understand the difference between a hardware and software failure, and how to debug a problem when something breaks - your friends probably come to you for tech support
- You love getting your hands dirty and don’t want to sit behind a computer all-day. You will frequently wake up early to drive to a construction site on-time and enjoy being in that context.
- You are outcome and detail oriented. You understand that running the robots all day but leaving walls stained and dirty is still a failure when we’re building a house that someone will live in.
- Previous experience on a construction site is a strong plus.
- You have a drivers license and are comfortable driving a van.
- You’re fluent in English (spoken and written).
Employment and logistics
- 5 days a week as a contractor/sole trader
- UK-based, commuting from our hub for day-trips to sites. Sponsorship not available for this role.
Why Monumental?
The UK has missed its housing target by almost 100k homes every year for the last decade, all while the industry is facing a shortage of around 25,000 bricklayers. We're hiring the team that's going to deploy a new way of building to solve this.
It is hard, messy, and deeply rewarding work. If you're driven by the idea of building real things with new technology, we want to hear from you.
For open applications, or if you don't see an exact role match but think you'd be good at this, write to us at iwanttojoin@monumental.co. Tell us the most interesting or challenging project you've worked on, why you want to join, and your CV or portfolio.
If you don't meet every line above but are excited about Monumental and feel you'd help us solve difficult problems, get in touch. We're open to generalists who get things done and are comfortable learning as they go.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/morningconsult/0f76ee51.description_excerpt:
ABOUT MORNING CONSULT:
Morning Consult is a global decision intelligence company changing how modern leaders make smarter, faster, better decisions. The company pairs its proprietary high-frequency data with applied artificial intelligence to better inform decisions on what people think and how they will act.
Morning Consult surveys 30,000+ people every day across 50+ countries — one of the largest proprietary survey engines in the world, with a cumulative dataset of 6 billion+ questions answered. We're turning that data into AI-native decision intelligence. Our data is trusted by organizations from central banks to Fortune 500 brands to leading media institutions, including Apple, Google, Netflix, Amazon, Salesforce, Target, American Express, and Starbucks. Leaders at these companies, and many more, rely on Morning Consult to turn real-time consumer signal into confident, faster decisions.
This is Morning Consult's first dedicated global hire — you'll open new markets, not join an established one. The role is based in London.
THE ROLE:
Morning Consult is hiring its first UK-based Account Executive to build inroads in new global markets with focus on the UK and EMEA. This is a quota-carrying role and you will own a revenue number from day one. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, you'll own the UK and EMEA go-to-market motion from the ground up: prospecting, positioning, and full sales cycles. While this is a greenfield build without an inherited pipeline, you won't be doing it alone — you'll have direct support from the US-based GTM team on developing the local playbook, sales enablement, competitive positioning, and marketing collateral.
You'll test and refine what resonates with UK and EMEA buyers, report back on what's working, and help shape Morning Consult's broader international expansion strategy. A genuine interest in marketing, positioning, and buyer strategy matters here as much as sales execution skill, as well as a keen interest in having a robust feedback loop with sales leadership to continually iterate on what is working in the global markets.
WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON:
- Lead complex, high-value sales cycles with an average deal size (ACV) of approximately £75,000–£85,000 across enterprise accounts, including advanced qualification, discovery, and deal structuring.
- Own top-of-funnel and full-cycle sales activities — from prospecting and outreach to closing — with a strong emphasis on self-sourced pipeline.
- Build pipeline in a greenfield market. You will identify and prioritize target accounts, develop your own outreach, and create demand where none exists yet.
- Deliver compelling, customized platform demonstrations and thought leadership to C-level and executive stakeholders, leveraging deep product and industry knowledge.
- Maintain rigorous pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce, ensuring data integrity and providing actionable visibility to leadership.
- Prospect into continental EMEA — to help build the pipeline case for a second regional hire.
- Share market feedback with the CRO and US-based team — what's resonating with buyers, where we're winning, and where we're not — to help sharpen the pitch and inform future hiring decisions.
- Represent Morning Consult externally, including UK trade press briefings and a flagship UK launch event as part of the company's go-to-market announcement.
ABOUT YOU AND WHAT YOU'VE DONE:
- 5–8 years of enterprise sales experience (or equivalent demonstrated track record), with a strong record of closing complex, net-new deals in SaaS, data, or market research environments.
- Demonstrated ability to independently build pipeline through outbound prospecting without reliance on inbound leads or SDR support.
- Demonstrated ability to independently manage and close high-value, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
- Experience selling into UK and/or European enterprise buyers preferred, not required.
- BS/BA or equivalent; advanced degree a plus.
- Deep intellectual curiosity and the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights for diverse audiences.
- Advanced knowledge of marketing, communications, data, or brand strategy.
- Genuine interest in market positioning and buyer strategy — you enjoy figuring out how to enter and win a market, not just executing an established playbook.
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with experience presenting to executive and C-suite audiences.
- Familiarity with survey research and its methods (highly valued, but not required).
- Based in London, UK with flexibility for overlap with US-based teams.
WHAT WE OFFER:
The expected base salary range for this role is £90,000–£120,000, with an OTE of £180,000–£240,000 (50/50 split). Final package will be commensurate with experience.
Benefits:
- Health: Freedom Health Elite Family cover
- Pension: Auto-enrolment
- Internet stipend: £65/month
- New hire stipend: £200
- Holiday: 20 days + public holidays
- Work model: Remote-first — no mandatory office days, though regular client travel and in-person events (including the UK launch event) are expected as part of the role
- Beyond compensation, this role comes with the rare opportunity to build MC's EMEA go-to-market from the ground up — shaping not just your own success, but the playbook and hiring decisions that follow you.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES
Morning Consult is committed to being an inclusive employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership status, race, religion or belief, sex, pregnancy or maternity, or sexual orientation, in line with the Equality Act 2010. Please let us know if you require any adjustments to the interview process.
RIGHT TO WORK:
This role is engaged via an Employer of Record (EOR) in the UK and is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must already have the right to work in the UK (e.g., UK or Irish citizenship, settled or pre-settled status, or another independent right to work) without the need for sponsorship.
DATA PROTECTION NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES:
Morning Consult LLC is the data controller for the personal data you provide when you apply. We collect what's in your CV/application — name, contact details, work and education history — plus, where applicable, interview notes, references, background-check results, and any diversity information you choose to share.
We use this to assess your application, run the hiring process, and meet legal obligations, relying on our legitimate interest in recruiting effectively and the steps needed to enter a contract with you. Your application is processed through Ashby, our applicant tracking system provider, which handles this data on our instructions as our data processor; your data is accessed by our recruiting team, including in the United States.
We retain your application data for the duration of the recruitment process. If unsuccessful, we may keep your details to consider you…
