jobs.ashbyhq.com/lupapets/cc32dc49-c761-.description_excerpt:
About Us
Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before.
We are the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals health than ever.
The traction speaks for itself: one of Europe's top 100 AI startups with a team of 50 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 2.5M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London.
This is a rare chance to join a rocket ship at exactly the right moment and we are looking for exceptional people to help us fly it.
In this role, you will:
- Own the end to end testing process for your product area alongside dev, from drafting BDD scenarios and acceptance criteria all the way through to release
- Decide what gets automated and build it. You are not waiting to be told what needs a test, you are making that call yourself
- Review AI drafted tests and catch flaky tests or visual regressions before they reach merge
- Run smoke tests and exploratory testing at release and be accountable for releases going out smoothly, not just for finding bugs
- Work directly with engineers from the start of a feature, not at the end when problems are harder to fix
- Help shape how the QE function works as we build it from scratch. Early hires leave fingerprints here
Your background looks something like:
- 1 to 3 years of experience in a QE, SDET, or software engineering role, or a strong recent graduate with real coding experience under your belt
- Comfortable owning both manual and automated testing end to end
- Hands on experience with Playwright for test automation and TypeScript
- Confident writing BDD style scenarios from acceptance criteria
- Genuinely AI fluent. You use AI tools day to day, have opinions on where they help and where they fall short, and know how to review AI generated output critically
- Mobile automation experience (nice to have)
As a person, you:
- Are proactive by nature. You see what is not working and fix it before being asked
- Like to innovate and try new things. You are not looking to execute someone else's process, you want to help build the right one
- Take real ownership of what you ship. A release going out smoothly matters to you personally, not just as a task
- Thrive with genuine autonomy and are energised by the space to make decisions rather than slowed down by it
- Are excited to work in person from our Paddington, London HQ
- Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic
What does success look like in 6 months?
- You own the end to end testing process for at least one product area independently, working directly with dev rather than waiting to be looped in
- Releases you are responsible for go out smoothly and the team trusts you to make the call on what needs testing and automating without being told
- You are actively contributing to moving the automation percentage up and your fingerprints are already on how the QE function works

jobs.ashbyhq.com/mubit/77a5ea32-5012-407.description_excerpt:
WHO'S MUBIT?
AI agents are being deployed into production faster than the infrastructure can support them. The result: engineers spending 5+ hours a week manually compensating for agents that have no memory of what they've done, what failed, or why.
Mubit is the operational memory and state management layer for production AI agents. We give agents persistent execution history, shared state, and ACL-gated memory — so they get more reliable over time without constant human intervention.
We're well funded and building the founding team. This is your chance to get in at the beginning of something real.
WHAT THIS ROLE IS
You'll be the first engineering hire and co-own the architecture of Mubit's core infrastructure.
Mubit sits in the hot path of production AI agents — sub-80ms retrieval, ACL-gated shared state, pub/sub event triggers, execution history across agent fleets. The systems you build are why agents get more reliable over time instead of requiring constant human intervention.
This isn't a spec-execution role. You'll identify the problems, own the trade-offs, and ship the solutions.
Our office is in Canary Wharf (WeWork - 30 Churchill Place).
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT 12 MONTHS
- Retrieval latency is consistently under 80ms at real customer scale
- The SDK is something engineers recommend to each other — not something they tolerate
- You've made architecture calls we're still building on at 10x current load
- Early customers have integrated Mubit into production agent stacks without hand-holding
YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS
- Get deep into the core storage and retrieval architecture — understand every trade-off already made and form opinions on what to change
- Work directly with early customers integrating Mubit into their agent stack (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, etc.)

About myTomorrows
myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.
We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.
We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.
With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.
Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today.

Beyond ensuring quality, compliance, speed, and resilience, you’ll be expected to think like an entrepreneur: spotting opportunities, optimising processes, and driving commercially sound decisions that enable sustainable growth.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives on complexity, builds high‑performing teams, and raises the operational bar—while balancing patient‑first decision‑making with a strong commercial mindset.
Geographic Requirement: This role is open to candidates in The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada and USA. For candidates in North America, to ensure seamless collaboration with our teams, applicants must reside within the EST or CST time zones.
WHAT YOU'LL DO IN THIS ROLE:
- Own the end-to-end operating model for EAP Program + Site Management, ensuring scalable and compliant delivery
- Translate strategy and portfolio forecasts into capacity planning, org design and hiring priorities
- Build resilient coverage and escalation models across the portfolio (no single points of failure)
- Lead the EAP Program Management team to deliver consistent execution across clients and geographies
- Lead the EAP Site Management team to ensure strong site engagement, workload balance and service performance
- Drive standardisation and continuous improvement across ways of working, tooling and operational excellence
- Set and run a strong governance rhythm: KPIs, performance reviews, risk management and quality oversight

- Grow a bar-raising leadership bench through coaching, performance management and succession planning
- Partner with Finance, People and Operations on budgeting, workforce planning and scale-up decisions
WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE:
- You have 8–10+ years experience leading and managing expanded access programs.
- Experience in a market access setting and with multi-country reimbursement strategies is a plus.
- You understand the EAP business, and have a strong and proven commercial and client service mindset.
- You have proven experience building and leading high performance teams.
- You know how to lead managers and scale operational teams in complex settings
- You have an exceptionally strong understanding of compliance, regulatory frameworks and operational requirements in the context of Expanded Access Programs
- You have a track record of operational excellence: scaling delivery, managing risk, and raising performance standards
- You are a strategic thinker with strong execution focus — you simplify complexity and drive outcomes
- You are a confident stakeholder manager who can align senior leaders and external partners
- You hold a high bar for quality and accountability, with calm leadership under pressure
WHAT SUCCESS IN THE FIRST 6 MONTHS LOOKS LIKE:

Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.
We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.
By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.
Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.
This role is located in Sydney, Australia - A relocation package and visa sponsorship will be provided as part of the salary package.
The Staff Machine Learning Platform Engineer owns the infrastructure and systems that allow Neara's ML discipline to move fast, ship reliably, and scale without breaking.
Neara is conducting cutting edge research, developing multi-modal spatial frontier models. You will help the team run faster, helping overcome challenges that have never been seen before in the world. These models work with a range of less researched data types, including point cloud, geospatial data, and asset data. The lack of research maturity in the geospatial domain and novel nature of the problem presents unique challenges around performance, data unification, and deployment.
The problem and role stretch beyond pure research. These models will be deployed with our global utility and new vertical customers, delivering real value and increased climate resilience for critical infrastructure. Your role will be critical in both making sure we can develop frontier level spatial intelligence quickly and economically, but also in making sure we can deploy those models efficiently to our customers.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
- Own the ML platform strategy end-to-end - Define and drive the multi-year technical roadmap for training pipelines, serving architecture, experiment management, and monitoring systems that tie it all together.
- Build tooling that accelerates ML delivery - Develop foundational infrastructure that takes engineers from idea to production faster, standardising workflows and eliminating friction between experimentation and deployment.
- Solve hard distributed systems problems - Enable training across distributed data with residency and security requirements, while ensuring models run efficiently across varied GPU hardware, including sparse tensor implementations and architecture bottlenecks.
- Design scalable, flexible serving architecture - Define serving systems that handle spiky load in production while giving the ML team the freedom to experiment across regions, customers, tasks, and verticals.
- Unblock the ML team at scale - Identify what's slowing the team down, define the contracts and interfaces between training, evaluation, and serving, and build the roadmap to turn ambitious research into routine delivery.
WHAT YOU’LL BRING
- A foundation in R&D to help drive the right direction and prioritisation necessary for faster iteration.
- Demonstrated ability to set ML platform standards and interactions across teams, influence engineering roadmaps without direct authority, and drive alignment on complex infrastructure decisions.
- Significant technical experience running deep learning at scale, with a track record of designing and operating the systems other ML engineers depend on.
- Experience in building training data warehouses as well as bringing data systems to ML readiness.
- Deep hands-on expertise building ML infrastructure at scale, in particular: training pipelines, distributed compute, model serving and model monitoring.
- Deep familiarity with model monitoring, data quality frameworks, and the operational practices required to maintain a diverse portfolio of production ML models.
- A proven investment in building others through documentation, internal standards, and raising the MLOps capability of the engineering discipline around you.
- Strong proficiency in Python, PyTorch (or equivalent framework) and a passion for deep learning.
- Demonstrated software engineering fundamentals across system design, code quality, and scalability, with a clear instinct for where to invest complexity and where to keep things simple.
- Solid experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) as well as dealing with custom on-prem/neocloud offerings
- Proficiency in writing and optimising custom CUDA kernels for deep learning training is a nice-to-have but not imperative
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
- Full relocation to Australia
- Competitive salary
- Meaningful ESOP
- Fully flexible work environment. We have a fully stocked office (and an impressive snack collection) in Redfern.
- Regular office events
- The real benefit is working on a genuinely complex, innovative and industry-leading product, making a genuine difference in the world around us
To apply, please use the online application link below. Neara values diversity, belonging and equal employment opportunities. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.
No agencies or third-party service providers, please.

Location: Central London

WHY JOIN NORM LAW
You’ll be part of the founding UK team bringing a proven US category leader to a receptive UK market. You’ll have autonomy, visibility, and the opportunity to build meaningful relationships — backed by a world-class product, an experienced executive team, and a growing global reputation.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/numeric/e89edec6-650d-4.description_excerpt:
WHY NUMERIC
Every business runs on accounting, but the systems underneath it were built for a different era. Today’s ERPs don’t store a company’s financial data. They store a diluted copy of it. Every contract, lease, and invoice gets flattened into a journal entry, and the context that made it meaningful is thrown away. That’s why accounting teams spend every month re-checking numbers, stitching together spreadsheets, and waiting on engineering, and why AI struggles to do real accounting work. Accounting doesn’t have a reporting problem. It has a data problem.
Enter Numeric: the data platform finance teams run on. We started with the month-end close, where the data problem hurts most, and hundreds of finance teams now run their close on Numeric. That work led us to rebuild the system of record itself. In September 2026 we launched the Financial Data Platform (FDP), a platform built for the agent era. Instead of a journal entry, the real business object enters the system and the accounting is derived from it. Every number is traceable to its source, reporting works on any dimension, and accountants and AI agents finally have enough context to work together. While others bolted AI features onto the old data model, we built a new one.
We have a growing base of customers who love our product, including Anthropic, Plaid, Brex, Betterment, Wealthfront, and Asana. We’ve raised $89M from top-tier investors including IVP, Menlo Ventures, Founders Fund, and 8VC, along with founders and executives from Ramp, Segment, and other category-defining companies. We’re in-person, with teams in New York, San Francisco, and London, and we just shipped the product that will define our next decade. There’s never been a better time to join.
About This Role
As a Sales Engineer, you'll be the technical expert partnering with our sales team, helping accounting & finance leaders understand how Numeric solves their most complex accounting challenges. The product is moving fast, customers are getting more sophisticated, and the SE role is at the center of every major win.
We’re looking for someone with experience in technical selling to the OCFO and can hold their own with a Controller pushing back on the technical detail. This role is your path to owning bigger deals, shaping the playbooks the team runs on, and helping define what world-class presales looks like.
What you'll do
- Independently lead demos, discovery sessions, and proof-of-concept engagements across mid-market and select enterprise accounts
- Partner closely with Account Executives to develop technical win strategies and drive deals forward
- Build credibility with senior finance stakeholders including CFOs, Controllers, and FDs of Finance as a trusted domain expert
- Gather and synthesize customer feedback to inform product roadmap priorities. Partner closely with PMM and product to shape the future of the platform
- Develop and maintain reusable demo environments, technical collateral, and enablement materials for the broader tea
About You
- 3–5 years of total experience, with time as a Sales Engineer/Solution Consultant or Implementation Consultant at an ERP or FP&A platform (e.g., NetSuite, Workday, or Pigment), or time in an accounting & finance org with a passion for more customer-facing work
- Solid accounting and finance domain knowledge, with the ability to hold a credible conversation with a Controller or CFOs
- A track record of running demos, POCs, and discovery independently on deals of real complexity
- Based in the London
Nice To Haves
- Experience contributing to an SE function at a high-growth startup
- ACCA/CIMA or formal accounting background
- Familiarity with accounting close management or financial reporting workflows
How We Work:
This role is in-person in London (in office, with flexibility). We strongly believe we will only be successful if everyone on the team is anchored in our following set of core principles:
- Brick by Brick: To win, our team needs to show up and execute in each domain every day.
- Love the Game: We focus on the craft and a deep sense of giving a f*ck. We’re building a company full of people who are equally engaged and motivated.
- SALY: We refuse to accept “Same As Last Year.” For too long, accounting and finance systems have reflected outdated processes instead of reimagining what’s possible. We’re driven by a first-principles approach to building better solutions.
- Own the Outcome: We own our results. We typically hire builders and give them large mandates with high-trust. Engineers are responsible not just for code, but for ensuring the product is solving the end problems of the users.
- Earn the right: We’re impatient to deliver results. We relentlessly iterate, measure, and improve. Every day is an opportunity to beat our prior best, raising the bar for the value we deliver to customers.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/openhomefoundation/9e9d.description_excerpt:
We are looking for
The Open Home Foundation is looking for a Senior Product Manager preferably based in Europe to join our Ecosystem department. This department is responsible for the development of all the projects except Home Assistant under the OHF umbrella, including ESPHome https://esphome.io/, Voice https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2025/02/13/voice-chapter-9-speech-to-phrase/, Music Assistant https://www.music-assistant.io/, the Open Home Protocols (Zigbee/Z-Wave/Matter), our collaborations with other projects like WLED https://kno.wled.ge/ or Zigbee2MQTT https://www.zigbee2mqtt.io/, and any others that join us in the future.
As an open-source organization, being a product manager involves accounting for a large community of active users and contributors, balancing open-source collaboration with product leadership.
The Ecosystem department is seeking Product Managers across three key projects: ESPHome, Music Assistant & Sendspin, and Voice & Assist.
This position will likely be a combined role spanning a pairing of these projects (such as Music Assistant + Sendspin or ESPHome + Voice & Assist), with flexibility for other combinations depending on the candidate's strengths, experience, and interests.
In this role, you will define product vision, align community feedback with strategic goals, and work hand-in-hand with UX designers, core foundation engineers, and open-source contributors around the globe. You will have access to UX research and marketing resources to validate ideas and drive adoption.
What you are going to do
- Lead the creation of product visions and strategies for your assigned product(s), working on larger strategic roadmap topics while signaling community needs via feature requests and discussions.
- Execute your product vision by bringing opportunities to life, up to and including delivery, together with engineers and designers.
- Join the day-to-day operation of the product development, participating actively in anything required to get the job done.
- Collaborate with other teams, stakeholders, and commercial partners.
- Involve our worldwide community from discovery to delivery, including monitoring community channels such as Discord, forums and Github to collect feedback and ensure projects stay on the right track.
- Coordinate with external stakeholders and commercial partners (e.g., aligning new hardware product launches with software features).
What you need to have
- 5+ years of experience delivering value to users as a product manager.
- 3+ years of experience shaping strategy and vision for a product.
- Meaningful experience with full autonomy, and iterative development/releasing.
- Proficiency in working with multi-disciplinary teams (UX designers and engineers), including hands-on project management to keep engineering teams on track.
- Proficiency in communication, being able to adapt the message to the audience.
- Comfort with public speaking during workshops, meetups, livestreams, etc.
- Professional Fluency in English: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
- European Residency: You must be currently based and eligible to work within Europe.
It would be great if you also have
- A passion for smart homes and automation.
- Experience as a Home Assistant, ESPHome or Music Assistant user.
- Curiosity and passion for learning.
What we offer you
The Open Home Foundation is a fully remote organization that uses Remote to employ people from all over the world. You will be a normal salaried employee in your country.
This is a full-time position for 40 hours per week. Because we are a fully remote company, there is no fixed schedule. For the purpose of team communication, we do try to ensure at least 3 hours of overlap in the workday. You will report to the Ecosystem Lead, who is based in the Netherlands.
Core to the establishment of the Open Home Foundation was the well-being of the people building the future of the smart home. We will provide all the benefits required by the country you reside in. However, we also want to make sure all our employees, regardless of country of origin, get at least a minimal set of benefits, including:
- Twenty-five days of paid time off.
- Fourteen days of paid sick leave if your country/laws treat them as unpaid.
- Six weeks of paid and six weeks of unpaid parental leave to be used in the first year after birth. We will provide the missing days if your country/laws do not provide such compensation.
- A budget for your work hardware once you start. After three years, you may keep this equipment for personal use.
- A 50% contribution to your internet connection fee at your home workspace.
- One day every two weeks to work on your personal projects.
- If you are currently working on Home Assistant-related side projects, you can spend work time maintaining them.
When first offering a position to a new member, the Open Home Foundation aims to provide a total compensation package that matches the 75th percentile for the new hire's role, seniority, and local market rates. For a Senior Product Manager in our primary operating countries, the approximate yearly compensation will be the following:
- Netherlands: 71.000 EUR.
- UK: 67.000 GBP.
- Spain: 61.000 EUR.
- Portugal: 51.000 EUR.
- Other countries: compensation can be discussed during the first interview.
These figures may be adjusted based on experience, qualifications, and work hours.
About us
The Open Home Foundation is a non-profit organization based in Switzerland, with the objective of fighting for the fundamental principles of privacy, choice, and sustainability for smart homes. It does this by supporting the development of open-source projects, and open connectivity and communication standards.
A big part of this is Home Assistant https://www.home-assistant.io/, the biggest https://github.blog/news-insights/octoverse/octoverse-2024/#the-state-of-open-source open-source project in number of contributors, but the Open Home Foundation also owns or collaborates with other projects important to promoting privacy, choice, and sustainability in the smart home, like:

- Open standards (e.g., Matter JS https://github.com/matter-js/matter.js, Z-Wave JS https://github.com/zwave-js, ZigPy https://github.com/zigpy/zigpy, BTHome https://bthome.io/, Improv Wi-Fi https://www.improv-wifi.com/).
- Open voice (e.g., Rhasspy https://github.com/rhasspy/rhasspy, Wyoming Protocol https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/wyoming/, Piper https://github.com/rhasspy/piper).
- Music Assistant https://www.music-assistant.io/.
The recruitment process
1. Apply for the role.
2. Our HR team will review your application with the hiring manager.
3. Interview with HR.
4. Interview with the manager.
5. Case study with the team.
6. Offer.
7. Join our team!

jobs.ashbyhq.com/onhires/06381c3d-8938-4.description_excerpt:
REMOTE | UNITED KINGDOM | CRYPTO & PAYMENTS | FCA AUTHORISATION | EMPLOYMENT OR B2B
Our client is an established, profitable fintech operating at the intersection of crypto and traditional payments. It runs a consumer on/off-ramp platform and a fast-growing B2B infrastructure business: APIs and white-label solutions that let exchanges, neobanks, PSPs, wallets and other platforms embed regulated crypto and fiat services. The company is authorised under MiCA and PSD2 in the EU and is now building its regulatory presence in the UK. The culture is owner-led, high-ownership and low-bureaucracy: decisions are made quickly and close to the founders.
About the role
This is a senior, hands-on legal role with a single, clear mandate: own the company’s UK regulatory build. You will report directly to the CEO and be the most senior legal voice in the business on UK matters.
The UK’s new cryptoasset regime takes effect in October 2027. From that date, regulated cryptoasset activity in the UK requires FCA authorisation. You will own a first-wave authorisation under this new regime end to end, alongside a UK e-money application. For a regulatory lawyer, this is a career-defining piece of work, and the window to start it is narrow.
The role has no direct reports at hire. You will work closely with the company’s EU legal function. This is a deliberately focused UK mandate, not a group legal role.
What you will own
- FCA cryptoasset authorisation: perimeter analysis of B2C and B2B activities against the new regime, application strategy, drafting, regulatory business plan input, RFI handling and dialogue through to decision.
- UK EMI application: ownership on the same basis, including sequencing between the two applications.
- FCA relationship: acting as the senior in-house legal counterpart to the regulator.
- UK conduct perimeter: the cryptoasset financial promotions regime, Consumer Duty, the UK Travel Rule, and safeguarding and prudential requirements.
- Post-authorisation readiness: governance, senior manager and certification considerations, reporting and disclosures.
- External counsel: briefing, directing and quality-controlling UK external counsel, and managing that spend.
- International expansion: legal lead on additional licence applications in other jurisdictions, and advice where the UK and EU regulatory perimeters meet.
- Commercial legal: drafting and negotiating English-law B2B agreements. This includes MSAs, API and white-label terms, referral and agent agreements, and banking, payment and card scheme counterparty agreements.
- UK consumer-facing legal: consumer terms, financial promotions review and UK-specific disclosures.
- UK employment: UK employment law and contractor arrangements, in partnership with HR.
What we are looking for
- Qualified solicitor or barrister in England & Wales, typically with 8+ years PQE.
- Hands-on UK financial services regulatory experience, including at least one FCA authorisation or variation of permission that you personally owned or materially led, from perimeter analysis to decision.
- Direct, personal interaction with the FCA: correspondence, meetings and representation that you led yourself.
- Crypto or digital-asset legal experience at licensed or established firms, such as registered or authorised exchanges, regulated on/off-ramps, licensed custodians or infrastructure providers.
- Cryptoasset, e-money or payments perimeter experience. Engagement with the 2025–26 FCA cryptoasset consultations is highly relevant.
- Ability to draft and negotiate English-law B2B fintech agreements independently.
- A track record of owning regulatory outcomes, not only advising on them. Law-firm backgrounds are welcome where this is evident.
- Ability to take a clear position under pressure from senior stakeholders and counterparties, and to translate legal risk into business options with a recommendation.
- Comfort operating as a remote senior with no legal support structure beneath you, working with a leadership team based outside the UK.
- Practical use of AI tools in legal drafting, research or review.
- Fluent legal English to regulator-facing standard.
- Existing right to work in the UK, and the ability to attend regulator meetings in London as required.
Team management experience is not required. We welcome strong senior counsel ready to step into a Head of Legal role.
Nice to have
- Previous Head of Legal, GC or senior counsel role at a UK-authorised EMI, PI or FCA-registered cryptoasset firm.
- Experience of a firm moving from AML registration to full FSMA authorisation.
- Involvement in industry working groups or trade association engagement on the new UK crypto regime.
- SM&CR experience.
- Knowledge of UK safeguarding and prudential requirements for e-money and payments.
- Crown Dependency (Jersey, Guernsey, Isle of Man) or Australian regulatory exposure.
- Card scheme legal experience, such as Visa/Mastercard rules and principal membership.
- Experience building a legal or regulatory function in a jurisdiction from scratch.
What’s on offer
- A direct reporting line to the CEO and ownership of the company’s UK market entry.
- A defining role in a first-wave authorisation under the UK’s new cryptoasset regime.
- A remote setup in the UK, with a flat structure and fast decisions.
- An employment or B2B contract, with a performance bonus linked to UK authorisation milestones.
- A fast, transparent hiring process, typically completed within four weeks.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/openai-deployment-compa.description_excerpt:

The OpenAI Deployment Company ("DeployCo") is the deployment arm of OpenAI, purpose-built to deliver enterprise AI transformation at scale. As model capabilities accelerate, deployment has become the primary constraint to realizing AI value creation within large enterprises. DeployCo bridges that gap.
Our ambition is to build the company that defines AI deployment. We operate at the intersection of cutting-edge AI, enterprise transformation, and scaled services delivery. We partner with enterprise customers to identify where AI can transform their businesses and build solutions leveraging OpenAI's models and products. We work with many of the world's largest and most influential companies to solve their most complex business challenges using the latest advances in AI.
People who thrive at DeployCo get excited about ambitious and complex work. We are deep believers in the future with AI. We execute quickly, value intellectual honesty and empathy, and obsess over the solutions we build for our customers.
DeployCo is being built from the ground up as a subsidiary of OpenAI and funded with a partnership of outside investors.
About the Role
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer to lead the design, build, and deployment of enterprise AI systems. In this role, you will operate as a senior technical owner across customer engagements, shaping architecture, setting engineering standards, and helping teams move from prototypes to durable production AI systems. DeployCo is one of the few places where engineers can work with the autonomy of a small startup while building for the scale, complexity, and impact of the world’s largest enterprises.

We're looking for engineers who deploy high-quality agentic systems into real customer workflows and business critical decisions and deliver reusable components that help future deployments move faster.
This role is based in the UK, with hybrid work and customer travel shaped by deployment needs.
In this role, you will:
- Lead software engineering workstreams for customer deployments, owning architecture, implementation quality, evaluation strategy, and production readiness for LLM-powered systems.
- Build AI applications, agents, and workflow tools using LLMs, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, data systems, and production software practices.
- Guide engineers through ambiguous technical problems, reviewing designs, code, tradeoffs, and operating assumptions.
- Work directly with customer technical teams and business stakeholders to translate workflows into reliable AI systems.
- Prototype quickly, identify what is reusable, and harden successful patterns into reference architectures and implementation assets.
- Design evaluation and monitoring approaches that improve quality, reliability, safety, and customer trust.
- Surface field insights to Product and Research, connecting deployment reality to roadmap priorities and model/system improvements.
You may thrive in this role if you:
- Bring senior software engineering experience building production applications and microservices, including APIs, scalable data pipelines, data systems, and cloud infrastructure.
- Use your expertise in Python and SQL to design and build robust data applications in enterprise environments.
- Bring production LLM experience, including leading teams delivering generative AI systems with hands-on understanding in agents, retrieval, evaluation, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and model integration.
- Have led software engineering projects from prototype to production and can set a high-quality bar while keeping teams moving quickly.
- Are comfortable as a hands-on player-coach: writing code, reviewing designs, mentoring engineers, and owning customer outcomes.
- Communicate clearly with executive, product, research, customer, and engineering audiences when decisions involve risk or ambiguity.
- Make disciplined standardization-versus-customization decisions instead of defaulting to bespoke work.
- Operate calmly under pressure and turn messy deployment problems into practical, reusable engineering patterns.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/phasebiolabs/47fde3f5-f.description_excerpt:
THE COMPANY
Phase Biolabs is a deep tech company building biomanufacturing platforms. We use engineered biocatalysts to convert waste and low-value feedstocks like CO2 into sustainable chemicals and fuels, starting with ethanol. Phase develops and scales these industrial bioprocesses from lab to pilot and commercialises them with industrial partners through retrofit models.
If you are a top-notch scientist, engineer, or builder with a passion for solving big problems, we want to hear from you.
We are seeking extraordinary talent to join our team of visionaries, risk-takers, and problem-solvers who want to become part of an effort to leverage bioengineering and convert CO2 into ethanol & other useful products. Our proprietary technology uses genetically engineered microbes to enable the creation of valuable products from CO2 emissions.
What We Offer:
- The opportunity to work on a revolutionary technology that has the potential to transform industries and reduce our reliance on fossil fuels.
- A dynamic and inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, and your contributions make a real impact.
- The flexibility to shape your role based on your skills, interests, and career goals.
- Competitive compensation and benefits, including professional development opportunities.
- Opportunities for career growth and advancement within the company.
Who You Are:
- You have a strong background in bioengineering, process engineering, or chemical engineering, with a track record of success in your field.
- You are a creative problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
- You have excellent communication skills and can effectively articulate your ideas to a diverse audience.
- You are excited about the possibility of contributing to a wide range of projects and are open to exploring new opportunities.
- You embody our company values of being Authentic, Resilient, and Respectful.
- Most importantly, you are a doer who takes initiative and gets things done instead of finding excuses.
Desired Skills:
- Experience with genetic engineering, microbial fermentation, or bioprocess engineering.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
This is an open-ended role for candidates at any experience level who want to change the world with us. If you think you have the skills, drive, and pioneering spirit to be part of our mission, we encourage you to apply. Tell us about yourself and how your talents can contribute to building the future of carbon-tech.
THE HIRING PROCESS
We will review your cover letter and CV and invite you to an initial screening interview if we think you might be a good fit. Our process includes two additional interviews (30-45 minutes each). If successful, we will carry out referencing will prior to making an offer. All interviews are remote.
We endeavour to provide feedback to all interviewees. Applications are being considered on an rolling basis.
COVER LETTER
Include a brief cover letter explaining why you are interested in the job.
HOW TO APPLY
Only applications received through our website will be reviewed.
Please submit your application here: https://phasebiolabs.com/career
Phase Biolabs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone and will consider reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process and in the role.
If you have any questions, please email the Phase Hiring Team at hr@phasebiolabs.com.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/pebl/f146c6e8-7d25-4172.description_excerpt:
Purpose in Every Position
Pebl puts a world of talent at your fingertips. With our AI-powered Global Work Platform™, companies can hire, pay, and manage employees in 185+ countries—removing risk, red tape, and guesswork from global growth. Backed by more than a decade of compliance leadership and local expertise, Pebl helps businesses move fast, stay compliant, and scale with confidence. With Pebl, companies everywhere can hire great talent anywhere.
Where Your Work Moves the Needle.
At Pebl, every team member drives our success. Joining us means more than filling a role—you’re accountable for results and impact. Our values guide how we operate, execute, and collaborate across borders. By putting them into action, you’ll help us scale faster, compete harder, and lead the future of global work.
What Makes You a Great Fit
We're looking for a driven and commercially minded Marketing Manager to join the Pebl EMEA team, reporting directly into the Principal Marketing Manager. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and is ready to hit the ground running.
Based in London, you'll play a key role in supporting and executing our go-to-market strategy across the EMEA region- with a particular focus on driving growth in French and German-speaking markets. You'll work across events, campaigns, and regional initiatives, balancing day-to-day execution with a clear understanding of broader business priorities.
French or German language skills are strongly preferred, as you'll be supporting localisation and regional engagement efforts in these markets.
How You'll Make An Impact:
GTM Strategy & Regional Campaigns
- Support the development and localisation of go-to-market strategies for the French and German markets, adapting messaging, content, and campaigns to local audiences.
- Execute integrated regional marketing campaigns across multiple channels, supporting awareness, consideration, and conversion goals.
- Collaborate with the wider marketing team on EMEA-wide initiatives — ensuring regional nuance and relevance are reflected as well as our partnerships team for partner-led campaigns.
- Contribute to demand generation and pipeline growth by aligning field activities with broader marketing and sales objectives.
- Stay close to regional market trends, competitive landscape, and customer insights to inform strategy and campaign direction.
Events & Field Marketing
- Plan and deliver a regional events calendar that spans conferences, expos, virtual summits, hosted dinners, VIP roundtables, and smaller closing events — ensuring strong alignment with sales pipeline and buying cycles.
- Lead end-to-end event execution: from logistics and vendor management to budget tracking and post-event reporting.
- Develop compelling pre-event promotional campaigns across email, social, and paid channels to drive registration and engagement.
- Test and iterate on innovative event formats — hybrid, interactive, and digital — to continuously improve prospect and customer experience.
- Analyse event performance data (attendance, lead quality, pipeline influence) and feed insights back into future planning.
- Partner closely with sales to ensure smooth lead handoff, follow-up, and pipeline tracking post-event.
Let's Connect If You Have:
- 3–5 years of experience in B2B marketing, with strong demonstrable experience in events and field marketing.
- Fluency or strong proficiency in French or German (strongly preferred).
- A track record of delivering high-quality events and campaigns in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment.
- Experience supporting or contributing to GTM strategy — you understand how marketing activity connects to revenue.
- Strong project management skills: you can handle multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and keep stakeholders aligned without losing momentum.
- Data-driven mindset — comfortable using event metrics and campaign data to evaluate performance and optimise future activity.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across marketing, sales, and external partners.
- Familiarity with virtual and hybrid event platforms (e.g., Hopin, Zoom Webinars), marketing tools (e.g., Inflection, Salesforce, Looker, Canva), project management tools (eg. Asana, Slack).
- A self-starter mentality — someone who takes ownership, moves quickly, and brings creative energy to every brief.
- Willingness to travel across the EMEA region as required — particularly for events, market visits, and key partner or customer meetings.
Nice to Have
- Experience in EOR, HR tech, workforce management, or a related SaaS environment.
- Familiarity with the HR and Finance buyer landscape in France, Germany, or broader EMEA markets.
- Experience working with external agencies (creative, PR, events, or media) to deliver campaigns and activations.
Our Commitment to You
At Pebl, we’re committed to supporting our team with comprehensive rewards and benefits designed to meet diverse needs across roles and locations. Our core offerings include:
- Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge.
- Parental Leave – Support for growing families.
- Health and Dental Insurance – Where applicable, to cover you and your loved ones.
- Retirement Savings + Employee Incentive Plan – Plan for the future while sharing our success.
Please visit our career page for more information https://hellopebl.com/company/careers/.
Pebl is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We power global teams and believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and impact. Employment decisions at Pebl are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive and do the best work of their career—anywhere in the world.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/platform-engineering/50.description_excerpt:
ABOUT PLATFORM ENGINEERING
Platform Engineering (platformengineering.org http://platformengineering.org) is home to the world's largest community of platform engineers. Through PlatformCon and AgenticCon, one of the world's largest conferences dedicated to platform engineering, we bring together thousands of platform engineers, platform leaders every year. Alongside our events, we run a university, a newsletter read by hundreds of thousands of engineers, and Weave Intelligence, our research arm.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We’re looking for an Events Growth Marketing Manager to own registration and attendance growth across our entire events portfolio. That starts with our flagship conferences, PlatformCon and AgenticCon, the biggest conferences in the platform engineering world, which travel to San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York and Berlin, and extends to our roadshows, roundtables, workshops, House of Kube (the largest party in the cloud native world) and the satellite events we run in cities around major conferences such as AWS re:Invent, KubeCon and Google Cloud Next. Your goal is to bring platform engineering leaders into the room and keep them coming back. This is a systems and relationships role, not a one off campaign role. You’ll build the growth loops, the audience, and the repeatable playbook needed to fill these events and drive high attendance every time. You’ll report to the Head of Growth.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Own registration and attendance growth for PlatformCon and AgenticCon ticket sales, and for every other event we run, across San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York, Berlin and Amsterdam.
- Build growth loops and long term relationships with the platform engineering community, its practitioners and its leaders, so we have an audience to pull from in every city.
- Own our event pages on Luma and the end to end campaigns that fill them.
- Plan campaigns designed for a high attendance rate, so the right people do not just register but actually show up.
- Use HubSpot and Luma to build and target the right audience segments for each event.
- Collaborate with design team to ensure high quality event pages and with content for strong copy and assets.
- Brief and work with our performance marketing and lifecycle managers to get paid and email support behind each event.
- Build the systems and the playbook that let us fill these events repeatedly, so the approach compounds instead of starting from scratch each time.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Within your first 90 days, we want you to come back to us with a proposed playbook: how we should run our in person events, and the exact workflow you would follow every time a new event brief lands, from audience to event page to campaigns to attendance. By 180 days, we want that playbook proven on live events, with a rising attendance rate and a reusable audience building in each city.
WHAT YOU'LL BRING
- A systems thinker who works in growth loops, not one off tactics.
- Experience in B2B SaaS marketing. Even better if you have worked somewhere whose core business is running events.
- A track record of building and growing audiences and driving real attendance at in person events, not just registrations.
- Strong hands on experience with CRM tools such as HubSpot for segmentation and targeting.
- Comfort running social campaigns and briefing paid campaigns.
- The ability to work independently with complete ownership, and to build a repeatable system rather than firefighting each event.
- Work closely with the design team to produce strong event visuals, both for our Luma pages and website pages, so every event looks as good as it performs.
- Comfortable with occasional travel to our event cities when an event calls for it.
NICE TO HAVE
- Experience with Luma as an event platform.
- Experience marketing events for a company whose primary business is events.
You do not need experience with data or automation tooling such as zapier, n8n or similar data flow systems. Our ops team supports all of that.
WHY JOIN US?
We run the biggest and most influential events in the platform engineering world. PlatformCon and AgenticCon are the flagship conferences of the entire space, and they travel to San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York and Berlin, alongside a full calendar of roadshows, executive roundtables, AI Platform Leaders events and House of Kube, the largest party in the cloud native world. These rooms bring together senior platform and engineering leaders from some of the biggest companies on the planet, including many from the S&P 500. You would own the growth of all of it end to end, with the mandate to build the audience and the playbook that make these events repeatable, and direct access to the Head of Growth and the wider leadership team.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/propelr/0f5e3194-0680-4.description_excerpt:
Business Development Manager at Propelr
Reports to: Director of Sales & GTM
GROUND-UP TECH STARTUP OPPORTUNITY
Join a fast-growing proptech founded by ex-unicorn and property industry leaders.
Our Mission
Buying and selling a property in the UK is a nightmare. Transactions drag on for months and have a 40% chance of collapsing completely. We’re on a mission to change this - helping customers get the keys to their new home up to 95% faster than it currently takes.
To do this, we’re combining a new approach to residential property sales with a platform built on modern technology - making the experience faster, clearer, and dramatically better for everyone involved.
We’d love you to join us and help bring this model to the agents and offices who need it most.
The Role
This is a relationship-led, full-cycle BD role where you’ll be out in the market - pitching our proposition to estate agents, getting offices signed up, and keeping the momentum going long after the contract is signed.
You’ll need to be credible with decision-makers, trusted by staff on the ground, and able to sell the value of Propelr in a way that lands with both. You’re not here to sell a dream - you’re here to show them a proven, better way to sell homes.
You’ll own your own pipeline, manage your own process, and help us refine how we take Propelr to market as we grow.
Key responsibilities:
- Own and manage your full sales funnel: identify prospects, qualify, pitch, close, and retain
- Build trust and credibility with both estate agency leadership (franchise owners, directors) and front-line negotiators
- Run in-person and virtual meetings with estate agents, adapting your pitch to different personalities and levels of influence
- Tailor the Propelr proposition to the specific challenges and goals of each office or brand
- Work closely with the Onboarding and Account Management teams to ensure smooth handovers and long-term engagement
- Keep your CRM, pipeline, and priorities sharp and up to date - this is a self-managed role
- Hit your activity and deal targets with pace, precision, and strong follow-through
- Bring market feedback into the business to help refine our positioning, materials, and process
Here’s the Reality of the Role:
You’re Selling to Agents - All Types
This isn’t a SaaS sale to a homogenous buyer. You’ll be dealing with multi-office franchise owners, one-branch independents, and sharp negotiators who’ve seen it all. You’ll need to read the room, build rapport fast, and show them why Propelr is worth trying.
It’s a Proper BD Role - Not a Pre-Packaged Machine
We’ll give you the core pitch, a product that works, and support from a great team — but you’ll still need to build your own rhythm, tactics, and funnel. You’ll be responsible for making deals happen, not waiting for leads to land in your lap.
It’s a Relationship Game, Not a One-and-Done Sale
Signing an office is the start, not the finish line. Your job is to make sure the team actually adopts Propelr — and keeps using it. That means revisiting offices, checking in, and keeping relationships warm so momentum doesn’t die on the vine.
You Need to Understand This World
Estate agency is fast-paced, instinctive, and relentlessly focused on the deal on the table. Agents make decisions quickly - and move on just as fast. If you want to land and keep their attention, you need to bring value fast, build genuine relationships, and stay top of mind without wasting their time. The best agents are brilliant at closing - but not always at process. That’s where you come in: translating Propelr into something that helps them win more instructions and get deals over the line faster.
What You’re Signing Up For:
- Ownership of your patch and pipeline - with the trust to go out and execute
- The chance to bring a genuinely useful, tangible product to a market crying out for something better
- A seat at the table: we’re still early, and the way we go to market is still evolving - your ideas will shape the next stage
- Opportunities to grow: you’ll be one of our first senior hires in BD - future roles could include leading a regional team, owning partnerships, or building out a vertical
Who This Is For:
- You’ve sold into estate agency before and know how to land a pitch with both the principal and the negotiator
- You’ve got a strong network - or the confidence and persistence to build one fast
- You understand the incentives and frustrations in this industry and can talk the language of deal flow, fall-through rates, and pipeline pressure
- You know how to run a sales process - qualify, multi-thread, close, and keep the momentum going
- You’re relationship-driven but commercially sharp - you know how to read the room and when to push for the close
- You’re proactive, self-managing, and hungry to get deals done
How We Work:
Our sales and operations teams operate a hybrid model designed to give you flexibility while maintaining strong team connection.
You’ll be in the office three days a week - usually for all-in days, team lunches, focus sessions, or socials. The rest of the time, you can work from anywhere in the UK. Our office near Barbican is always open, and you're welcome to use it as much as you like.
We prioritise high trust and high performance. That means autonomy, flexibility, and the expectation that you own your patch and drive results.
Our Interview Process
- Intro chat with one of the team (20–40 mins)
- Take-home case study to show how you’d approach a BD opportunity (max 2 hours)
- Presentation & Q&A with the BD team (60 mins)
- Values-alignment interview with two founders (60 mins)
We aim to complete the process in 2–3 weeks. After an offer, we’ll take you to lunch or drinks so you can meet the rest of the team.
Our Perks
- Learning and development – request any book, course, or training you need
- Modern tools – new MacBook, monitor, and anything else you need
- AI tools – subscription to ChatGPT Premium or GitHub Copilot
- Flexible hours – work around your life, not the other way round
- 3 days in, 2 days from home – with full office access any time
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays
- Your birthday off – take it any time two weeks either side
- Pension contribution

jobs.ashbyhq.com/platformed/093fad63-205.description_excerpt:
This is a great opportunity for an experienced full stack engineer to join our growing engineering team. You'll report to the CTO and work alongside the founders and the rest of our small engineering team.
ROLE
- You'll build a SaaS application using cutting edge technology (React, Rust & TypeScript), and you'll be hands-on with everything adjacent to that, from cloud deployment to system architecture.
- You'll work across the stack. We're still a small team, so you'll be involved in every aspect of the product. That means more than the frontend and backend of our codebase: you might speak to users to help them get the most out of the product, or help the sales team build a demo for a pitch.

- You’ll work alongside engineers with previous experience building and scaling a B2B SaaS product from zero to exit.
WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO…
- is motivated by making a difference for customers, and by building something that solves real problems for real people.
- thrives in a fast-paced, less structured operating environment - you’re confident in your ability to be sure you’re working on the most important thing at any given moment.
- cares about building high quality software, and you have strong opinions on how to do that. You understand the trade-offs between doing things 'right', and doing things 'at the right time' in a growing business.
- is comfortable working on the backend or the frontend, building 'both sides' of a feature - even if you have a preference for one or the other.
- has 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, building customer-facing applications where you spoke directly to users.
- can demonstrate proficiency using Rust in a professional or open-source context.
- is able to spend at least 2 days (Monday + Tuesday) per week at our office in Central London.
BENEFITS
- £80-100k salary depending on your experience.
- We think you should choose how to spend your comp, not us! We prioritise your base salary over expensive benefits.
- Every role comes with generous equity options.
- 33 days of annual leave per year.
- This includes public holidays (you are free to take them on public holidays or not).
- Currently, the first Friday of every month is a company-wide day off, which doesn’t eat up your leave allowance. Just promise to post your bungee-jumping selfies on #random.
FAQS
- What is your office/remote working policy?
- Everybody attends our Central London office on Mondays and Tuesdays, unless it’s a day off! It’s really important for us to have this time together, face-to-face.
- You can choose to work from home or attend the office on Wednesdays, Thursdays and Fridays.
- What are the working hours like?
- We believe that we get the best results in the long term by keeping things sustainable. Problem solving and relationship building works better when you’re feeling fresh!
- Aim for 9am-6pm with flexibility when you need it. Sometimes we’ll have to work late or on a weekend to meet a deadline, but this is the exception and not the norm.
- We expect you to use up your annual leave allowance in full and encourage you to make best use of the monthly Friday off! (see Benefits)
- Where is the office?
- The office is currently located right next to Victoria station in London.
- If we move to a new office, it will be in Central London and near to a public transport hub.
- Do you have company socials?
- We have a social every month on an office Tuesday.
- There’s a generous budget so we can enjoy an activity or go for a nice meal.
- What is your tech stack?
- We’re using React & TypeScript on the frontend, and Rust on the backend - everything is hosted on Google Cloud, and we’re all-in on Postgres.
INTERVIEW PROCESS
- 30-minute initial call
- Take-home task
- Half-day on-site final interviews

RapDev builds the operational backbone for autonomous IT. More than 1,000 enterprises run ServiceNow and Datadog better because of us — trusted data, connected workflows, and AI that resolves incidents instead of just reporting them.
On the ServiceNow side of our business, we specialize in modern ITOM, ITAM, AI, SPM, and DevOps implementations designed to help organizations engineer their ServiceNow into a powerful AI-driven platform. And on the Datadog side of our business, our experienced team of SREs and DevOps engineers drive better observability, availability, and deployment velocity for organizations looking to drive measurable business impact through their Datadog environment.
About the job
Are you interested in solving complex problems for ServiceNow customers? Regulatory Strategy & Market De-risking

ABOUT
Sampura Research is an AI safety research non-profit focused on scalable oversight for frontier models through improved human+AI “judges”.
Judges (LLM, human, or a hybrid) are essential for aligning highly capable models through their use in evaluation and training. Limitations in today's judges can lead to undesirable behavior such as reward hacking in training, or failure to spot misalignment in evaluation. As models become more capable and their data more complex, often beyond what the systems overseeing them can understand, we expect these limitations to grow in severity and to become harder to notice.
We are designing novel judge protocols which leverage the strengths of both humans and models to outperform either alone, and building high-quality evaluations to explore judge performance across a diverse set of safety-related tasks. We believe that our focused approach will rapidly advance the science of judges by providing a much-needed systematic measurement of which protocols actually work, and producing state-of-the-art judges which can be used in real world training and evaluation pipelines.
Backed by an $11M grant from Coefficient Giving ($7M for the first year, and another $4M pledged), Sampura Research was founded in 2026 by members of DeepMind’s alignment and human data teams.
Please see our announcement https://sampura.org/news/announcing-sampura-research/ for more information.
ROLE OVERVIEW
As a founding Member of Technical Staff, you will help shape the research and engineering direction alongside the founding team, and own end-to-end research and engineering problems within our agenda:
Evaluation: Build diverse and high-quality evaluations for judge protocols, spanning static datasets (existing and novel) and dynamic settings where policies actively optimize against the judge during RL
Methods: Research and implement strategies for improving human+AI judge protocols, such as learning-to-defer, AI-generated assistance for human raters, and co-training LLM judges alongside the policy during RL.
Infrastructure: Build the tools required to enable and scale our research agenda, including large-scale evaluation and training pipelines, a human rating platform, and a public judge leaderboard.
We've initially budgeted ~$1M per quarter for compute and human data, across a team of fewer than ten, to ensure that we can commit to ambitious goals in all of these areas. You'll scope ambiguous problems independently, communicate progress clearly, and synthesize findings into papers, blog posts, and benchmark releases.
Staff hires may also lead research and mentorship programs through paid fellowships or volunteer research focused on evaluation or methods work.
If our work and mission resonate with you, please consider applying even if you don’t tick every box. We strongly believe in investing in excellent people regardless of prior or formal experience.
You may be a good fit if you have
- A Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field or equivalent experience.
- Strong Python engineering skills and experience in large collaborative codebases, with experience in the modern ML stack (e.g., LLM inference APIs, PyTorch/JAX, data analysis tooling) and large codebases.
- Experience training and evaluating large language models, including critically assessing datasets and analysing results quantitatively and qualitatively.
- A willingness to embrace AI tools intelligently, applying scrutiny and human review where necessary.
- A track record of exploring and resolving open-ended research questions with rigor and integrity, in academic or industry labs, fellowships, or volunteer research programs.
Outstanding candidates will have
- Demonstrated ownership across multiple parts of the AI research lifecycle (experiment design and execution, infrastructure, data collection and processing, inference).
- Expertise in a highly relevant domain such as model confidence/calibration, interpretability, safety/alignment evaluation, human-computer interaction, or other fields related to scalable oversight.
- Hands-on experience with post-training methods such as reinforcement learning, adversarial fine-tuning, or distillation, especially applied to judges or reward models.
- Hands-on experience with human data collection and rater study design.
- Leadership as a mentor or team lead for related research, either inside a research lab or via programs like SPAR, MARS, or MATS.
SALARY RANGE:
Junior hires: £100,000-£150,000 (~$136,000-$205,000)
Senior hires: £150,000-£200,000 (~$205,000-$273,000)
Staff hires: £200,000-£290,000 (~$273,000-$395,000)
*Approximate USD conversion as of 24 August 2026.
Exceptional students/new-grads and early-career individuals will often come in at the junior level. Researchers or engineers with several relevant years of experience will often come in at the senior level. Staff hires typically bring deep expertise in a directly relevant area at notable research labs, and have led research programs or teams.
We'll agree a target level with you early in the process, and may reassess as you progress.
LOGISTICS:
Location: This role is based on-site in London.
Visa Sponsorship: We offer visa sponsorship for this role.
Start Dates: We are hiring 2-4 FTEs targeting an October 2026 start, and hiring other FTEs on a rolling basis.
Deadlines: We will review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply ASAP. For October hires, apply by Sept 21 latest. Feel free to apply again in a few months, if your experience has updated.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY:
Sampura Research is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team with diverse backgrounds and perspectives and believe this makes our research and workplace better. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, age, disability, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, or any other protected characteristic. If you need adjustments at any stage of the application process, let us know and we'll make them.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/sandboxaq/d8faf1b6-d018.description_excerpt:
ABOUT SANDBOXAQ
SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.
We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.
At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.
THE OPPORTUNITY
The AI Sim R&D team builds leading-edge ML and physics-based models ("LQMs") to advance drug discovery. Within this team, AQCell is our virtual cell platform: it takes a cell representation (e.g. basal gene expression) and a perturbation descriptor (e.g. SMILES, dose, and time), predicts the resulting transcriptomic response, and maps that response through pathway activity to functional endpoints such as cell viability, IC50, and toxicity dose-response — helping drug discovery scientists understand the biological repercussions of a compound across the cell, not just whether it binds its target.
As a Machine Learning Engineer on AQCell, you will build and maintain the models and data infrastructure that power this pipeline. You will work across large, heterogeneous transcriptomic and functional-endpoint datasets (e.g. LINCS L1000, GDSC, Tahoe-100M, and DILImap), train and evaluate expression-perturbation and cell-viability prediction models over them, and help harden our evaluation pipeline and baselines so we can trust and improve model performance over time. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning and biology, and offers the opportunity to shape how virtual cell models are trained, validated, and scaled toward real drug discovery decisions.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Model Development: Build, train, and maintain machine learning models for expression-perturbation prediction (e.g. transcriptomic response to a drug perturbation) and downstream functional-endpoint prediction (e.g. cell viability, IC50, toxicity dose-response).
- Large-Scale Dataset Management: Acquire, harmonize, and manage large-scale biological datasets (e.g. LINCS L1000, GDSC, Tahoe-100M, DILImap) — including schema harmonization, normalization, and de-duplication across cell, drug, and assay identifiers — and manage model training pipelines over these pooled datasets.
- Evaluation & Baselines: Contribute to automating and hardening the end-to-end evaluation pipeline, including implementing robust statistical baselines (e.g. cell- and drug-conditioned mean baselines) to rigorously benchmark model performance.
- Research Translation: Translate ideas from the scientific literature (e.g. transformer-based perturbation models, knowledge graph and GNN-based embeddings) into working, well-tested code integrated into our modeling framework.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with computational biologists, software engineers, and product stakeholders to ensure models are grounded in sound biology and are usable in real drug discovery workflows.
- Communication: Clearly document methods, assumptions, and results, and communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
- Academic Foundation: Bachelor's degree in a scientific or quantitative field (Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, or related); an advanced degree (MS or PhD) is preferred.
- Applied ML in Science: Demonstrated experience building and maintaining machine learning models in a scientific discipline in an industry setting, including taking models from prototype through validation and maintenance; experience in a life sciences setting is preferred.
- Large-Scale Data Management: Required experience managing large-scale datasets and managing the training of models over them, including data ingestion, cleaning, versioning, and pipeline maintenance at scale.
- Software Engineering: Strong Python programming skills and experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, JAX) and experiment tracking/data versioning tools (e.g. Weights & Biases).
- Scientific Rigor: Ability to design sound evaluation methodology (e.g. train/test splitting strategies, held-out generalization tests) and to critically interpret model performance against meaningful baselines.
HIGHLY DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
- Bioinformatics & Computational Biology: Experience with bioinformatics and computational biology data analysis tools, particularly transcriptomics harmonization and normalization tools (e.g. batch correction, pseudobulking, gene ID mapping/standardization).
- Domain Datasets: Familiarity with public perturbation or drug-sensitivity datasets such as LINCS L1000, GDSC, DepMap, or single-cell perturbation atlases.
- Knowledge Graphs & GNNs: Experience with knowledge graph embeddings or graph neural networks applied to drugs, targets, or cells.
- Cheminformatics: Familiarity with cheminformatics representations (SMILES, InChI keys, PubChem/Cellosaurus identifiers) used to harmonize drug and cell metadata across datasets.
- Collaborative Innovation: Experience working in interdisciplinary environments where AI intersects with the biological sciences.
WHY JOIN US?
We offer competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional growth.
- Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation.

UK | Full-Time
THE MISSION: SOURCE.DEV http://Source.dev
Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework, Security, and the Android Runtime (ART).
Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation.
Source.dev http://Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS.
THE CORE PRODUCT: SOURCEFS
SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes.
- 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed.
- 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine.
- True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match.
THE CULTURAL ANCHOR: OWN IT
We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of End-to-End Ownership:
"We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.”
THE ROLE: PUSHING THE SPEED LIMITS OF RUST, LINUX & I/O
We are looking for a Performance / Systems Engineer to join us at Source.dev http://Source.dev. In this role, your primary metric of success is speed. You will dissect execution paths, eliminate kernel-space context-switching costs, optimize memory layouts, and ensure SourceFS runs as close to the hardware limits as physically possible.
WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
- System Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, and disk I/O bottlenecks in Rust systems code using tools like perf, eBPF, valgrind, and custom microbenchmarks.
- Kernel & File System Tuning: Deep dive into Linux kernel interactions, optimizing FUSE drivers, VFS caches, asynchronous I/O (io_uring), memory-mapped execution, and thread scheduling.
- Memory & Cache Efficiency: Optimize data structures for cache locality, minimize allocation overhead, and eliminate unnecessary memory copies across boundary transitions.
- Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust, reproducible benchmarking suites to measure micro- and macro-performance regression in high-concurrency environments.
- Scaling Build Primitives: Squeeze peak performance out of massive build graphs (Android, Yocto, and more) running on high-core hardware configurations.
IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE:
- The Performance Systems Mindset: You have a deep understanding of computer architecture (CPU caches, memory barriers, SIMD, system calls) and proven experience writing hyper-optimized code in Rust or C/C++.(or other). No prior experience with Rust required, just a willingness to learn is all we are looking for.
- Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale build systems and developer tooling.
- Impact-Driven: You embody the "Own It" mentality - you see a friction point in the developer journey and you don’t stop until it’s gone.
- Curious & Collaborative: You enjoy translating real-world customer problems into robust, production-grade solutions.
- Low Ego, High Impact: Beyond being a brilliant coder, you are a thoughtful and empathetic teammate - someone who leads with kindness
- Feedback Culture Champion: You embrace feedback and provide it thoughtfully; you see open, honest communication as the foundation of great teamwork.
A NOTE ON OUR SEARCH
We are looking for the best talent, wherever it may be. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a perfect fit, please do apply - we value diverse backgrounds and unique problem-solving approaches.
WHY JOIN SOURCE.DEV http://Source.dev?
- AI-Native Infrastructure: We merge deep systems expertise with AI to solve the "impossible" - using AI to automate complex merges and conflict resolution for the next generation of devices.
- Architect the Future: Have a direct, visible impact on the infrastructure used to build the world’s most advanced hardware.
- Early-Stage Ownership: You’ll have a seat at the table to shape our technical roadmap, product direction, and culture from day one.
- Tier-One Partnerships: Work side-by-side with world-class customers, from global automotive giants to leading cloud providers.
- Elite Engineering Culture: Join a high-trust & passionate team of engineers

Every breakthrough in trade infrastructure has followed the same pattern: reduce a transaction cost, expand the market. Containerization for goods. SWIFT for money. Stripe for payments. Sphere built the system that solves it. Our AI (TRAM) ingests global trade law, interprets it, resolves conflicts across jurisdictions, and produces compliance determinations more reliable than human experts.
