Company Overview

MerQube is a technology-driven index provider specializing in the design, calculation, and administration of innovative indices used across a range of financial products and investment strategies. As we continue to grow our global client base, we are looking for a client-focused individual to join our Client Services team in either New York or London.

This role offers broad exposure to our clients, products, and internal teams and is an opportunity to develop into a client-facing account management role within a growing financial technology firm.

The Role

The Client Services Associate will support and increasingly take ownership of client relationships throughout their lifecycle with MerQube. You will develop a strong understanding of your clients, their businesses, the projects they are working on, and how they use MerQube's indices and services.

You will work directly with clients and partner closely with Sales, Legal, Index Production, Product, Finance, and other internal teams to manage contracting, onboarding, launches, reporting, and ongoing client needs. You will also maintain visibility into the sales pipeline, helping ensure prospective opportunities are accurately tracked and that the Client Services team is prepared for upcoming client and project activity.

As you develop your knowledge of our business and client base, you will take on greater responsibility for the day-to-day management of assigned accounts, becoming a trusted point of contact for both the client and internal stakeholders.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys combining relationship management with execution: understanding what a client is trying to accomplish, keeping multiple workstreams moving, solving problems, and making sure the details behind the relationship are handled well.

Client Account Management

  • Develop a strong understanding of assigned clients, their businesses, key stakeholders, current projects, and use of MerQube indices and services.
  • Build relationships with client contacts and serve as an increasingly independent point of contact for day-to-day client needs.
  • Maintain visibility across ongoing client activity, proactively following up on open items, upcoming launches, contractual requirements, and other deliverables.
  • Coordinate internally to ensure client questions and issues are addressed accurately and efficiently.
  • Identify potential relationship risks, additional client needs, or opportunities for expanded engagement and communicate these to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Over time, take broader ownership of assigned client relationships and help ensure clients receive a consistent, high-quality experience across MerQube.

Contracting, Onboarding & Project Coordination

  • Manage client onboarding and coordinate the process from initial commercial agreement through contracting, implementation, and launch.
  • Develop a clear understanding of each project, including the product being launched, the role of the index, relevant counterparties, required services, and key commercial and contractual terms.
  • Draft contracts using established templates and coordinate reviews with Sales, Legal, and other stakeholders.
  • Work directly with clients to move contracts and onboarding requirements through completion, proactively identifying and resolving issues that could delay contracting, onboarding, or launch.
  • Track project milestones and ensure key information and requirements are communicated effectively across internal teams.

Client Information & Technology

  • Maintain accurate and timely client, contract, contact, project, and relationship information in Salesforce, ensuring key information is documented and accessible to relevant internal teams.
  • Use Salesforce and other internal tools to monitor client activity, the sales pipeline, upcoming contractual events, launches, reporting obligations, and other relationship requirements.
  • Leverage AI and other technology responsibly to analyze information, identify actionable insights, develop dashboards and reporting, and create more efficient ways of managing and understanding our client relationships.
  • Contribute to improvements in Client Services processes, reporting, tools, and controls as the business continues to scale.

Sales & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales to maintain visibility into the sales pipeline and ensure opportunities, next steps, and key information are accurately captured and kept current in Salesforce.
  • Provide sales operations support as needed, including pipeline reporting, data management, and coordination of information across teams.
  • Help ensure a smooth transition from prospective opportunities into contracting, onboarding, and ongoing account management.
  • Partner with internal teams to provide client and pipeline context and ensure projects and requests are appropriately prioritized and communicated.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing as appropriate on client communications, events, and other relationship initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in finance, economics, business, or a related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in client services, account management, financial services, indexing, asset management, management consulting, or a related field.
  • Strong interest in financial markets and a desire to develop a deeper understanding of indices and index-linked products.
  • Familiarity with ETFs and other financial products that use, reference, or track indices strongly preferred; exposure to structured products, derivatives, asset management, or index licensing is a plus.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills, both verbal and written, with the confidence to interact professionally with a range of stakeholders.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple clients, projects, contracts, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Solutions-oriented and proactive, with the ability to identify issues, coordinate across teams, and drive matters toward resolution.
  • Comfortable working independently within a fast-paced, collaborative, global organization.
  • Experience with Salesforce or another CRM platform strongly preferred.

Work Arrangement: Hybrid – minimum 3 days per week in the local office

Location: London (Hybrid — Tuesday to Thursday in the office)

Department: Sales

Reporting to: Director of Cloud Sales

ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD:

NexGen Cloud is the company behind Hyperstack, a full-stack AI cloud serving tens of thousands of customers from AI researchers to enterprises running the world's most compute-intensive workloads. We deliver on-demand and private GPU infrastructure to teams who treat performance as a requirement, not a feature.

We're a tight-knit, fast-moving team working at the cutting edge of AI cloud infrastructure. We practice what we preach, equipping our people with AI at every level so we can solve harder problems, ship faster, and keep raising the bar for what enterprise GPU infrastructure looks like.

THE ROLE: Senior Business Development Manager – Vertical Markets

Hyperstack already runs production GPU capacity at scale for AI start-ups, AI service providers and enterprise AI teams. This role exists to extend that position into compute-intensive, regulated and specialist industries — financial services, healthcare and life sciences, robotics and autonomous systems, computer vision and industrial AI — where compute budgets are already committed and infrastructure partners are being chosen now.

You'll own a named vertical end to end: the demand thesis, the target account map, the outbound motion, and every deal through to signature. This is a full-cycle role with real ownership, not a top-of-funnel handoff — you'll become the recognised commercial authority for your vertical inside NexGen, and a credible presence in that industry externally.

Role positioning: this is a role for a senior seller who already holds trust in a compute-intensive industry and wants full ownership of turning that trust into a book of business — the strategy, the pipeline and the close.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

Rather than a long checklist, here's what success in this role looks like:

  • Own a named vertical end to end — build the demand thesis, size the addressable market, and turn it into a prioritised target account map
  • Self-source the majority of your own pipeline and reach the people who decide compute budget: CIO, CTO, Chief Data or AI Officer, and the procurement and risk functions that gate them
  • Lead technical discovery to a real specification, then own the full cycle to signature — commercial proposal, security review, procurement, legal and MSA negotiation
  • Structure multi-year committed reservations and on-demand entry points, and keep a forecast the business can plan capacity against
  • Build Hyperstack's presence in your vertical — industry events, analyst and partner relationships, reference customers and case studies
  • Feed vertical requirements into Product, Capacity and Marketing with enough specificity to change decisions, then follow through until they land
  • Act as the internal reference point for your vertical — brief the wider Sales team and raise the technical floor around you

ABOUT YOU:

We're more interested in how you think and work than in a perfect CV. You'll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential

  • 8+ years in business development, enterprise sales or solution sales, including at least 3 years carrying a new business number in complex enterprise environments
  • A demonstrable record of opening net-new enterprise logos from a standing start — self-sourced, not inherited and not renewal-led
  • Deep credibility in at least one compute-intensive vertical — financial services, healthcare and life sciences, robotics and autonomous systems, computer vision and industrial AI, media and entertainment, or engineering and simulation — including an active network at buying level
  • Substantive infrastructure fluency (cloud, IaaS, HPC, data centre, GPU or AI compute), or a proven history of learning a technical domain to the point of holding your own with engineers
  • Evidence of closing complex deals through procurement, security review and legal, with contract values and cycle lengths you can talk to in detail

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a neo-cloud, GPU-as-a-Service platform, hyperscaler or HPC infrastructure vendor
  • Prior ownership of a vertical or industry go-to-market as a named remit
  • Familiarity with regulated buying environments — data residency and sovereignty, isolation requirements, and the security and compliance reviews that come with them
  • Experience selling committed capacity or reservation-style contracts rather than pure consumption
  • Formal sales methodology — MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or equivalent

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and accelerators above target, plus equity participation
  • Private Medical Insurance 
  • Employee wellbeing benefits
  • 25 days of holiday, plus public holidays
  • Hybrid working, with Tuesday to Thursday in the London office
  • Real ownership of a named vertical, with the trust to build and run it as your own
  • A clear route to principal-level individual contribution or vertical leadership as your vertical scales
  • A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
  • The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud's team, culture, and future alongside ambitious, mission-driven colleagues

MORE INFORMATION

Head over to our NexGen Cloud careers page to view current openings and follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey, newest releases and hear exciting news in the neocloud space.

The Obsidian Security platform gives unified visibility into every human and machine identity, app, and integration across their SaaS estate, detects identity-based and supply chain attacks in real time, and enforces least-privilege access before it's exploited. Trusted by major Fortune 500 companies T-Mobile, Workday, Snowflake, and S&P Global, Obsidian ranked No. 95 on the 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™, growing nearly 1000% from 2021–2024 — helping CISOs turn an unmonitored attack surface into one they can govern with confidence. Obsidian has also been recognized by Forbes as America's Best Startup Employers in 2026.

In August 2026, Obsidian raised $85 million in Series D financing led by Crescent Cove Advisors, with participation from existing investors including Greylock Partners, Menlo Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, IVP, Wing Ventures, and GV — pushing Obsidian's valuation to $1.1 billion, crossing into unicorn status. Obsidian is using the funding to deepen its R&D in agentic AI security and extend its platform as the standard for governing what AI agents can access and do inside third-party applications.

With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and fresh capital from its Series D behind it, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.

job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/occamindustr.description_excerpt:
About Occam

Occam Industries is a British defence-tech company building hardware-agnostic autonomous AI software for military drones. Our AI pilot, OccamX, turns existing, mass-produced aerial platforms into autonomous systems: software-only, running on cheap commodity hardware, and integrating into the supply chains our customers already use.

We work directly with OEMs and defence partners to get capability to the field at speed and scale.

That work is being proven on the front line in Ukraine right now. Our team operates close to the reality of modern warfare, where security, speed, discretion and reliability are not theoretical. They are the conditions that allow the mission to stand up.

Working with Occam

We believe the only defence technology that matters is the kind that changes outcomes on the battlefield. That means we move quickly, work pragmatically, and expect the same from the systems and operations behind the company.

At Occam, operations isn't just admin. As we grow across multiple geographies and move towards Series A, strong finance and people operations are what will allow the rest of the company to move quickly without things breaking behind the scenes.

This role is for someone who enjoys making things work. Someone organised, proactive and dependable, who takes ownership of the details and doesn't need to be chased. You'll be comfortable jumping between payroll, onboarding, payments, expenses and whatever else needs solving that day, while also looking for ways to make those processes better as we grow.

We're still early, so not everything will have a perfect process or playbook yet. You'll have the opportunity to help build them, learn directly from our CFO, take on more responsibility as the company scales, and grow the role with Occam.


About the role

We're a Series A-bound defence tech startup of 20+ people, rapidly expanding across multiple geographies. Our finance function is led by our CFO and supported by an external bookkeeping team. We're looking for an organised, detail-minded Finance & Operations manager to support them, keeping the day-to-day admin running smoothly across finance and people operations. You'll be the glue between the CFO, the bookkeepers and the wider team, making sure the right information gets to the right people on time, and you'll help build the tools and processes we'll need as we scale. It's a great opportunity to learn from an experienced CFO and grow with the business through Series A and beyond.

What you'll do

Payroll & people operations

  • Run monthly payroll on Deel: processing starters, leavers and changes, checking outputs, and submitting for CFO approval.
  • Support pensions, benefits and payroll-related admin.
  • Manage our international employees and contractors on Deel, including contracts, invoices and payments.
  • Run onboarding and offboarding: contracts, right-to-work checks, equipment, system access, and a smooth first week for new starters.
  • Keep HR records, policies and the employee handbook up to date, and be a friendly first port of call for people-ops questions.

Finance support

  • Support the CFO with day-to-day finance admin, preparing information, chasing approvals and keeping things moving.
  • Be the internal point of contact for our external bookkeepers: gathering invoices, receipts and supporting documents, and answering their queries promptly.
  • Prepare supplier and contractor payment runs for approval, including multi-currency international payments.
  • Manage company cards, expense claims and SaaS subscriptions, making sure receipts are captured and spend follows policy.
  • Help with month-end tasks, such as collecting accruals information, checking for missing documents, and supporting the CFO and bookkeepers to hit the close timetable.
  • Assist with group consolidation and intercompany admin across our entities.
  • Help keep the cash-flow forecast and finance trackers up to date.

Tooling, process & growth

  • Help select and roll out new tools as we scale, such as an HRIS, spend management or AP automation. This includes gathering requirements, supporting vendor evaluations, managing setup and data migration, and training the team.
  • Spot manual or repetitive processes and help design better, more scalable ways of working, documenting them clearly as you go.
  • Support the CFO with board packs, budgets, investor reporting and fundraise preparation.
  • Help keep compliance deadlines on track (VAT, company secretarial, and similar) with our advisers.

What we're looking for

  • 1-2 years' experience in a finance, operations or office/people-ops role, ideally in a startup or fast-growing business.
  • Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and a knack for keeping lots of plates spinning.
  • Comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets; experience with Xero is a plus.
  • Some exposure to payroll, expenses or accounts payable admin. Hands-on experience with Deel is a strong plus.
  • Proactive and happy to own tasks end to end without needing to be chased.
  • Clear, approachable communicator who's comfortable working with external partners.
  • Keen to learn and develop your finance career. For example, AAT or a desire to study towards ACCA/CIMA is a plus, but you could also want to become an Ops Wizard.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with outsourced bookkeepers or accountants.
  • Experience with international payments, contractors or EOR arrangements.
  • Experience implementing or administering an HRIS or other finance/ops software.
  • Familiarity with spend management or HR tools.

boards.greenhouse.io/orennia/jobs/528287.description_excerpt:
Location: London, UK
Position Type: Full time, salaried

About Orennia

Orennia provides an all-in-one platform for accurate data, predictive analytics and actionable insights across the energy transition. We drive faster capital allocation decisions and help our clients maximize returns across the solar, wind, storage, power, RNG, CCUS, clean fuels and hydrogen sectors. The technology that powers Orennia’s platform delivers an unparalleled experience, distilling information into actionable insights to give our clients a competitive edge.

As the world decarbonizes its energy stack, trillions in capital need to be deployed. Global investment in the energy transition must quadruple to over $5 trillion annually to stay on the 1.5°C pathway, according to the International Renewable Energy Agency. Without accurate data and predictive analytics, developers and investors will struggle to deploy capital efficiently and maximize returns. Orennia’s platform expedites the energy transition with effective and robust information for smarter capital allocation choices.

Why Join Orennia?

People are at the heart of the best technology companies. We’ve brought together some of the industry’s top experts and brightest minds in data orchestration, analytics, software development, and industry insights to uncover opportunities where others can’t. At Orennia, you’ll become part of a collaborative culture and do work that matters. We trust and support each other, ask hard questions and solve complex problems together. Guided by a spirit of inquiry, our team has a product-driven, continuous delivery mindset to drive our innovation forward.

The Opportunity 

This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth company at an exciting stage of its journey. As one of our first commercial hires in the region, you'll play a key role in establishing Orennia's presence across the UK power markets, building relationships with industry leaders, and helping renewable energy developers, investors, utilities, and infrastructure owners make better decisions through data and analytics.

You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of market experts, analysts, product leaders, and executives to shape our go-to-market strategy, influence product direction, and drive commercial growth across the region. Our mission is simple: accelerate the energy transition through better data and intelligence. Every conversation you have and every client you support contributes to the development of cleaner, more resilient energy systems around the world.

If you're entrepreneurial, intellectually curious, and excited by the opportunity to build something meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

  • Implement the go-to-market strategy to engage leaders across renewable energy developers, IPPs, private equity firms, banking, and clean fuels developers. 
  • Drive Orennia's commercial growth across the UK energy market by identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities.
  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of opportunities across renewable energy developers, utilities, independent power producers, infrastructure funds, private equity firms, banks, and energy market participants.
  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through negotiation, contracting, and expansion.
  • Develop strategic account plans and tailored engagement strategies for key prospects and customers.
  • Partner with prospects to understand their business challenges and demonstrate how Orennia's analytics and market intelligence can support investment and commercial decisions.
  • Represent Orennia at industry conferences, client meetings, and market events across UK
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Research, Marketing, and Client Success teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  • Provide market feedback and client insights that help shape product development and future growth strategies.

Who You Are

  • You have a proven track record of success in a quota-carrying sales role selling SaaS, analytics, market intelligence, data, or technology solutions.
  • You have experience navigating complex enterprise sales cycles and engaging senior decision-makers.
  • You are comfortable building new markets, creating opportunities from scratch, and operating with a high degree of autonomy.
  • You possess exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage executives, investors, and technical stakeholders.
  • You are naturally curious and enjoy understanding complex markets, commercial dynamics, and emerging industry trends.
  • You have experience in, or a strong interest in, power markets, renewable energy, energy infrastructure, energy trading, or the broader energy transition.
  • You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments and enjoy solving new challenges.
  • You are highly motivated, results-oriented, and excited by the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Why You’ll Love Orennia

At Orennia, you'll join a high performing, people-focused team where everyone has a role to play. We offer our regular, full-time employees a competitive total rewards package, comprehensive health, dental and vision benefits, a savings program that includes company matching, and a learning and development budget to master your craft. In addition, we offer generous time off with regular company holidays, paid vacation days and paid sick days. 

We thank all applicants in advance for their interest and for taking the time to apply; however, only applicants invited for an interview will be contacted.

Orennia is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer.…

job-boards.greenhouse.io/odeko/jobs/6221.description_excerpt:
About Us

Odeko is the all-in-one operations and technology partner to more than 20,000 independent coffee shops, cafes and other food establishments.

Through the Odeko web portal and mobile app, customers can purchase supplies from hundreds of national and local brands, track ordering trends, finance equipment, and access insurance. Customers that use Odeko can increase their revenue, reduce their environmental footprint, and save significantly on their cost of goods and time spent on vendor management. 

Odeko is on a mission to continuously develop technology to champion your neighborhood cafes, coffee shops, and other independent F&B establishments.

Local coffee shops and cafes are the backbone of any given community, and we’re here to help manage the day-to-day tasks with a platform so intuitive, it’s kinda like magic.

The Odeko team is diverse, passionate, and innovative. Our 400+ employees are spread across numerous departments and business lines, but are single-minded in our mission to develop technology to support the many needs of our customers. We believe that small businesses need support now more than ever, and that Odeko is uniquely positioned to provide that support.

 

We're hiring a Senior Product Engineer who wants to own problems end to end. You'll talk to the people who have those problems, decide what to build, build it across the front end, back end, and data layer, ship it, and measure whether it worked. You will have the autonomy and authorization to make design, product, and architecture decisions within guidelines set by design and engineering leaders.

You'll build with AI agents as your default tooling. At Odeko, AI-assisted development is a professional standard and engineers are measured on how well they direct, review, and take responsibility for that output. This role assumes you already work this way and what we're hiring for is the judgment about what to build and whether it's right.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own product outcomes, not tickets. Take a problem from a café owner, warehouse lead, or account manager through discovery, scoping, build, launch, and follow-up, with a lot of autonomy in how you get there. We value results over process.
  • Work across the full stack: React Native/Web front ends, Ruby/Rails and TypeScript services, AWS infrastructure, and the data underneath — moving to wherever the problem lives.
  • Spend real time with stakeholders: sit with operations, join customer calls, visit a warehouse. Turn what you learn into decisions about scope, sequencing, and trade-offs, and be able to explain those decisions to non-engineers.
  • Prototype fast and iterate toward the best experience for cafés and users.
  • Build with AI agents as your primary mode of development: planning and decomposing work for agents, running parallel agent workflows, reviewing generated code critically, and maintaining the tests and guardrails that make agent output safe to ship.
  • Raise the team's bar: mentor other engineers, share agent workflows and prompts that work, and contribute to our AI engineering standards.

About you:

Essential:

  • 6–10+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent), with a track record of shipping and operating production applications.
  • Demonstrated product ownership: you can point to things you've shipped where you made the calls on scope and design, not just implementation. You've worked directly with customers or operations staff and changed what you built as a result.
  • Proven expertise across our core stack — TypeScript/JavaScript, React Native/Web, Ruby/Rails, AWS, CI/CD — and distributed application architecture. You don't need to be equally deep everywhere, but you need to be comfortable everywhere.
  • AI-native development as your default practice. Concretely: you use an agentic coding tool (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor agent mode, or similar) to produce the majority of your code; you plan and decompose work so agents can execute it; you review agent output with the same rigor as a colleague's PR and own the result. We'll ask you to demonstrate this live in the interview loop.
  • Strong written and verbal communication with product, design, and operations audiences. You can explain a technical trade-off to a warehouse manager and a business trade-off to an engineer.
  • Experience in a startup or similarly fast-moving, innovative environment with a track record of delivering scalable, mission-critical production applications.

Desirable:

  • Experience building LLM-powered product features: retrieval, tool use, agent workflows, evaluation and observability of model output.
  • Familiarity with Ruby/Rails, React, Federated GraphQL, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, and NetSuite.
  • Experience in logistics, supply chain, marketplace, or other operations-heavy products.
  • Design sensibility: comfortable making reasonable UI decisions without waiting for a mockup.

Compensation for this role is £90k-£100k annually depending on experience. 

What you’ll love about Odeko:

  • Fast-paced environment and growth opportunities - plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and enhance your career!
  • Competitive compensation, healthcare benefits, and opportunity for equity
  • Other great perks -  Full lists of benefits available upon request

 

Odeko is proud to be a diverse, equitable, and inclusive employer. We encourage all to apply regardless of educational background, race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/marqvision/jobs.description_excerpt:
About MarqVision

Protect and build a future shaped by original ideas, innovations and creativity.

Threats to brand integrity are scaling fast. We're building the intelligence to scale faster. MarqVision is the brand integrity partner for the world's most ambitious companies, providing AI-powered detection and enforcement across 1,500+ platforms in 115+ countries. We don't just flag problems; we eliminate them at scale so brands can grow with confidence.

Founded in 2020 and backed by SoftBank, Y Combinator, DST Global Partners, HSG, and Salesforce Ventures, we've been recognized with an LVMH Innovation Award and named to the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies in 2025.

If you want to work at the intersection of AI, global commerce, and IP, this is the place.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Senior Customer Success Manager based in our London office, you'll own the full lifecycle of a portfolio of MarqVision customers, from onboarding through renewal, acting as their trusted partner and single point of accountability. You’ll work closely with teams across MarqVision to ensure customers get full value from our platform and services, and help brands across the UK and Europe protect and grow with confidence. We're looking for someone self-motivated and proactive, a natural relationship builder who is comfortable managing multiple senior stakeholders across large, complex organisations.

What You'll Do:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of customer accounts across the full lifecycle: onboarding, training, check-in calls, business reviews, feature implementation, and renewals
  • Build and maintain relationships at all levels of the customer organisation, including executive sponsors, to understand business priorities and cultivate internal advocacy
  • Proactively monitor account health, identify risk, and execute mitigation plans, escalating internally when needed
  • Drive adoption of MarqVision’s offering, ensuring customers are leveraging the functionality available to them
  • Identify expansion opportunities and partner with Sales to grow account value
  • Define timelines, milestones, and success criteria for customer initiatives and see them through to completion
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, Product, Engineering, and specialist teams to address customer requests and strategise account growth
  • Act as the voice of the customer internally, sharing feedback that shapes our product and improves the customer experience

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years of Customer Success and/or Account Management experience within brand protection, ideally managing customers in the UK and European markets
  • Proven experience owning renewals and expansions, including multi-stakeholder relationships
  • Ability to demonstrate strategic thinking to grow partnership value across complex customer organisations
  • Excellent customer-facing skills: training, coaching, executive-level discussion management, conflict resolution, and the ability to creatively explain and present complex concepts in an easy-to-understand manner
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with colleagues across multiple time zones
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills as well as business and technical acumen
  • Business fluency in French

Bonus Signal

  • Familiarity with marketplace or platform enforcement programmes (e.g., Amazon Brand Registry and similar)
  • Experience working with enterprise customers or in a high-growth startup environment

Why Become a MarqVisioner

  • Holiday to take the time you need, when you need it, plus UK bank holidays
  • Hybrid work model designed for focus and flexibility
  • Equity in every offer, because you should own a piece of what you're building
  • Private medical and dental insurance, plus parental leave to support your life outside of work
  • Workplace pension scheme with employer contribution to help you save for the future

Protect what's original. Scale what's possible. At MarqVision, we believe real growth comes with attracting the brightest minds, motivating them to succeed in their position, and ensuring plenty of fun along the way. If you think this position is for you, apply now.

Equal Opportunity

MarqVision is an equal opportunities employer and encourages applicants of all backgrounds to apply. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

If you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process, please let us know and we'll be happy to support you.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/pathstream/jobs.description_excerpt:
Contract Mechatronics Curriculum Consultant / SME

Pathstream | Remote · part-time contract · ~6–12 months · ~5-10 hrs/week

 

WHAT WE DO

Pathstream was founded on the premise that substantial unrealized economic and human potential exists within each organization's frontline workforce. We are reshaping the way employees and managers on the frontlines excel in their careers. In this age of rapid tech evolution, our enterprise partnerships transform frontline teams from transactional to relational, and from task-oriented to strategic.

We impact companies' bottom lines with improved productivity, increased retention, and differentiated quality of customer experience — while employees experience greater success in their current roles and unlock future professional growth.

We're a tight-knit, hardworking, mission-driven team of ~60 employees eager to scale our solution and transform careers across the United States.

 

THE ROLE

We're looking for experienced maintenance professionals to provide ongoing subject-matter expertise for a training program that prepares people for maintenance-operator roles in automated warehouses and facilities. You bring the real-world experience;  you don't need a background in course design.

We're currently prioritizing UK-based candidates, though it's not a requirement.

Note: We want your experience and professional judgement, not your employer's confidential information. We'll never ask you to share proprietary documents, internal procedures, or other non-public information from a current or former employer.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Give feedback and input on course content — review what we're building and tell us where it's accurate and where it doesn't match how the work is really done.

  • Lend real-world, on-the-floor expertise — what the job is actually like day to day, the knowledge that isn't in any textbook.

  • Help our learners — once the program launches, be a knowledgeable, credible person they can turn to with questions as they build confidence in an unfamiliar field.

ABOUT YOU

  • You have hands-on experience maintaining automated equipment — the kind found in warehouses, fulfillment centers, or similar facilities — across mechanical, electrical, and basic automation/controls. You've done the real diagnosis and repair, not just read about it.

  • You ideally hold relevant industry credentials — SACA certifications or micro-credentials, or comparable technical qualifications.

  • You understand the entry-level maintenance operator role and the people entering it. You may have worked in the role yourself, supervised or mentored operators, or worked alongside them as a technician.

  • You can spot when something isn't how it's really done and explain the right way clearly and specifically. Clear communication is key.

  • You're comfortable working with beginners. You can explain technical work patiently to people brand new to it, without dumbing it down or making them feel out of their depth.

  • Teaching or training experience is a strong plus — if you teach mechatronics or maintenance at a community college or trade school, or have mentored apprentices and new technicians, you already know what beginners get stuck on.

  • You're available around 5- 10 hours a week on a contract basis, including some ongoing availability once the program is live to help answer learner questions. If you don't have that much availability, please still reach out — we're open to working with experts who can offer less.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Meaningful work where your expertise directly shapes a program that helps people launch skilled-trade careers.

  • Flexible, mostly asynchronous, part-time, remote contract work that fits alongside an existing job.

  • Competitive contract rate, based on experience; scope and weekly hours to be discussed

 

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

Our company values diversity and believes diverse teams make innovation possible. We work on complex, difficult problems with no linear or clear solutions. We need a diverse team that can bring different perspectives and approaches, and whose experiences reflect the full set of stakeholders we seek to serve. As such, Pathstream is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage all qualified applicants from any race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or other characteristics to apply.

 

#LI-Remote

job-boards.greenhouse.io/pdtpartners/job.description_excerpt:

We hire exceptionally talented engineers and give them room to grow in a dynamic, supportive environment. The people who thrive here value breadth, continuous learning, and long-term investment in their craft. They  find energy in growth that comes from rotating through different teams across the organization. This kind of mobility is central to how we work, allowing engineers to build deep, varied skills and make meaningful impact over time.

 Data

 Trading Control   

  • Engineers the real-time and historical systems that monitor trading activity, including PnL, alerting, and risk, and builds the tools that enable teams to diagnose issues fast and intervene with confidence. 

 Trading Infrastructure

job-boards.greenhouse.io/pagerduty/jobs/.description_excerpt:
PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

 

PagerDuty is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (SRE Agent) to join our customer-focused SRE Agent team! As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work inside PagerDuty’s largest customer accounts, connecting the SRE Agent to their production environments (observability tools, infrastructure as code, GitOps tooling, and CI/CD pipelines) and guiding their teams from AI-assisted incident response to supervised and autonomous actions with safety guardrails. You will also contribute code directly back to the core SRE Agent product, building reusable tools, connectors, and skills derived from real customer needs.

This is an exciting opportunity to join the product engineering team as the Staff Engineer and directly shape how agentic AI operates within the most strategic customers. The ideal candidate brings a strong background as a software engineer, hands-on experience shipping LLM/agentic systems to production, and the customer-facing skills to bridge technical execution with business strategy.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Embed and drive SRE Agent adoption: Work onsite and in regular contact with 2–4 strategic customer teams to deploy the SRE Agent, configure tools and connectors, and embed AI actions across their incident management lifecycle to drive adoption and value 
  • Build and contribute core agent capabilities: Scope, design, and build reusable agent tools, connectors, and skills on the agent’s extensibility surfaces, shipping them through the product team's repos, review process, and evaluation gates.
  • Run pilots and unblock customer adoption: Stand up new agentic capabilities with strategic accounts first, gather eval data, identify technical blockers (permissions, telemetry, missing connectors), and build production fixes directly into the product.
  • Integrate with production stacks and progressive delivery: Connect the SRE Agent to IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), GitOps (ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines, and observability platforms, guiding customers safely from AI-assisted to autonomous operations.
  • Set technical direction and feedback insights: Define 3–6 month technical roadmaps across assigned accounts, provide architectural guidance to product managers and engineering managers, and bring customer friction and eval data back to the core team.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years of experience building and shipping production software across team boundaries (assessed against PagerDuty Staff Engineer / SDE V expectations).
  • Hands-on experience with LLM and agent systems in production, including agent development, tool-use frameworks (MCP or equivalent), evaluation pipelines, and guardrail design.
  • Customer-facing skills. You can run a technical design session with a customer’s engineers and present the business case to their leadership.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You can start from a vague problem statement in an unfamiliar environment and get to working software without much direction. Former founders and founding engineers tend to do well in this role.
  • A record of shipping software that got adopted, and the judgment to recognize which customer requests generalize and when the right answer is not to build.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/pelago/jobs/519.description_excerpt:
Pelago is the leading specialty substance use care provider, built on the belief that effective treatment means matching care intensity to what each member actually needs rather than defaulting to the most expensive intervention. Our programs guide members through every stage of the substance use spectrum, from unhealthy habits to active use disorders, delivering personalized treatment for tobacco, alcohol, opioid, cannabis, and stimulant use based on individual health, habits, genetics, and goals.

With Sona, our voice-first AI Mental Health Specialist, Pelago now applies that same clinically-driven model to mental health, pairing deep clinical expertise with technology to expand access without compromising care quality. We believe technology should make clinical care more precise and more human, not replace the judgment behind it.

About Pelago Engineering:

Our engineering team operates as empowered, outcome-oriented problem solvers, working in close partnership with product, design, and clinical teams to improve member outcomes at scale.

As AI transforms how software is built, we are intentionally evolving our development lifecycle so we spend less time on mechanical implementation and more time on system design, judgment, and impact.

How We Work:

  • Outcome-driven: Engineers are given problems to solve, not just features to build. Success is measured by learning, impact, and outcomes—not velocity alone
  • AI-native: We use AI across the SDLC to accelerate implementation, testing, and review. Engineers focus on defining intent, validating behavior, and designing resilient systems
  • High autonomy, high accountability: Teams have real ownership over their domains. With autonomy comes responsibility for quality, safety, and results
  • Cross-functional by default: Engineers partner deeply with Product, Design, Data, and Clinical. Discovery, experimentation, and delivery are shared responsibilities
  • Quality and safety matter: We build in a regulated, member-impacting domain. Reliability, observability, and correctness are first-class concerns

 

What You’ll Do:

Instead of task lists, anchor on ownership:

  • Own meaningful problem spaces end-to-end, from discovery through delivery and iteration
  • Design and evolve systems that support safe, scalable, AI-augmented development
  • Use data and experimentation to validate whether solutions actually work
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to balance member impact, clinical constraints, and technical tradeoffs
  • Shape how we work—our tools, processes, and culture

 

What We Look For:

 We explicitly assess for empowerment:

  • You start with "why" before diving into "how"
  • You're energized by ambiguity and collaborative problem-shaping
  • You use AI to amplify your judgment and move faster on what matters
  • You think in systems and anticipate second-order effects
  • You want to own outcomes, not just ship features

 

Overview of the Role:
Pelago is building behavioral health care delivery from the ground up – AI-native, outcome-oriented, and built for a domain where what you ship has direct consequences for member health. Product Engineers own meaningful problems end-to-end: from discovery through production and iteration, in close partnership with product, design, data, and clinical stakeholders. The hire we're looking for is technically strong enough to ship across the stack, fluent enough with AI tooling to move fast, and grounded enough to make sound trade-offs in an environment where member safety, privacy, and reliability matter as much as speed.

 

 

In This Role You Will:

  • Own meaningful product areas end-to-end — from problem framing and prototype through production rollout and iteration.
  • Partner deeply with product, design, data, and clinical teams to shape solutions that improve member outcomes and business results.
  • Build and evolve secure, well-tested, observable software across backend, frontend, and data surfaces.

  • Operate autonomously in ambiguous environments, communicating proactively across globally distributed teams and functions.
  • Make sound trade-offs across speed, safety, technical quality, and maintainability in a regulated environment.
  • Improve Pelago's engineering system: AI-native development practices, testing, documentation, knowledge sharing, and review quality.

The Background We're Looking For:

  • Strong production experience building product software in a startup or scale-up environment.
  • Excellent TypeScript/Node capability; comfortable working across APIs, services, data and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong product sense:  able to start from the user or business problem, not just the implementation.
  • Comfortable operating autonomously in ambiguous environments and making sound trade-offs with incomplete information.
  • Solid testing, observability, and reliability instincts.
  • Fluent with AI-augmented engineering workflows while maintaining human judgment and QA discipline.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience in healthcare, digital health, or safety-sensitive regulated software.
  • Experience with event-driven systems, serverless AWS, relational database design, and infrastructure as code.
  • Experience with experimentation, analytics, and growth/product instrumentation.
  • Experience contributing to both backend and user-facing product surfaces.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/safariai/jobs/5.description_excerpt:
About Safari AI
Safari AI's vision is to Automate Action of the leading companies in the physical economy, from Entertainment, Live Venues, QSR's, Retail and beyond. The company uses computer vision AI to Measure, Alert and provide AI-generated Recommendations at the operations of leading enterprises such as Merlin/Legoland, 7-11, Tanger Outlets, Charlotte Hornets, Tennessee Titans, and more.
 
Leadership & Culture
Safari AI is founded by Ali Vahabzadeh, who has a meaningful exit under his belt and has managed large, high-performing Go To Market and Engineering teams. The company is headquartered in Miami with the Engineering team co-located in Vancouver.
 
About You And How You Succeed At Safari AI
You're excited to build a product and invent a market that hasn't existed before. You read documentation first and are not afraid to ask for help when uncertain. You're looking to take ownership/run a singular project and take advantage of the freedom and culture an early stage startup can provide. You are looking to see through the fluff of the modern AI landscape and explore new ways of achieving measurable ROI. Enjoy a small team size ~10, project team of 1-3.

About the Role
Safari AI already works with UK-headquartered enterprises such as Merlin Entertainments, and demand from operators across the UK and Ireland in attractions, live venues, retail and hospitality is growing. Safari AI now needs a Country Head to run the UK & Ireland business as its general manager responsible for sales, client success, and activations. You will be the first Safari AI leader on the ground in the region and will own its growth end to end: winning new enterprise clients, making existing clients successful, building partnerships, and hiring the local team. This role is based in London, reports to and works directly with the Miami-based CEO, and works closely with the Go To Market and Engineering teams in Miami and Vancouver. We welcome country managers, general managers, senior enterprise sales and client success leaders, and top-tier management and transformation consultants to apply.

What You Will Own

  • Regional P&L and growth: set the UK & Ireland go-to-market plan, revenue targets and budget with the CEO, and report on results
  • New business: build and close a pipeline of enterprise clients across attractions, live venues, sports, retail, QSR and hospitality
  • Client success: be the senior point of contact for UK & Ireland clients, lead QBR's, prove ROI and grow accounts
  • Partnerships: build relationships with camera, systems integrator, technology and channel partners in the region
  • Team building: hire, lead and develop the local team (sales, client success and deployment) as the region grows
  • Operations: coordinate deployments with Engineering, and work with Finance and legal advisors on local contracting, data protection (UK GDPR / EU GDPR) and procurement requirements
  • Market presence: represent Safari AI at industry events and conferences, and bring local market insight back into product and company strategy

Requirements for the Role

  • Mandatory #1: Track record of owning commercial results in the UK & Ireland as a country manager, general manager, or senior enterprise sales, account, client or client success leader
  • Mandatory #2: You can point to specific value created and show how you calculated ROI for clients
  • Established network among enterprise operators in the UK & Ireland (attractions, venues, sports, retail, hospitality or similar)
  • AI-first: We expect you to be currently using as many relevant AI tools as available to leverage your time and 'multiply yourself'
  • Fast technical learner: eager to learn about new technologies and how they can be applied to legacy industries
  • Experience crafting, soliciting and communicating ROI, Payback Periods, and other financial performance metrics
  • Proven ability and willingness to serve clients in a variety of industries, not just one vertical
  • Comfortable being the first employee in a new region and working across time zones with a US-based leadership team
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Willingness to travel across the UK & Ireland, and occasionally to the US to meet with the Exec team and Board of Directors
  • Experience building and managing a team strongly preferred

What Safari AI offers

  • An opportunity to scale up Safari AI's UK & Ireland business and revolutionize how businesses uses Vision AI throughout their operations
  • Professional growth at a fast-growing, venture-funded startup with proven exec team
  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity for founding team leaders
  • Unlimited vacation days
  • Competitive benefits package

Why bet on Computer Vision and Safari AI? 

  1. Huge opportunity hiding in plain sight: leveraging already-installed cameras to automate and real-time action on operational data
  2. Already the market leader in enterprise CV by working with industry leaders with billions in revenue
  3. Large chasm between customer knowledge and market availability, i.e. customers don't know what is available in the market...yet.
  4. Early leader in computer vision; everyone is small and unbranded (i.e. no Amazon or Google in the room to compete with)
  5. Very modular, allowing Safari AI and its customers to invent whole new use cases on a regular basis
  6. Developed the tech and data pipelines over three years and invested several million dollars and is now ready to scale

Strong project management is a key element of client success at RainFocus. Your focus is entirely on leadership: managing timelines and risks, building strong client relationships, aligning stakeholders, and driving successful outcomes across a portfolio of concurrent projects.
Our clients are sophisticated, high-touch, and deeply invested in their events. That means you will be in daily communication across multiple channels, navigating scope conversations, managing competing priorities, and keeping complex projects on track even when requirements shift. It also means this work is genuinely meaningful — you will own the client relationship and see the direct impact of your leadership at every event.
Our Project Managers typically manage multiple client engagements simultaneously, with project cycles averaging 9–12 months. You will also take on projects mid-lifecycle as part of normal portfolio management — experience navigating mid-flight transitions is a strong asset.
This remote role can be located anywhere in the United States. Average travel is up to 15%, averaging 5–7 days per trip. Travel primarily involves being onsite at client events, which may include weekends, as well as post-event reviews and client-driven meetings.
